magic-item:shielding-turtle-sugarbombs.description: A pack of 2. Eating one as a Magic action reduces your Speed by 10 feet for 1 minute; if you're trained with Shields and wearing one on your back (not wielding one), you gain +1 AC meanwhile. Upset Stomach: only one such sugarbomb works at a time; eating another replaces it and forces a DC 13 Constitution save or you're Poisoned for 1 minute.

magic-item:signet-rings-of-blindness-dea.description: Each ring has 1 charge, regained at dawn: expend it (no action) to end Blinded, end Deafened, or speak a phrase (such as a Verbal component) through magical silence, matching the ring. Worn as a set they pool their 3 charges.

magic-item:signet-rings-of-the-fey-court.description: Four seasonal rings attuned together. While wearing them you know Druidcraft and gain the Trance trait. Each has 2 charges, regained on a Long Rest: as a Reaction when you take Radiant (spring), Fire (summer), Necrotic (autumn), or Cold (winter) damage, expend that ring's charge for Resistance to it until your next turn; or as a Reaction when an enemy targets you with magic, expend any 2 charges for Advantage on saves against magic until your next turn.

magic-item:silken-socks-of-slickening.description: Once per dawn while wearing both, cast Grease (DC 13) centered within 5 feet of you.

magic-item:silver-eagle-weapons.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. They deal 2d6 damage instead of their normal dice. Critical Hits don't double dice; instead, whenever both damage dice match, roll an extra 1d6, continuing while each new die matches.

magic-item:silver-lycan-chime.description: Hung up, it plays a distinct melody (audible 100 feet) when a Lycanthrope passes within 15 feet, or within 60 feet under a full moon; each kind has its own tune.

magic-item:singing-stein.description: Holding alcohol, its face sings songs suited to the drink, harmonizing with other steins. If the drink is poisoned it sings off-key, noticed with a Search action and a Perception check (DC set by the GM).

magic-item:sirensong-silencer.description: Put on as a Magic action, it grants Advantage on saves against Charmed. Tapping it twice Deafens you (hearing only faint ocean sounds), and again to end it.

magic-item:sling-of-the-tiny-giant.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Ranged hits deal an extra 1d4 Force damage per size the target is larger than you (maximum 3d4). On a natural 20, the target makes a DC 15 Strength save (Disadvantage if Large or larger) or is pushed 10 feet and knocked Prone.

magic-item:smash-potatoes.description: Eating one lets your hand Unarmed Strikes deal 1d4 damage for 1 hour; each extra potato adds an hour, up to three per Long Rest.

magic-item:snuff.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra 1d6 Psychic damage. Once per dusk as a Magic action, extinguish nonmagical flames within 60 feet and dispel spell-made light there (as Dispel Magic, +4 modifier). As a Magic action it becomes a shadowy scythe (Two-Handed, Reach, 2d6 Psychic), reverting as a Bonus Action.

magic-item:snugglebeast.description: When you spend Hit Dice at the end of a Short Rest spent snuggling it, you regain extra Hit Points: owlbear (common) 1d6, unicorn (uncommon) 2d6, dragon (rare) 3d6, tarrasque (very rare) 4d6. One at a time, once per Long Rest per toy.

magic-item:socks-of-the-well-rested.description: Finishing a Long Rest wearing both grants 1d8 + your Constitution modifier Temporary Hit Points.

magic-item:spellwoven-robe.description: While wearing it without armor, your base AC is 10 + your spellcasting modifier. When you cast a level 1+ spell, you can change its style, color, and material.

magic-item:spiderbite-daggers.description: When you hit the same creature with both on your turn, it makes a DC 13 Constitution save or takes an extra 2d4 Poison damage and is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.

magic-item:spire-seed.description: Planted by its attuned owner, it grows in 30 days into a 300-foot magical tree (attunement survives distance on the same plane and up to 1 minute of death; losing it early kills the tree). A loyal Dryad guards a door opened with the seed's stem, after which the tree is yours: ten floors you arrange, hidden windows, immune to divination, scrying, teleportation, and planar travel. It has AC 20, 500 Hit Points, immunity to Poison, Psychic, and nonmagical non-siege weapon damage, Resistance to all else, regains 1d6 at dawn, and regrows destroyed parts in 7 days. Once per dawn when attacked it creates a defending Treant. Killing the dryad yourself makes it nonmagical. It makes a new seed every 100 years.

magic-item:spirit-pike.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric; pike
magic-item:spirit-pike.description: You're proficient with it while attuned. When you cast Spiritual Weapon while holding it, it becomes the spectral weapon, dealing 1d10 + your spellcasting modifier Force damage (+1d8 per slot level above 2), and returns when the spell ends. It has 4 charges, all regained at dawn; on a hit with either form, expend 1 for an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

magic-item:splintershot.description: As a Magic action, shatter a nocked nonmagical arrow into a 15-foot Cone: DC 15 Dexterity save or 2d6 Piercing damage (3d6 within 5 feet of you).

magic-item:splitter.description: As a Bonus Action with a command word it splits into a handaxe and quarterstaff (both Light), or rejoins. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. (+1 each when split). Halberd: rolling a 10 on its damage die reduces the target's Speed by 10 feet and raises yours by 10 until your next turn. Split: +1 AC while wielding both, you add your modifier to the Light extra attack, the quarterstaff deals Necrotic damage (maximized against plants), and the thrown handaxe returns.

magic-item:squasher.description: A durable squash; druids can use Wisdom for its melee attack and damage rolls.

magic-item:staff-of-favorable-winds.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:staff-of-favorable-winds.description: While holding it, wind-caused Difficult Terrain costs no extra movement, and as a Magic action you can create harmless gust effects. It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn (on the last, roll 1d20; on a 1 it blows away): Feather Fall 1, Gust of Wind 2, Wind Wall 3, Cone of Cold 5, with your DC.

magic-item:staff-of-the-four-seasons.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:staff-of-the-four-seasons.description: A magic quarterstaff with a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls and 10 charges (regaining 1d6 + 2 at dawn; on the last, roll 1d20; on a 1 it becomes nonmagical). With a charge, melee hits deal an extra 1d8 of its season's type: spring Radiant, summer Fire, autumn Necrotic, winter Cold. Focus 10 minutes to change season for 8 hours. Spells by season (1/2/3 charges): spring Guiding Bolt, Moonbeam, Plant Growth; summer Burning Hands, Spike Growth, Fireball; autumn Inflict Wounds, Pass without Trace, Vampiric Touch; winter Color Spray, Darkvision, Sleet Storm.

magic-item:staff-of-the-magpie.description: A 10-pound stone staff. +1 to Perception checks to search for treasure or a sought item. It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn: Locate Object (2) or Fly (3). On the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 the magpie flies off and it becomes a plain quarterstaff.

magic-item:staff-of-the-mirage.description: It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn (on the last, roll 1d20; on a 1 it vanishes). Cast with your DC +2: Disguise Self 1, Silent Image 1, Invisibility 2, Mirror Image 2, Hallucinatory Terrain 4, Mislead 5.

magic-item:staff-of-the-mustang.description: It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn (on the last, roll 1d20; on a 1 it breaks). Expend 1 to cast Phantom Steed, or 1 with a command word to Dash as a Bonus Action.

magic-item:staff-of-the-reverent-warrior.description: A bladed staff usable as a magic quarterstaff with a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls, dealing Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage (your choice). While attuned you know True Strike; when casting it with the staff, spend charges from its 10 (regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn): 2 to cast it as a Bonus Action, 1 to give the next attack against the target Advantage, 1 on a hit for an extra 1d6 Radiant damage. On the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 it becomes nonmagical (keeping the damage choice).

magic-item:stalaga-spear.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. Within 5 feet of unworked stone or earth, as a Magic action expend 1 to plunge it in and erupt as a 10-foot spike from another such surface within 60 feet: creatures in a 5-by-10-foot Line make a DC 16 Dexterity save, taking 4d6 Piercing damage and pushed 5 feet, or half damage only. As a Bonus Action near stone within 60 feet of the spike, recall it to your hand.

magic-item:starbreaker.description: While held it sheds Bright Light 20 feet and Dim 20 more. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra 1d4 Radiant damage. Once per dawn, cast Daylight with it.

magic-item:starmetal-ring.description: Over 1 hour, bond it to an object of up to 25 pounds that is at least half metal (one at a time). As a Bonus Action, pull the bonded object within 40 feet up to 20 feet toward you, catching it if you have a free hand.

magic-item:starmetal-shield.description: A hovering shield tied to a gauntlet, leaving your hand free; it grants +1 AC instead of a Shield's normal bonus, or +3 against attacks with metal weapons or projectiles. As a Magic action, throw it at up to three targets (the first within 30 feet, each next within 10 feet of the last), making a proficient ranged attack against each with Strength or Dexterity, ignoring Half and Three-Quarters Cover, dealing 2d8 Slashing damage; it then returns.

magic-item:starmetal-solar-axe.description: Fused as a greataxe: +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls, an extra 2d6 Fire damage, and sunlight (Bright 20 feet, Dim 20 more). Fissioned into two battleaxes: +1 each and an extra 1d6 Cold damage; they orbit you, and when you Attack you can make a Bonus Action melee attack with an orbiting axe against a target within 20 feet. Switching states is a Bonus Action with a command word: fission blasts creatures within 30 feet (DC 17 Dexterity, 3d6 Lightning, half on success), fusion does the same with Fire; each once per 12 hours.

magic-item:starmetal-striker.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra 1d4 Cold damage and returns to your hand after a ranged attack.

magic-item:steps-of-the-trickster.description: You can change the sound of your footsteps (not their volume), such as bare feet, heels, or metal boots.

magic-item:storm-sickle.description: You can make proficient ranged attacks with it (20/60, Strength, 1d4 Slashing). All its attacks deal an extra 1d4 Lightning damage.

magic-item:storm-thrower-harpoon.description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Ranged hits deal an extra 1d8 Lightning damage, and as a Bonus Action after a throw you reel it back by its chain. Once per dawn after a hit on a target open to the sky, call lightning: it and creatures within 5 feet make a DC 16 Dexterity save (Disadvantage if submerged or in metal armor), 6d10 Lightning damage or half; you're immune. As a Magic action, make a ranged attack against a creature up to one size larger; on a hit it makes a DC 17 Strength save or is pulled 20 feet toward you.

magic-item:stormstruck-staff.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra 1 Lightning damage. For 1 minute after it or you (holding it) take Lightning damage from another source, or while under Shillelagh, it glows (Bright Light 10 feet, Dim 10 more) and the extra damage becomes 1d6.

magic-item:sundersludge-net.description: An ooze net. A creature Restrained by it takes 1d6 Acid damage then and at the end of each of its turns, and nonmagical metal armor takes a cumulative -1 AC each time (destroyed at 10; Mending fixes it). Others touching it take 1d6 Acid damage; you're immune while attuned. Escape takes an action and a DC 13 Athletics check, or destroying it (AC 10, 5 Hit Points, Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, Psychic, Resistance to others). Salvaged scraps stored in a 5-gallon container for 12 hours regrow it; attunement ends if torn for 48 hours.

magic-item:switch.description: As a Bonus Action, spend a Wild Shape use to turn it into any Simple or Martial Bludgeoning or Piercing weapon without Loading or Reach (making its own ammunition), proficient, using Wisdom, dealing an extra 1d8 damage; switch forms as a Bonus Action. Spend a second use as a Magic action for bark armor: Temporary Hit Points equal to four times your druid level and AC 17 if lower. It lasts hours equal to half your druid level, ending at 0 Hit Points or as a Bonus Action.

magic-item:sword-of-resonance.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a bard; longsword
magic-item:sword-of-resonance.description: A hollow brass sword usable as a lute and Spellcasting Focus, proficient with both while attuned. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the Finesse property. After you spend Bardic Inspiration while holding it, your next hit with it before the end of your next turn deals an extra 1d6 Thunder damage.

magic-item:sword-of-the-spelldrinker.description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While holding it, magical light and Darkness within 30 feet count as nonmagical for you, and you can breathe in any environment. It has 2 charges, regaining 1d2 at dusk: cast Counterspell, which automatically stops spells of level 5 or lower and fails against 6 or higher. You can absorb a stopped 1-action or Bonus Action spell for 8 hours (one at a time) and release it with the matching action, using the original caster's slot, DC, attack bonus, and ability.

magic-item:talyard-the-great-s-wand-of-p.description: A plain stick that looks magnificent to drunk creatures. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dusk; while you're drunk, cast Thaumaturgy (free), Heroism (1), or Lesser Restoration (2) with a +3 modifier.

magic-item:tear-of-gaia.description: Crushed underfoot as a Magic action, it revives plants in a 10-foot Emanation and ripens their produce over 1 hour; with no plants, it spreads an inch of grassy topsoil.

magic-item:tectonic-gauntlets.description: Your fist Unarmed Strikes deal 1d8 Bludgeoning damage (double to objects and structures). They have 15 charges, regaining 1d10 + 5 at dawn: spend up to 5 on a strike for +5 feet of reach each; up to 3 on a hit for an extra 1d8 Bludgeoning each plus a DC 18 Strength save or pushed 5 feet; or cast Shatter 2, Spike Growth 2, Wall of Stone 5, Move Earth 6, Earthquake 8 (DC 18). Once per Short or Long Rest as a Magic action, encase yourself in stone for 1 hour: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing, half Speed, Disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saves, and a 30-foot Burrow Speed through earth and stone (ending it while burrowed shunts you out for 1d10 Force). Curse: they fuse to you, reducing Speed by 5 feet and Intelligence by 4 (minimum 7) until Greater Restoration or Remove Curse. 1 minor beneficial and 1 minor detrimental random property; destroyed only in the mines of Durhun.

magic-item:telescoping-bladelance.description: As a Bonus Action it extends into a lance or retracts into a greatsword dealing 1d10 Slashing damage. Right after a greatsword hit, extend it as a Bonus Action to push a Large or smaller target 5 feet.

magic-item:tempest-griffon-feather-cape.description: While wearing it you have Lightning Resistance and Advantage on Dexterity saves against Lightning effects. Once per dawn as a Magic action, become lightning and travel to a space within 120 feet without provoking: other creatures in the 5-foot-wide Line or within 5 feet of either end make a DC 16 Dexterity save, 3d10 Lightning damage or half.

magic-item:tether-tearer.description: Hits against a creature with Incorporeal Movement deal an extra 1d6 Force damage and deny that trait until the end of its next turn.

magic-item:tethervine-quiver.description: Holds 20 arrows or bolts. As a Bonus Action with a command word, tie a drawn piece to its inner vine (up to 120 feet, regrowing 30 feet at dawn); shot into a surface it becomes a climbable line holding 250 pounds. As a Bonus Action reel it back 60 feet, pulling objects under 25 pounds it struck; it detaches on hitting a creature.

magic-item:the-griffon-s-saddlebag.description: A sentient chaotic neutral bag (Int 13, Wis 15, Cha 16; speaks Common and with griffons) made by the astral griffon Criir. It always weighs 3 pounds and works as a Bag of Holding pierceable only by Artifacts; other extradimensional items placed in it (or it in them) are destroyed and their contents absorbed. It offers courier quests that dispense magic items for payment and rewards, buys magic items for half price, and has 8 charges (regaining 1d6 + 2 at dawn) for Detect Magic 1, Identify 1, or Legend Lore 5, with more spells unlocked at the GM's discretion (Blink, Fly, Dimension Door, Divination, Secret Chest, Etherealness, Magnificent Mansion, Plane Shift). It can't be permanently destroyed.

magic-item:the-rose-basket.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra 1d8 Radiant damage to Fey and shape-shifted creatures. Once per dawn as a Magic action, grow silver rosebushes in a 25-foot square around you for 1 minute: Difficult Terrain dealing 2d4 Piercing damage per 5 feet moved, which you ignore while holding it.

magic-item:thornpiercer.description: A rose hilt that grows a dagger, shortsword, rapier, or whip as a Bonus Action; you're proficient with them. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra 1d4 Piercing damage. Dagger: the thrown blade bursts, and the target and up to three chosen creatures within 10 feet make a DC 17 Dexterity save or take 1d4 + 2 Piercing damage. Rapier: on a natural 20, an extra 10 Piercing damage, and a Large or smaller target makes a DC 17 Constitution save or loses that much Hit Point maximum (half on a success) until a rest. Shortsword: the first creature hit each turn makes a DC 17 Constitution save or takes 1d6 Poison damage and is Poisoned until the end of its next turn. Whip: on a hit against a Medium or smaller creature, it makes a DC 17 Strength save or is Grappled by the detached whip, taking 1d4 Piercing damage each turn (DC 17 Athletics as an action to escape).

magic-item:thunderous-flail.description: It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; with any charge, the first target you hit each turn takes an extra 1d6 Lightning damage. Expend 1 to cast Thunderwave (DC 15), or right after a melee attack as a Bonus Action toward the target. Its magnetic ball can be launched as a proficient ranged attack (20/60, Strength, 1d8 Bludgeoning), pulled back 20 feet as a Bonus Action, and serves as the origin of a 10-foot-radius Thunderwave while detached.

magic-item:thwackstaff.description: A festive quarterstaff with the Finesse property and +1 to Performance checks using it. It has 3 charges, all regained at dawn; as a Reaction when hit by a melee attack from a creature you can see, expend 1 and roll 1d6 to add to your AC; if that makes it miss, attack the creature, adding the d6 to damage on a hit.

magic-item:timber.description: Its attack and damage bonus equals its charges; each hit adds a charge, and at the third it explodes for an extra 3d6 Force damage (6d6 against wood), resets, and can push a target up to one size larger 10 feet. Charges last 1 minute and are lost on a miss, switching targets, or using another weapon.

magic-item:timepiercer.description: A quartz hourglass hilt that forms a rapier of sand as a Bonus Action. While formed, you gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Each once per dawn, cast Haste or Slow (DC 16) from the hilt with Advantage on Concentration saves.

magic-item:timeshifter-s-mantle.description: Once per dawn, as a Reaction after a Large or smaller creature hits you with a melee attack, move up to half your Speed without provoking, and the attacker's Speed becomes 0 until its next turn.

magic-item:toadstone.description: While wearing it you have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed and can hold your breath for 1 hour; once per dusk, cast Jump on yourself. Curse: until Remove Curse, your skin stays clammy and you crave only insects and grubs.

magic-item:tome-of-dreams.description: Reading a story takes 10 minutes; after your next Long Rest roll 1d20: 10 or lower, take 2d4 Psychic damage; 11 or higher, gain 2d4 Temporary Hit Points.

magic-item:torchbearer-s-reach.description: When held, its handle sheds flame (Bright Light 20 feet, Dim 20 more); flick it to form a 10-foot fiery whip with the Light property dealing Fire damage, harmless to you, that can't grab things but can light fires. Snuff it as a Bonus Action.

magic-item:torpedo-ammunition.description: Ignores underwater ranged attack drawbacks; out of water its ranges are halved.

magic-item:torrent-taiaha.description: A magic quarterstaff that can also lash water for proficient 10-foot-reach attacks using Wisdom (1d4 Bludgeoning); you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with both. While holding it you can walk on liquids (sinking if you end your turn there). Once per dawn, cast Control Water (flood or part water only) while holding it.

magic-item:tote-of-tricky-treat-sugarbom.description: A bag of 5d8 + 10 candies. Eating one as a Magic action rolls 1d20 for a minor effect lasting 1 minute, mostly harmless illusions or oddities (melting face, colored ears, snake pupils, maniacal laughter), with some mischievous ones such as a spoiled candy (DC 13 Constitution save or lose your next action retching).

magic-item:trident-of-the-dryad.description: It has 4 charges, regaining 1d3 + 1 at dawn. Within 5 feet of a Large or bigger tree, as a Bonus Action expend 1 to teleport to within 5 feet of another such tree within 60 feet. Once per dawn as a Magic action, plant it to become a 60-foot tree (faint Transmutation aura); near it, as a Bonus Action expend 1 to teleport anywhere on it. Touching it, repeat the command word as a Magic action to revert it (creatures in it fall).

magic-item:trident-of-the-hydra.description: A short-hafted mithral trident without Versatile. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When thrown, it splits into three spears: make three ranged attacks, each dealing 1d6 Piercing damage without your ability modifier; it then reforms.

magic-item:tub-of-churning-and-fermentat.description: Holds 2 gallons or 1 cubic foot. Once per dawn, seal perishables inside and name a plausible product (cider, wine, sauerkraut, pickles, butter, cheese, yogurt); after 10 minutes it unlocks with the contents transformed.

magic-item:uorik-the-conqueror-s-juice-c.description: As a Bonus Action whisper a fruit's name to make water in it look and taste like that juice (shouting makes it fizzy); it remains water. Poisoned water tastes foul.

magic-item:vancian-helm.description: Made from a shield guardian; grants +1 AC. It stores one spell of level 1-4 cast into it by any creature, which you can cast while wearing it using the original caster's slot, DC, attack bonus, and ability. A level 5+ spell cast into it while you wear it is wasted and deals you 2d6 Psychic damage. Your eyes glow while it holds a spell.

magic-item:venombane-armor.description: While wearing it you can't be caught in webs and move through them as Difficult Terrain; as a Reaction when you take Poison damage, reduce it by 1d8 + your Constitution modifier.

magic-item:vigilus.description: A hand crossbow with a six-bolt autoloading case (ignore Loading while loaded; reload with a Utilize action). As a Magic action deploy it as a Tiny turret; within 30 feet, as a Bonus Action command it to attack a target within 30 feet of it using your modifiers. It chirps (audible 100 feet) the first time an Invisible creature other than you comes within 30 feet. The turret has AC 12, 30 Hit Points, Immunity to Poison and Psychic; at 0 it falls and can't redeploy for 1 minute. Retrieve it as a Bonus Action in its space.

magic-item:visage-of-delight-and-disaste.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature with Charisma 17 or higher
magic-item:visage-of-delight-and-disaste.description: While wearing it you gain two d10 Bardic Inspiration dice (regained on a Short or Long Rest), used like the bard feature. Delight (joyful performance): the recipient has Advantage on saves against Frightened for 1 minute and gains Temporary Hit Points equal to twice the die when it uses it. Disaster (grim performance): Advantage on saves against Charmed for 1 minute, and on a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit it can spend the die for extra Psychic damage equal to twice the roll.

magic-item:void-ammunition.description: It deals Psychic damage, makes no sound, leaves no wound, and vanishes after hitting or missing.

magic-item:volcanic-boots.description: While wearing them you have Fire Resistance. They have 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn. As you walk on solid ground, expend charges to make 5-foot Cubes in spaces you passed through scorching for 1 minute; other creatures entering or starting a turn in one make a DC 15 Dexterity save or take 2d6 Fire damage. Ends if you're Unconscious or as a Bonus Action.

magic-item:volt-gauntlets.description: Your fist Unarmed Strikes deal Piercing damage. They have 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn; on an Unarmed Strike hit, expend 1 for an extra 1d8 Lightning damage, and the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save or can't make Opportunity Attacks until its next turn.

magic-item:voltedge.description: It deals an extra 1d6 Lightning damage. Once per dawn as a Magic action, fire a 60-by-5-foot Line of lightning: DC 15 Dexterity save, 4d6 Lightning damage or half.

magic-item:vox-helm.description: With its mouthguard lowered, you can freely alter your voice's pitch, timbre, and reverberation; it sounds obviously enchanted.

magic-item:wand-of-whispers.description: A candle-shaped wand with a harmless flame (Bright Light 5 feet, Dim 5 more) lit or doused as a Bonus Action. It has 7 charges, regaining 1d6 + 1 at dusk (on the last, roll 1d20; on a 1 it becomes a mundane candle). Cast Message at will, Sending for 3 charges, or spend 1 charge per slot level to ignore Verbal components of a spell of level 5 or lower.

magic-item:war-standard-of-battlecries.description: A collapsible 10-foot standard extended as a Magic action, held or planted. While extended, you and allies within 15 feet at the start of combat gain +3 Initiative. It has 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn; within 15 feet, expend 1 and shout "Charge!" to Dash as a Bonus Action, and allies within 15 feet can Dash as a Bonus Action on their next turn. Restyle its emblem over 1 hour.

magic-item:warmind-wand.description: It has 7 charges, regaining 1d6 + 1 at dawn (on the last, roll 1d20; on a 1 it becomes a plain hilt). Forced Endurance: as a Reaction, 2 charges keep an ally within 30 feet who can perceive you at 1 Hit Point instead of 0 (once per Long Rest per ally). Form Ranks: 1 charge as a Magic action gives an ally 2d4 + 2 Temporary Hit Points and a Reaction to move half Speed without provoking. Unyielding Critical: as a Reaction, 1 charge adds 2d4 to an ally's Critical Hit damage. Warband Strike: replace one of your attacks and spend 1 so a willing ally makes one attack with its Reaction.

magic-item:wavebender-s-leiomano.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Once per dawn, cast Control Water (redirect flow only) while holding it. Each one used as an oar adds 5 feet (or 1/2 mile per hour) to a vessel's speed.

magic-item:weapon-of-mooring.description: A dense iron weapon with the Heavy property. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits reduce a Large or smaller creature's Speed by 5 feet until the end of its next turn.

magic-item:weapon-of-showmanship.description: When it reduces a Small or larger creature to 0 Hit Points or scores a Critical Hit, create a Prestidigitation-style flourish on or around the target.

magic-item:weapon-of-spite.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The bonus becomes +2 against a creature that damaged you since the end of your last turn.

magic-item:webgrip-rucksack.description: A spiderskin pack holding 8 cubic feet or 80 pounds whose web lining holds contents in place. Others have Disadvantage on Sleight of Hand to steal from it and on Strength checks to wrench it off you; it sticks to surfaces, and removing its straps takes a Magic action.

magic-item:wildman-s-spinning-cleaver.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a barbarian; handaxe
magic-item:wildman-s-spinning-cleaver.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It returns to your hand after a ranged attack. Once per turn while raging, a ranged attack with it can also target a second creature within 10 feet of the first (even beyond long range, rolled at the first target's range).

magic-item:windrazor.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the Finesse property and 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn: cast Heroism (1) or Wind Wall (3) at DC 17, +5. When you Attack, replace attacks with wind-blade ranged attacks against targets within 30 feet for 1 charge each. As a Reaction for 1 charge, attack a creature within 5 feet that damages you, or reduce a ranged attack's damage by 1d10 + 5, destroying a nonmagical projectile if reduced to 0.

magic-item:windswept-wyvernplate.description: Holding your breath removes its Stealth Disadvantage, and when you fall you can hold your breath as a Reaction to cast Feather Fall on yourself.

magic-item:winter-s-embrace.description: While wearing it you have Cold and Fire Resistance and ignore ice and snow Difficult Terrain. Once per dawn, cast Ice Storm (level 6 version, DC 16) centered within 5 feet of you; you're immune to it.

magic-item:wisplight-lantern.description: A fuel-free hooded lantern with adjustable blue light (Bright 5-20 feet plus equal Dim) set as a Bonus Action. It has 4 charges, regaining 1d3 + 1 at dusk. As a Magic action, expend 1 touching a Large or smaller non-Undead corpse to show an illusion of its last 6 seconds of action (once per corpse), or expend 1 with a command word to flash red if Undead are within 60 feet.

magic-item:wooden-chain-of-the-unbroken-.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a druid or ranger; chain shirt
magic-item:wooden-chain-of-the-unbroken-.description: A wooden chain shirt that adds your Wisdom modifier (maximum +2) to its AC; you count as trained with it.

magic-item:wyvernwing.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. As a Magic action expend 1 to fan it open: creatures in a 15-foot Cone, or all others within 5 feet, make a DC 15 Dexterity save, 2d6 Bludgeoning damage and pushed 10 feet, or half damage only.

magic-item:zafu-of-the-wandering-mind.description: After 1 minute settling in, you meditate on the pillows (able to chat but not act) and can levitate 5 feet; it ends if you take damage or leave them. Within 100 feet, stow them in a pocket dimension or recall them as a Bonus Action. They have 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; while meditating, expend 1 to cast Arcane Eye, which ends if your meditation does.

magic-item:abjurer-s-gilder.description: While wearing this badge, you always have Shield prepared if it's in your spellbook (not counting against your prepared spells). When hit by an attack roll or targeted by Magic Missile, you can take a special Reaction to cast Shield, separate from your normal Reaction but not on the same turn as it; once used, not again until the start of your next turn.

magic-item:acidlight-ammunition.description: On impact it ignites, shedding Bright Light in the target's space and Dim Light in a 5-foot Emanation for 1 minute. The target takes 1d4 Acid damage at the start of each of its turns, has Disadvantage on Stealth checks, and can't benefit from being Invisible while it stays lodged; a creature can remove it with a Utilize action. The ammunition is destroyed.

magic-item:aegis-of-radiance.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric; shield
magic-item:aegis-of-radiance.description: Its emblem becomes your deity's, letting you use it as a Holy Symbol, and it grants +1 AC on top of its normal bonus. Once per dawn as a Bonus Action with a command word, it shatters into shards of light that protect you as the Shield with your hands free for 1 minute (or until dismissed, or you're Unconscious or die), shedding Bright Light 20 feet and Dim Light 20 more; Undead have Disadvantage on attacks against you meanwhile.

magic-item:amulet-of-equilibrium.description: Usable as a Spellcasting Focus. It has 4 charges, regaining 2 at dawn and 1 whenever an enemy deals you Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage. When you deal Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage to only one creature, expend any number of charges to reroll that many damage dice, using the new rolls.

magic-item:arcane-mirror.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Reaction when hit by an attack, cast Shield from it. It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn: when you succeed on a save against a spell targeting only you or a spell attack misses you, as a Reaction learn the spell's level and expend that many charges (level 6 or lower) to reflect it; the caster makes a DC 16 Dexterity save, taking 1d8 Radiant damage per charge, or half on a success. Reflecting a half-on-save spell leaves you unharmed.

magic-item:arcanist-s-bowstaff.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a creature with Intelligence 17 or higher; quarterstaff
magic-item:arcanist-s-bowstaff.description: A quarterstaff you can telekinetically bend into a longbow (proficient, no Heavy property) that fires arrows of arcane energy. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon and can use Intelligence for them. It has 8 charges, regaining 1d6 + 2 at dawn; immediately after an attack roll with it as part of the Attack action, expend 1 to cast Magic Missile as a Bonus Action.

magic-item:architect-s-disdain.description: An adamantine war pick. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon, and its hits against objects and structures are Critical Hits. Once per dawn, when it hits a magically created object or structure, you can dispel it as Dispel Magic (level 6 version); this fails against effects from level 7+ slots.

magic-item:astral-bracelet.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a class listed for the bracelet's kind
magic-item:astral-bracelet.description: As a Magic action it unfolds into a spinning sphere with 10 charges (regaining 2d4 + 2 at dawn; it refolds when the last is spent). In sphere form, expend charges to cast its spells with your spellcasting ability and DC (costly components still required). Energy (sorcerer or wizard): Floating Disk 1, Dispel Magic 3, Hypnotic Pattern 3, Protection from Energy 3, Hallucinatory Terrain 4, Resilient Sphere 4, Globe of Invulnerability 6. Heavens (cleric or paladin): Detect Evil and Good 1, Protection from Evil and Good 1, Warding Bond 2, Magic Circle 3, Spirit Guardians 3, Divination 4, Dispel Evil and Good 5. Hells (cleric, warlock, or wizard): Detect Evil and Good 1, Hellish Rebuke 1, Protection from Evil and Good 1, Flaming Sphere 2, Magic Circle 3, Fire Shield 4, Dispel Evil and Good 5. Knowledge (bard, cleric, druid, ranger, or wizard): Comprehend Languages 1, Detect Magic 1, Identify 1, Locate Object 2, Dispel Magic 3, Sending 3, Locate Creature 4, Legend Lore 5. Planebending (sorcerer, warlock, or wizard): Find Familiar 1, Misty Step 2, Rope Trick 2, Sending 3, Banishment 4, Dimension Door 4, Plane Shift 7. Omniscience (wizard): Detect Magic 1, Detect Thoughts 2, See Invisibility 2, Sending 3, Arcane Eye 4, Scrying 5, Telepathic Bond 5.

magic-item:astral-sea-piercer.description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon, and hits deal an extra 1d4 Force damage; on the Astral Plane you always know the direction of the nearest portal. It has 4 charges, regaining 1d3 + 1 at dawn. As a Bonus Action, expend 1 to strike a flat surface and make a rift lasting 1 minute; a second rift within 300 feet opens a portal between them until the end of your next turn for Medium or smaller creatures. On a hit against a Small or larger creature, expend 1 for an extra 1d8 Force damage and attach a rift to it; when a portal opens, attached creatures make a DC 17 Charisma save (Large or larger succeed) or are shunted through.

magic-item:aurum-and-argentum.description: A gold and silver dagger pair. While holding one in each hand, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with these magic weapons, and you add your ability modifier to the Light extra attack's damage. Hitting the same target with both in a round deals an extra 1d4 Piercing damage and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the end of your turn.

magic-item:avian-circlet.description: While wearing it, cast Animal Messenger or Speak with Animals from it, affecting only creatures with a Fly Speed. Once per dawn as a Magic action, touch a willing flying Beast to see through its eyes (with its senses) for 1 minute.

magic-item:axe-beak-tomahawk.description: The first time each turn you hit a creature with a Fly Speed, it makes a DC 13 Strength save; each failure reduces its Fly Speed by 15 feet for 1 minute.

magic-item:bag-of-sundrops.description: Holds 1d6 + 4 sundrops. As a Magic action, throw one at a point within 30 feet to create a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder of sunlight (Bright Light) until the start of your next turn; Dispel Magic ends it.

magic-item:band-of-mirrored-essence.description: When you reduce a Small or larger enemy to 0 Hit Points, as a Reaction capture its essence (one at a time; once per 1d8 hours). As a Magic action, release it to either take on its appearance as an illusion (within one size of you; DC 16 Investigation reveals it; you understand its languages) or gain one of its skill or save proficiencies, Damage Resistances, Condition Immunities, special senses, languages, or water breathing, lasting 8 hours or until dismissed or you're Unconscious.

magic-item:bands-of-the-found-and-lost.description: Two bracelets with compasses; worn by different creatures, each points toward the other (no height or depth), spinning if they're on different planes.

condition:blinded.description:
While you have the Blinded condition, you experience the following effects.

Can't See. You can't see and automatically fail any ability check that requires sight.

Attacks Affected. Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage.

condition:charmed.description:
While you have the Charmed condition, you experience the following effects.

Can't Harm the Charmer. You can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with damaging abilities or magical effects.

Social Advantage. The charmer has Advantage on any ability check to interact with you socially.

condition:deafened.description:
While you have the Deafened condition, you experience the following effect.

Can't Hear. You can't hear and automatically fail any ability check that requires hearing.

condition:exhaustion.description:
While you have the Exhaustion condition, you experience the following effects.

Exhaustion Levels. This condition is cumulative. Each time you receive it, you gain 1 Exhaustion level. You die if your Exhaustion level is 6.

D20 Tests Affected. When you make a D20 Test, the roll is reduced by 2 times your Exhaustion level.

Speed Reduced. Your Speed is reduced by a number of feet equal to 5 times your Exhaustion level.

Removing Exhaustion Levels. Finishing a Long Rest removes 1 of your Exhaustion levels. When your Exhaustion level reaches 0, the condition ends.

condition:frightened.description:
While you have the Frightened condition, you experience the following effects.

Ability Checks and Attacks Affected. You have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is within line of sight.

Can't Approach. You can't willingly move closer to the source of fear.

condition:grappled.description:
While you have the Grappled condition, you experience the following effects.

Speed 0. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.

Attacks Affected. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than the grappler.

Movable. The grappler can drag or carry you when it moves, but every foot of movement costs it 1 extra foot unless you are Tiny or two or more sizes smaller than it.

condition:incapacitated.description:
While you have the Incapacitated condition, you experience the following effects.

Inactive. You can't take any action, Bonus Action, or Reaction.

No Concentration. Your Concentration is broken.

Speechless. You can't speak.

Surprised. If you're Incapacitated when you roll Initiative, you have Disadvantage on the roll.

condition:invisible.description:
While you have the Invisible condition, you experience the following effects.

Surprise. If you're Invisible when you roll Initiative, you have Advantage on the roll.

Concealed. You aren't affected by any effect that requires its target to be seen unless the effect's creator can somehow see you. Any equipment you are wearing or carrying is also concealed.

Attacks Affected. Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and your attack rolls have Advantage. If a creature can somehow see you, you don't gain this benefit against that creature.

condition:paralyzed.description:
While you have the Paralyzed condition, you experience the following effects.

Incapacitated. You have the Incapacitated condition.

Speed 0. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.

Saving Throws Affected. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.

Attacks Affected. Attack rolls against you have Advantage.

Automatic Critical Hits. Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.

condition:petrified.description:
While you have the Petrified condition, you experience the following effects.

Turned to Inanimate Substance. You are transformed, along with any nonmagical objects you are wearing and carrying, into a solid inanimate substance (usually stone). Your weight increases by a factor of ten, and you cease aging.

Incapacitated. You have the Incapacitated condition.

Speed 0. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.

Attacks Affected. Attack rolls against you have Advantage.

Saving Throws Affected. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.

Resist Damage. You have Resistance to all damage.

Poison Immunity. You have Immunity to the Poisoned condition.

condition:poisoned.description:
While you have the Poisoned condition, you experience the following effect.

Ability Checks and Attacks Affected. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

condition:prone.description:
While you have the Prone condition, you experience the following effects.

Restricted Movement. Your only movement options are to crawl or to spend an amount of movement equal to half your Speed (round down) to right yourself and thereby end the condition. If your Speed is 0, you can't right yourself.

Attacks Affected. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls. An attack roll against you has Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet of you. Otherwise, that attack roll has Disadvantage.

condition:restrained.description:
While you have the Restrained condition, you experience the following effects.

Speed 0. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.

Attacks Affected. Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage.

Saving Throws Affected. You have Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

condition:stunned.description:
While you have the Stunned condition, you experience the following effects.

Incapacitated. You have the Incapacitated condition.

Saving Throws Affected. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.

Attacks Affected. Attack rolls against you have Advantage.

condition:unconscious.description:
While you have the Unconscious condition, you experience the following effects.

Inert. You have the Incapacitated and Prone conditions, and you drop whatever you're holding. When this condition ends, you remain Prone.

Speed 0. Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.

Attacks Affected. Attack rolls against you have Advantage.

Saving Throws Affected. You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.

Automatic Critical Hits. Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.

Unaware. You're unaware of your surroundings.

feat:aberrant-anatomy.description: Exposure to alien horrors like those of the Far Realm has warped your physical form in supernatural ways. You gain the following features. Breathless. You can hold your breath for 1 hour. Extrasensory Perception. You have proficiency in the Perception skill, if you lack it. You also gain Expertise in that skill. In addition, you have Blindsight with a range of 15 feet. Warping Flesh. Immediately after you make a D20 Test and roll a 1 on the d20, the aberrant influence infecting your form flares, wrenching control of your flesh. Make a Constitution saving throw (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, you have the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn.

feat:aberrant-dragonmark.prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can’t Have Another Dragonmark Feat
feat:aberrant-dragonmark.description: Aberrant Fortitude. When you fail a Constitution saving throw, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the save, potentially turning the failure into a success. Once you’ve used this benefit, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest. Aberrant Magic. You know one cantrip of your choice from the Sorcerer spell list. Also, choose a level 1 spell from that spell list. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Short or Long Rest. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for this spell. Aberrant Surge. When you cast the level 1 spell from this feat, you can expend one of your Hit Point Dice and roll it. If you roll an even number, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the number rolled. If you roll an odd number, one creature within 30 feet of you (not including you) takes Force damage equal to the number rolled. If no other creatures are in range, you take the damage.

feat:ability-score-improvement.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. This feat can’t increase an ability score above 20. Repeatable. You can take this feat more than once.

feat:abjuration-adept.prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
feat:abjuration-adept.description: Ability Score Increase. +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). Additional Spells. Always prepared once you have slots of that level: Shield (1), Lesser Restoration (2), Protection from Energy (3), Banishment (4), Mass Cure Wounds (5). Protective Ward. When you cast an Abjuration spell with a slot, you or a creature within 30 feet gains Temporary Hit Points equal to twice the slot level.

feat:actor.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Impersonation. While you’re disguised as a real or fictional person, you have Advantage on Charisma (Deception or Performance) checks to convince others that you are that person. Mimicry. You can mimic the sounds of other creatures, including speech. A creature that hears the mimicry must succeed on a Wisdom (Insight) check to determine the effect is faked (DC 8 plus your Charisma modifier and Proficiency Bonus).

feat:adept-of-the-white-robes.prerequisite: 4th level, Initiate of High Sorcery (Solinari) feat
feat:adept-of-the-white-robes.description: Protective Magic: learn one 2nd-level abjuration or divination spell, castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots, using your Initiate of High Sorcery ability. Protective Ward: when you or a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, use your reaction and expend a spell slot to reduce the damage by d6s equal to the slot's level plus your spellcasting modifier.

feat:agent-of-order.prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes (Lawful) feat
feat:agent-of-order.description: +1 to one ability score (max 20). Stasis Strike: once per turn when you damage a creature you can see within 60 feet, deal an extra 1d8 force and it makes a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + your Scion spellcasting modifier) or is restrained until the start of your next turn. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:alert.description: Initiative Proficiency. When you roll Initiative, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll. Initiative Swap. Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat. You can’t make this swap if you or the ally has the Incapacitated condition.

feat:arcane-artist.description: Cantrip. Learn Minor Illusion (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, chosen with the feat). Inspiring Magic. Once per Long Rest, when you cast an Illusion spell, one ally within 30 feet who can see you gains Heroic Inspiration.

feat:arcane-eloquence.description: Cantrip. Learn Vicious Mockery (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, chosen with the feat). Smooth Talker. Add 1d4 to Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion) checks.

feat:arcane-infiltrator.description: Cantrip. Learn Friends (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, chosen with the feat). Cunning Diversion. Take the Dodge action as a Bonus Action, Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

feat:arcane-infiltrator-dmls.description: Cantrip. You learn the Friends cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). Cunning Diversion. You can take the Dodge action as a Bonus Action. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

feat:arcane-omens.description: Cantrip. Learn Guidance (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, chosen with the feat). Helpful Premonition. Reaction when you or a creature within 30 feet fails a save: add 1d4 to it, possibly turning it into a success. Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

feat:arcane-overload.description: Cantrip. Learn Fire Bolt (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, chosen with the feat). Power Surge. Once per Long Rest, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll of an Evocation spell.

feat:arcane-safeguard.description: Cantrip. Learn Resistance (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, chosen with the feat), and cast it as a Bonus Action Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. Sheltering Aid. When you Help an ally's ability check, they gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

feat:arcane-undertaker.description: Cantrip. Learn one Cleric or Wizard Necromancy cantrip (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, chosen with the feat). Knowledge from the Dead. Add 1d4 to Intelligence (History) and Wisdom (Medicine) checks. Understanding of Death. Once per Long Rest, stabilizing a creature at 0 HP with the Help action gives you Heroic Inspiration.

feat:arcane-warrior.description: Learn two Wizard cantrips (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, chosen with the feat). Each time you gain a level, you can swap one for another Wizard cantrip.

feat:archery.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.

feat:artificer-initiate.description: Learn basic spells from the Artificer class Buff, Utility You’ve learned some of an artificer’s inventiveness: You learn one cantrip of your choice from the artificer spell list, and you learn one 1st-level spell of your choice from that list. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells. You can cast this feat’s 1st-level spell without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have. You gain proficiency with one type of artisan’s tools of your choice, and you can use that type of tool as a spellcasting focus for any spell you cast that uses Intelligence as its spellcasting ability.

feat:athlete.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Climb Speed. You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed. Hop Up. When you have the Prone condition, you can right yourself with only 5 feet of movement. Jumping. You can make a running Long or High Jump after moving only 5 feet.

feat:baleful-scion.prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes (Evil) feat
feat:baleful-scion.description: +1 to one ability score (max 20). Grasp of Avarice: once per turn when you damage a creature you can see within 60 feet, deal an extra 1d6 + proficiency bonus necrotic and regain that many HP. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:blind-fighting.description: You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.

feat:bloodlust.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Powerful Recovery. When you roll a Hit Point Die to regain Hit Points, you can treat any roll of 1 or 2 as a 3. Sanguine Feast. Once per turn when you hit a Bloodied creature that isn’t a Construct or Undead with an attack roll, you can expend a Hit Point Die, roll it, and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the number rolled plus your Constitution modifier. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

feat:bomber.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Far Lobber. When you use the Attack action to throw a vial or flask, you can target an object or creature you can see within 40 feet of yourself. Long Shots. Attacking at long range doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with Thrown weapons.

feat:boon-of-blazing-dawn.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Beloved of the Sun. You have Immunity to Radiant damage. Blazing Strike. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, the damage can be Radiant or the weapon’s normal damage type (your choice). Burst of Sunlight. Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Radiant damage, you can emit Bright Light in a 30-foot radius from yourself and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet until the start of your next turn. This light is sunlight.

feat:boon-of-bloodshed.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Killer's Fortune. When an enemy you can see is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you gain Advantage on the next attack roll you make before the end of your next turn. Power from Pain. Once per turn, when you make an attack roll while Bloodied, you can deal extra damage to the target equal to your Proficiency Bonus. The extra damage's type is the same as the attack's type.

feat:boon-of-bountiful-health.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Augmented Health. When you gain Temporary Hit Points, increase the number of Temporary Hit Points you gain by 5. Superior Recuperation. When you spend one or more Hit Point Dice to regain Hit Points, you can instead use the highest number possible for each die.

feat:boon-of-combat-prowess.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Peerless Aim. When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until the start of your next turn.

feat:boon-of-communication.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Cunning Speaker. You don't have Disadvantage on ability checks to influence Hostile creatures. Gifted Interpreter. You understand the literal meaning of any language you hear or see signed, and you can understand the literal meaning of any written language you see. Mental Communication. You gain telepathy with a range of 120 feet.

feat:boon-of-desperate-resilience.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Defense of Body and Mind. While you are Bloodied, you have Resistance to every damage type except Force.

feat:boon-of-dimensional-travel.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Blink Steps. Immediately after you take the Attack action or the Magic action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

feat:boon-of-energy-resistance.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Energy Resistances. You gain Resistance to two of the following damage types of your choice: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your choices. Energy Redirection. When you take damage of one of the types chosen for the Energy Resistances benefit, you can take a Reaction to direct damage of the same type toward another creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself that isn’t behind Total Cover. If you do so, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or take damage equal to 2d12 plus your Constitution modifier.

feat:boon-of-erupting-spellpower.prerequisite: Level 19+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
feat:boon-of-erupting-spellpower.description: Ability Score Increase. +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 30). Spell Overload. When a slot-cast spell deals damage, treat 1s and 2s on its damage dice as 3s and knock every creature it damaged Prone. Recharges when you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

feat:boon-of-exquisite-radiance.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Eternal Rest. Creatures you reduce to 0 Hit Points can't become Undead. Powerful Radiance. When you make a damage roll that deals Radiant damage, you can instead use the highest number possible for each damage die. Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

feat:boon-of-fate.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Improve Fate. When you or another creature within 60 feet of you succeeds on or fails a D20 Test, you can roll 2d4 and apply the total rolled as a bonus or penalty to the d20 roll. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

feat:boon-of-fluid-forms.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Shapechanger. You can take a Magic action to shape-shift into a Beast, Humanoid, or Monstrosity with a Challenge Rating no higher than 10. When you shape-shift, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the form. The shape-shifting effect lasts for 1 hour, and it ends early if you have no Temporary Hit Points left or if you take a Magic action to return to your true form. Your game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen form, but you retain your creature type; alignment; personality; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points; Hit Point Dice; proficiencies; and ability to communicate. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature, you retain it too. Upon shape-shifting, you determine whether your equipment drops to the ground or changes in size and shape to fit the new form while you’re in it. Once you use this benefit, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest. Hardy Transformation. When you gain Temporary Hit Points when you shape-shift, increase that number of Temporary Hit Points by 20.

feat:boon-of-fortitude.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Fortified Health. Your Hit Point maximum increases by 40. In addition, whenever you regain Hit Points, you can regain additional Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier. Once you’ve regained these additional Hit Points, you can’t do so again until the start of your next turn.

feat:boon-of-fortune-s-favor.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Saving Throw Reroll. When you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it and must use the new roll. Once you use this benefit, you can’t do so again until the start of your next turn.

feat:boon-of-irresistible-offense.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Overcome Defenses. The Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you deal always ignores Resistance. Overwhelming Strike. When you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack roll, you can deal extra damage to the target equal to the ability score increased by this feat. The extra damage’s type is the same as the attack’s type.

feat:boon-of-looming-shadows.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Shadowy Stretch. When you take the Attack action, your reach for your Melee weapon attacks increases by 10 feet until the end of your turn. Dancing Silhouette. You can take the Dodge action as a Bonus Action.

feat:boon-of-magic-school-mastery.prerequisite: Level 19+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
feat:boon-of-magic-school-mastery.description: Ability Score Increase. +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 30). Mastered School. Pick a school. Rote Casting: a level 1 spell of that school from your class list is always prepared and castable with no slot or components. Signature Arcanum: a level 7 or lower spell of that school is always prepared and castable free once per Long Rest. Repeatable with a different school.

feat:boon-of-misty-escape.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Gaseous Form. If you drop to 0 Hit Points but aren’t killed outright, you can instead drop to 1 Hit Point and cast Gaseous Form without expending a spell slot (no action required). When you cast this spell this way, you can target only yourself, your Fly Speed is 20 feet, and you regain 10 Hit Points at the start of each of your turns for the spell’s duration. The spell’s spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat. Once you use this benefit, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

feat:boon-of-poison-mastery.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Antitoxic. You have Immunity to Poison damage and the Poisoned condition. Perfect Poisoner. Once per turn, when you roll dice to determine Poison damage a creature takes from your attack, spell, or feature, you can instead use the highest number possible for each die.

feat:boon-of-recovery.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Last Stand. When you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead and regain a number of Hit Points equal to half your Hit Point maximum. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest. Recover Vitality. You have a pool of ten d10s. As a Bonus Action, you can expend dice from the pool, roll those dice, and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll’s total. You regain all the expended dice when you finish a Long Rest.

feat:boon-of-revelry.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Inspire Dance. You always have the Otto’s Irresistible Dance spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. When you cast the spell, it requires no spell components, and taking damage doesn’t break your Concentration on it. Sing Out. While a creature that failed its saving throw against your Otto’s Irresistible Dance has the Charmed condition from that spell, it can’t cast spells with Verbal components, and it sings delightful nonsense if it can sing.

feat:boon-of-siberys.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Aberrant Magic. Choose a Sorcerer spell of level 8 or lower or a Siberys dragonmark spell (Animal Shapes, Control Weather, Demiplane, Heroes' Feast, Maze, Mind Blank, Plane Shift, Project Image, Regenerate, Symbol, Teleport or True Seeing). It is always prepared, and you can cast it once per Short or Long Rest without a slot or components, or with slots of its level. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is the spellcasting ability (chosen with this feat).

feat:boon-of-siberys-dragonmark-spell.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Aberrant Magic. Choose a spell from the Siberys Dragonmark Spells table (the table includes dragonmark suggestions if you’d like to associate a spell with one of the marks). You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot or spell components, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Short or Long Rest. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you gain this feat). Siberys Dragonmark Spells

feat:boon-of-siberys-sorcerer-spell.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Aberrant Magic. Choose a level 8 or lower spell from the Sorcerer spell list or a spell from the Siberys Dragonmark Spells table (the table includes dragonmark suggestions if you’d like to associate a spell with one of the marks). You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot or spell components, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Short or Long Rest. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you gain this feat).

feat:boon-of-skill.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. All-Around Adept. You gain proficiency in all skills. Expertise. Choose one skill in which you lack Expertise. You gain Expertise in that skill.

feat:boon-of-speed.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Escape Artist. As a Bonus Action, you can take the Disengage action, which also ends the Grappled condition on you. Quickness. Your Speed increases by 30 feet.

feat:boon-of-spell-recall.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Free Casting. Whenever you cast a spell with a level 1–4 spell slot, roll 1d4. If the number you roll is the same as the slot’s level, the slot isn’t expended.

feat:boon-of-terror.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Fearless. You have Immunity to the Frightened condition. Flee, Fools! When a creature with the Frightened condition starts its turn within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to stoke its terror, provided you can see the creature and it isn’t behind Total Cover. If you do so, the creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Charisma modifier and your Proficiency Bonus) or spend its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. Intimidating. You gain Proficiency in the Intimidation skill if you don’t already have it. You also gain Expertise in Intimidation.

feat:boon-of-truesight.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Truesight. You have Truesight with a range of 60 feet.

feat:boon-of-the-bright-sun.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Constitution, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Daylight Presence. As a Bonus Action, you radiate a 30-foot Emanation of Bright Light that is sunlight. If any of the Emanation’s area overlaps with an area of Darkness created by a spell, that spell is dispelled. The Emanation lasts until you dismiss it (no action required), die, or have the Incapacitated condition. Fortifying Light. When your Daylight Presence is active, at the start of each of your turns, you and allies you can see in your Daylight Presence gain 10 Temporary Hit Points.

feat:boon-of-the-furious-storm.prerequisite: Level 19+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
feat:boon-of-the-furious-storm.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Eye of the Storm. You have Resistance to Lightning and Thunder damage. While you are Bloodied, you have Immunity to Lightning and Thunder damage. Storm's Strength. Creatures have Disadvantage on saving throws against your spells that deal Lightning or Thunder damage.

feat:boon-of-the-iron-mind.description: Ability Score Increase. +1 to any ability (max 30). Unshakable Focus. You lose Concentration only by starting another Concentration effect, becoming Petrified or Unconscious, or dying.

feat:boon-of-the-night-spirit.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Merge with Shadows. While within Dim Light or Darkness, you can give yourself the Invisible condition as a Bonus Action. The condition ends on you immediately after you take an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction. Shadowy Form. While within Dim Light or Darkness, you have Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant.

feat:boon-of-the-soul-drinker.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Grave Resistance. You have Resistance to Cold damage and Necrotic damage. Siphon Life. When an enemy within 120 feet of you is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you can take a Reaction to regain 50 Hit Points. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

feat:bountiful-luck.description: Allow Allies to Reroll a 1 on Attack Rolls, Ability Checks, or Saving Throws Buff, Species Feat Prerequisite: Halfling Your people have extraordinary luck, which you have learned to mystically lend to your companions when you see them falter. You’re not sure how you do it; you just wish it, and it happens. Surely a sign of fortune’s favor! When an ally you can see within 30 feet of you rolls a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to let the ally reroll the die. The ally must use the new roll. When you use this ability, you can’t use your Lucky racial trait before the end of your next turn.

feat:cartomancer.description: You have learned to channel your magic through a deck of cards Utility, Combat, Deception Prerequisite: 4th Level, Spellcasting Feature You have learned to channel your magic through a deck of cards. You can use a card deck as your spellcasting focus, and you gain the following benefits: Card Tricks. You learn the Prestidigitation cantrip and can use it to create illusions that duplicate the effects of stage magic. When you use Prestidigitation in this way, you can conceal the verbal and somatic components of the spell as ordinary conversation and card handling. Hidden Ace. When you finish a long rest, you can choose one spell from your class’s spell list and imbue that spell into a card. The chosen spell must have a casting time of 1 action, and it must be a level for which you have spell slots. The card remains imbued with this spell for 8 hours. While the card is imbued with the spell, you can use a bonus action to flourish the card and cast the spell within. The card then immediately loses its magic.

feat:charger.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Improved Dash. When you take the Dash action, your Speed increases by 10 feet for that action. Charge Attack. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line toward a target immediately before hitting it with a melee attack roll as part of the Attack action, choose one of the following effects: gain a 1d8 bonus to the attack’s damage roll, or push the target up to 10 feet away if it is no more than one size larger than you. You can use this benefit only once on each of your turns.

feat:chef.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Cook’s Utensils. You gain proficiency with Cook’s Utensils if you don’t already have it. Replenishing Meal. As part of a Short Rest, you can cook special food if you have ingredients and Cook’s Utensils on hand. You can prepare enough of this food for a number of creatures equal to 4 plus your Proficiency Bonus. At the end of the Short Rest, any creature who eats the food and spends one or more Hit Dice to regain Hit Points regains an extra 1d8 Hit Points. Bolstering Treats. With 1 hour of work or when you finish a Long Rest, you can cook a number of treats equal to your Proficiency Bonus if you have ingredients and Cook’s Utensils on hand. These special treats last 8 hours after being made. A creature can use a Bonus Action to eat one of those treats to gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

feat:child-of-the-sun.description: Eyes of Eirdu. You and allies within 10 feet of you have Advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Blinded condition. Faerie Fire. You learn the Faerie Fire spell. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have. When you cast Faerie Fire without a spell slot using this benefit, taking damage can’t break your Concentration on the spell.

feat:cloying-mists.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Arise, Fog. You always have the Fog Cloud spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat. Grasping Mist. Whenever you cast Fog Cloud, nonmagical flames in the spell’s Sphere are extinguished, and creatures other than you and your allies have their Speed reduced by 5 feet while in the spell’s Sphere.

feat:cohort-of-chaos.prerequisite: 4th level, Scion of the Outer Planes (Chaotic) feat
feat:cohort-of-chaos.description: +1 to one ability score (max 20). Chaotic Flare: when you roll a 1 or 20 on an attack roll or save, roll a d4 for a flare lasting until the end of your next turn (one at a time). 1 Battle Fury: a creature you can see has advantage on attacks and disadvantage on ability checks. 2 Disruption Field: creatures starting their turn within 5 feet of you or first entering that area on a turn take 1d8 force. 3 Unbound: you can spend movement to teleport that far to an unoccupied space you can see, once. 4 Wailing Winds: creatures within 15 feet of you, you included, have disadvantage on Wisdom saves.

feat:cold-caster.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Cantrip. You learn the Ray of Frost cantrip. If you already know it, you learn a different Wizard cantrip of your choice. The spell’s spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat. Frostbite. Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll and deal Cold damage, you can temporarily negate the creature’s defenses. The creature subtracts 1d4 from the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn.

feat:conjuration-adept.prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
feat:conjuration-adept.description: Ability Score Increase. +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). Additional Spells. Always prepared once you have slots of that level: Entangle (1), Misty Step (2), Conjure Animals (3), Dimension Door (4), Conjure Elemental (5). Persistent Conjuration. Add the increased ability's modifier to Constitution saves to keep Concentration on Conjuration spells.

feat:crafter.description: Tool Proficiency. You gain proficiency with three different Artisan’s Tools of your choice from the Fast Crafting table. Discount. Whenever you buy a nonmagical item, you receive a 20 percent discount on it. Fast Crafting. When you finish a Long Rest, you can craft one piece of gear from the Fast Crafting table, provided you have the Artisan’s Tools associated with that item and have proficiency with those tools. The item lasts until you finish another Long Rest, at which point the item falls apart. Fast Crafting

feat:crossbow-expert.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Ignore Loading. You ignore the Loading property of the Hand Crossbow, Heavy Crossbow, and Light Crossbow (all called crossbows elsewhere in this feat). If you’re holding one of them, you can load a piece of ammunition into it even if you lack a free hand. Firing in Melee. Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with crossbows. Dual Wielding. When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the extra attack if that attack is with a crossbow that has the Light property and you aren’t already adding that modifier to the damage.

feat:crusher.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Push.
