Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you takes the Disengage action or hits a target other than you with an attack, you can make an Opportunity Attack against that creature. Halt. When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, the creature’s Speed becomes 0 for the rest of the current turn.

feat:shadow-touched.description: Your exposure to the Shadowfell’s magic grants you the following benefits. Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Shadow Magic. Choose one level 1 spell from the Illusion or Necromancy school of magic. You always have that spell and the Invisibility spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this way, you can’t cast that spell in this way again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells’ spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

feat:shadowmoor-hexer.description: Hex. You always have the Hex spell prepared. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have. Curse Magic. When a creature that you’ve cursed with Hex hits you with an attack roll, the creature takes Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. A creature takes this damage only once per turn.

feat:sharp-eye.description: When you take the Search or Study action, you can give yourself Advantage on any ability check made as part of that action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. If the check fails, the use of this feature isn’t expended.

feat:sharpshooter.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Bypass Cover. Your ranged attacks with weapons ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover. Firing in Melee. Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons. Long Shots. Attacking at long range doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

feat:shield-master.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Shield Bash. If you attack a creature within 5 feet of you as part of the Attack action and hit with a Melee weapon, you can immediately bash the target with your Shield if it’s equipped, forcing the target to make a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, you either push the target 5 feet from you or cause it to have the Prone condition (your choice). You can use this benefit only once on each of your turns. Interpose Shield. If you’re subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you can take a Reaction to take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and are holding a Shield.

feat:shifting-combatant.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Domino Strike. When you hit a creature with a weapon and activate the Push mastery property to push that creature into a space occupied by a Large or smaller creature, you can force the creatures to collide. Each creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat and your Proficiency Bonus) or have the Prone condition. Fearless Leap. When you make a Long Jump, moving at least 10 feet immediately before the jump, and land in a space within 5 feet of two or more enemies, attack rolls made against you have Disadvantage until the start of your next turn.

feat:skill-expert.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20. Skill Proficiency. You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice. Expertise. Choose one skill in which you have proficiency but lack Expertise. You gain Expertise with that skill.

feat:skilled.description: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice. Repeatable. You can take this feat more than once.

feat:skulker.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Blindsight. You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet. Fog of War. You exploit the distractions of battle, gaining Advantage on any Dexterity (Stealth) check you make as part of the Hide action during combat. Sniper. If you make an attack roll while hidden and the roll misses, making the attack roll doesn't reveal your location.

feat:slasher.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Hamstring. Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Slashing damage, you can reduce the Speed of that creature by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Enhanced Critical. When you score a Critical Hit that deals Slashing damage to a creature, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

feat:soothing-familiar.description: Ability Score Increase. +1 to any ability (max 20). Healing Beacon. While your familiar is within 120 feet of you, allies within 5 feet of it treat 1s and 2s on healing dice as 3s.

feat:soul-of-the-storm-giant.prerequisite: 4th level, Strike of the Giants (Storm Strike) feat
feat:soul-of-the-storm-giant.description: +1 Strength, Wisdom or Charisma (max 20). Maelstrom Aura: as a bonus action, a 10-foot aura surrounds you until the start of your next turn (or until incapacitated): you resist lightning and thunder, attacks against you have disadvantage, and a creature starting its turn in it can be forced to make a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + the raised ability's modifier) or have half speed until the start of its next turn. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:speedy.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Speed Increase. Your Speed increases by 10 feet. Dash over Difficult Terrain. When you take the Dash action on your turn, Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement for the rest of that turn. Agile Movement. Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.

feat:spell-resistant.description: Ability Score Increase. +1 Dexterity or Constitution (max 20). Magical Resilience. Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder (choose one). Magic Resistant. When you would fail a save against a spell or magical effect, add 1d6, possibly turning it into a success; Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

feat:spell-sniper.prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
feat:spell-sniper.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Bypass Cover. Your attack rolls for spells ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover. Casting in Melee. Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with spells. Increased Range. When you cast a spell that has a range of at least 10 feet and requires you to make an attack roll, you can increase the spell’s range by 60 feet.

feat:spell-subterfuge.prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
feat:spell-subterfuge.description: Ability Score Increase. +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). Shrouding Spells. After casting an action spell with a slot, take Dash and Hide together as a Bonus Action; uses equal to the increased ability's modifier per Long Rest. Sneaky Casting. Verbal components and spell attacks don't end your Hide-granted Invisible condition if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters or Total Cover.

feat:spellfire-adept.prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellfire Spark Feat or the Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
feat:spellfire-adept.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Fueled Spellfire. Once per turn, when a spell you cast deals Radiant damage, you can expend up to two Hit Point Dice, roll them, and add the total rolled to one damage roll of the spell. Searing Spellfire. When you make a damage roll that deals Radiant damage, it ignores Resistance to Radiant damage.

feat:spellfire-spark.description: Magic Absorption. Once per turn, when you take damage from a spell or magical effect, you reduce the total damage taken by 1d4. You can’t use this benefit if you have the Incapacitated condition. Spellfire Flame. You learn the Sacred Flame cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). You can also cast this cantrip as a Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

feat:squat-nimbleness.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity, +5 ft. Speed, Acrobatics or Athletics proficiency Buff, Movement, Species Feat Prerequisite: Dwarf or a Small race You are uncommonly nimble for your race. You gain the following benefits: Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Increase your walking speed by 5 feet. You gain proficiency in the Acrobatics or Athletics skill (your choice). You have advantage on any Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check you make to escape from being grappled.

feat:squire-of-solamnia.prerequisite: Dragonlance Campaign, Fighter or Paladin class or Knight of Solamnia background
feat:squire-of-solamnia.description: Mount Up: mounting or dismounting costs only 5 feet of movement. Precise Strike: once per turn, give a weapon attack roll against a creature advantage; on a hit add 1d8 to the damage. Proficiency bonus uses per long rest, spent only on a hit.

feat:street-justice.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Headlock. Your allies have Advantage on attack rolls against a creature Grappled by you. Sturdy Knot. When you use Chain, Manacles, or Rope to bind a creature, add your Proficiency Bonus to the DC to escape or burst the Chain, Manacles, or Rope. Tough Talk. A creature’s Hostile attitude doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your Charisma (Intimidation) checks to influence that creature.

feat:strike-of-the-giants.prerequisite: Martial weapon proficiency or Giant Foundling background
feat:strike-of-the-giants.description: Choose one strike. Once per turn when you hit with a melee or thrown weapon attack, add its effect (save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Str or Con modifier); proficiency bonus uses per long rest. Cloud: +1d4 thunder, and on a failed Wis save you are invisible to the creature until the start of your next turn or until you attack or cast. Fire: +1d10 fire. Frost: +1d6 cold, and on a failed Con save its speed is 0 until the start of your next turn. Hill: +1d6 of the weapon's type, and on a failed Str save it falls prone. Stone: +1d6 force, and on a failed Str save it is pushed 10 feet. Storm: +1d6 lightning, and on a failed Con save it has disadvantage on attacks until the start of your next turn.

feat:survivor.description: Hypervigilance. Whenever you roll Initiative, you can reroll the d20 if the number rolled is 9 or lower. You must use the new roll. Steel Yourself. When you fail a saving throw to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened condition, you can take a Reaction to add a bonus to the roll, potentially causing it to succeed. The bonus is equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Once you take this Reaction, you can’t do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

feat:symbiotic-being.description: A second being lives inside you, aiding you while pursuing its own agenda. Entwined Existence. The symbiote can't be targeted; it dies if you die and revives if you are revived. Second Mind. Gain proficiency in Arcana, Deception, History, Intimidation, Insight, Investigation, Nature, Religion, Perception or Persuasion, and learn one language. Sustained Symbiosis. When you fail a saving throw, take a Reaction and expend a Hit Die, adding its roll to the save. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest. Symbiotic Agenda. Immediately after you roll a 1 on a D20 Test, make a Charisma save (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus). On a failure you are Charmed for 1d12 hours and must further the symbiote's goals as the DM decides; repeat the save whenever you take damage. The DM may also call for this save when you act against the symbiote's agenda.

feat:tactical-combatant.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Buffering Strike. When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the total number rolled on the weapon’s damage dice. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest. Honed Instincts. When you fail an ability check, you can roll 1d6 and add the number rolled to the ability check, potentially turning it into a success. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

feat:tavern-brawler.description: Enhanced Unarmed Strike. When you hit with your Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage of an Unarmed Strike. Damage Rerolls. Whenever you roll a damage die for your Unarmed Strike, you can reroll the die if it rolls a 1, and you must use the new roll. Improvised Weaponry. You have proficiency with improvised weapons. Push. When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can deal damage to the target and also push it 5 feet away from you. You can use this benefit only once per turn.

feat:telekinetic.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Minor Telekinesis. You learn the Mage Hand spell. You can cast it without Verbal or Somatic components, you can make the spectral hand Invisible, and its range and the distance it can be away from you both increase by 30 feet when you cast it. The spell’s spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat. Telekinetic Shove. As a Bonus Action, you can telekinetically shove one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. When you do so, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat and your Proficiency Bonus) or be moved 5 feet toward or away from you.

feat:telepathic.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Telepathic Utterance. You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Your telepathic utterances are in a language you know, and the creature understands you only if it knows that language. Your communication doesn’t give the creature the ability to respond to you telepathically. Detect Thoughts. You always have the Detect Thoughts spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot or spell components, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat.

feat:thrown-weapon-fighting.description: When you hit with a ranged attack roll using a weapon that has the Thrown property, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

feat:tireless-reveler.description: When an ally you can see within 60 feet of yourself expends Heroic Inspiration, you can gain Heroic Inspiration if you lack it. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

feat:touch-of-death.description: Deathly power resides within you, bursting out at the slightest provocation. You gain the following features. Death Touch. You learn the Chill Touch spell and can cast it without spell components. Necrotic damage you deal with this spell ignores Resistance. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). Pull of the Grave. You have Disadvantage on Death Saving Throws.

feat:tough.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your character level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a character level thereafter, your Hit Point maximum increases by an additional 2 Hit Points.

feat:transmutation-adept.prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
feat:transmutation-adept.description: Ability Score Increase. +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). Additional Spells. Always prepared once you have slots of that level: Jump (1), Spider Climb (2), Slow (3), Polymorph (4), Animate Objects (5). Magical Augmentation. When you cast a Transmutation spell with a slot on your turn, gain Speed equal to 5 times the slot level until the turn ends.

feat:transmutation-adept-dmau.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Enchanting Presence. You always have the Charm Person spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast it using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat. Inevitable Betrayal. You have Advantage on attack rolls against creatures with the Charmed condition.

feat:transmuted-anatomy.description: Lengthened Stride. Speed +5 feet. Resilient Anatomy. Advantage on saves against being forcibly shape-shifted. When you fail a Constitution save, use a Reaction to add 1d4, possibly turning it into a success; Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

feat:two-weapon-fighting.description: When you make an extra attack as a result of using a weapon that has the Light property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack if you aren’t already adding it to the damage.

feat:tyro-of-the-gauntlet.description: Stand as One. When an ally within 5 feet of you is subjected to an effect that would push or pull it, you can take a Reaction to prevent that ally from being pushed or pulled. To receive this benefit, the ally can’t have the Incapacitated condition. Vigilant. When you take the Ready action, the next attack roll made against you has Disadvantage before the start of your next turn.

feat:unarmed-fighting.description: When you hit with your Unarmed Strike and deal damage, you can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to 1d6 plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage of an Unarmed Strike. If you aren’t holding any weapons or a Shield when you make the attack roll, the d6 becomes a d8. At the start of each of your turns, you can deal 1d4 Bludgeoning damage to one creature Grappled by you.

feat:vampire-hunter.description: Adroit Escape. You have Advantage on checks to escape from nonmagical restraints or the Grappled condition. Vitality Ward. When you take Necrotic damage, you can take a Reaction to mitigate the damage. Roll a number of d6s equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and add them together. Reduce the Necrotic damage you take by this total. Once you use this benefit, you can’t use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

feat:vampire-touched.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Vampire Magic. Choose one level 1 spell from the Enchantment or Illusion school of magic. You always have that spell and the Spider Climb spell prepared. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot, but when you cast Spider Climb this way, you must target yourself, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast each spell in this way again. You can also cast either spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Your spellcasting ability for the spells is the ability increased by this feat.

feat:vampire-s-plaything.description: Decanting. When you finish a Long Rest, you can create one Potion of Healing or an Antitoxin, as long as you have an empty vial or flask. These liquids evaporate when you finish another Long Rest. Timely Retreat. You can take a Bonus Action to take the Dash action or the Disengage action. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you recover all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. Vampiric Connection. The DM determines the fate of your former vampire master. While you and your former vampire master are on the same plane of existence, the vampire can communicate with you telepathically, and you can choose to allow the vampire to perceive through your senses.

feat:vigor-of-the-hill-giant.prerequisite: 4th level, Strike of the Giants (Hill Strike) feat
feat:vigor-of-the-hill-giant.description: +1 Strength, Constitution or Wisdom (max 20). Bulwark: when an effect would move you 5 feet or more or knock you prone, use your reaction to stay put and standing. Iron Stomach: when you eat during a short rest and spend Hit Dice, regain extra HP equal to your Constitution modifier + proficiency bonus.

feat:war-caster.prerequisite: Level 4+ Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature
feat:war-caster.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Concentration. You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain Concentration. Reactive Spell. When a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack from you by leaving your reach, you can take a Reaction to cast a spell at the creature rather than making an Opportunity Attack. The spell must have a casting time of one action and must target only that creature. Somatic Components. You can perform the Somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a Shield in one or both hands.

feat:warlike-familiar.description: Ability Score Increase. +1 to any ability (max 20). Battle Familiar. The Battle Familiar spell is always prepared; cast it free once per Long Rest or with slots, using your Familiar Friend ability. Intercept Attack. When a creature within 5 feet of your familiar is hit, the familiar's Reaction adds your Proficiency Bonus to that creature's AC against the attack.

feat:watchers.description: Something unnatural is always watching you, taking the form of scurrying vermin and other eerie creatures. You gain the following features. Borrowed Eyes. You always have the Beast Sense and Speak with Animals spells prepared. You can cast each spell without a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Heightened Suspicion. Whenever you take the Search action, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to any ability check made as part of that action. Incessant Watchers. You have Disadvantage on saving throws made against the Scrying spell. In addition, immediately after you make a D20 Test and roll a 1 on the d20, paranoia threatens to overwhelm you. Make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, you have Disadvantage on D20 Tests for 1 minute. You can repeat the save at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect early on a success.

feat:weapon-master.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity Score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Mastery Property. Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery property of one kind of Simple or Martial weapon of your choice, provided you have proficiency with it. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kind of weapon to another eligible kind.

feat:wood-elf-magic.description: Learn the magic of the primeval woods Buff, Movement, Species Feat Prerequisite: Elf (wood) You learn the magic of the primeval woods, which are revered and protected by your people. You learn one druid cantrip of your choice. You also learn the longstrider and pass without trace spells, each of which you can cast once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast these two spells in this way when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for all three spells.

feat:zhentarim-ruffian.description: Exploit Opening. When you roll damage for an Opportunity Attack, you can roll the damage dice twice and use either roll against the target. Family First. If you have Heroic Inspiration when you roll Initiative, you can expend it to give yourself and your allies Advantage on that Initiative roll.

feat:zhentarim-tactics.description: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Retaliate. Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can make an Opportunity Attack against that creature. Versatile Merc. When you finish a Long Rest, choose a skill in which you have proficiency. You have Expertise in that skill until you finish your next Long Rest.

feat:adept-of-the-black-robes.prerequisite: 4th level, Initiate of High Sorcery (Nuitari) feat
feat:adept-of-the-black-robes.description: Ambitious Magic: learn one 2nd-level enchantment or necromancy spell, castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots, using your Initiate of High Sorcery ability. Life Channel: when a creature you can see within 60 feet fails a save against a damaging spell you cast, spend Hit Dice equal to the spell's level, roll them, and add the total to its damage.

feat:adept-of-the-red-robes.prerequisite: 4th level, Initiate of High Sorcery (Lunitari) feat
feat:adept-of-the-red-robes.description: Insightful Magic: learn one 2nd-level illusion or transmutation spell, castable once per long rest without a slot or with slots, using your Initiate of High Sorcery ability. Magical Balance: when you roll 9 or lower on the d20 for an attack roll or ability check, treat it as a 10; proficiency bonus times per long rest.

feat:shadow-pact.description: Darkvision: 60 feet, or +30 feet if you already have it. Shadow Blood: when you roll a 1 on a die for Hit Points you regain while entirely in Dim Light or Darkness, reroll it and use the new roll. Shroud of Shadows: as a Bonus Action, radiate a 5-foot Emanation of Dim Light for 1 minute (ends if you dismiss it or are Incapacitated); once per Short or Long Rest.

feat:shadow-trapper.description: +1 Strength or Wisdom (max 20). Dangerous Shroud: Advantage on attack rolls against creatures inside your Shroud of Shadows. Sorrowful Embrace: at the start of each of its turns, a creature you have Grappled makes a Wisdom save (DC 8 + the raised ability's modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or takes 1d4 + that modifier Psychic damage.

feat:shadow-weaver.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). Create Shadow: Darkness is always prepared; cast it once per Long Rest without a slot, or with slots, using the raised ability. Manipulate Shadow: as a Bonus Action, grow or shrink a Darkness you cast by 5 feet (radius 5 to 25 feet) or move its area to a point within 60 feet.

feat:fey-tormentor.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). Faerie Time Warp: once per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action, up to three creatures you can see within 60 feet make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + the raised ability's modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or lose 10 feet of Speed and take a -2 AC penalty until the end of your next turn. Hag's Hex: Hex is always prepared; cast it once per Long Rest without a slot, or with slots, using the raised ability. At character level 5, Bestow Curse works the same way.

feat:blood-hound.description: You notice any Small or larger creature that moves within 10 feet of you while you aren't Unconscious, and you have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sound or smell.

feat:convincing-inquisitor.description: Influence actions: no Disadvantage against Hostile creatures and Advantage against Indifferent ones, and you can use any ability modifier for Intimidation or Persuasion. When a Search with Insight catches a lie or evasion, you have Advantage on Initiative against that creature for 1 hour.

feat:deathbound.description: With two failed Death Saves you have Advantage on Death Saves until you are above 0 HP. When you spend Hit Dice on a Short Rest, roll each twice and keep the higher.

feat:fortune-of-the-thaumaturge.description: PB times per Long Rest, when you fail a D20 Test spend and roll a Hit Die and add it (once per test). If the die shows its highest or lowest number, you regain that Hit Die.

feat:free-sword-mercenary-s-will.description: When a creature moves you without using your movement, take a Reaction to reduce the distance by up to your Speed. Advantage on saves that would apply a condition.

feat:insightful-collector.description: A Study action identifies a magic item's properties and use without attuning (not curses), with a cumulative 5% chance per rarity step above Common of getting it wrong. You start with a Common magic item chosen with your GM.

feat:resolution-of-the-syndicate.description: On your first turn after rolling Initiative, add 1d4 to your first damage roll (2d4 at level 9, 4d4 at level 16). HP maximum increases by your character level, and by 1 per level after.

feat:triage-expert.description: Blood and Bone: Utilize action and a Healer's Kit use lets a creature within 5 feet spend and roll a Hit Die to heal. Bedside Manner: whenever you restore HP or use Blood and Bone, roll one extra die and drop the lowest.

feat:blackpowder-pistol-expert.description: +1 Dexterity, Constitution, or Intelligence (max 20). No Disadvantage at long range with Blackpowder Pistols, ignore their Loading property, and when a creature within 5 feet of you moves, take a Reaction to shoot it with one.

feat:expanded-grip.description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution (max 20). A Versatile weapon used in one hand deals its two-handed damage in melee. When an effect would make you drop what you hold, make a DC 15 Strength save to keep it, and you have Advantage on saves to keep your grip.

feat:hulking-figure.description: +1 Strength or Constitution (max 20). Once per turn an Unarmed Strike hit deals +1d4 Bludgeoning. Add Str mod to Intimidation, Performance, and Persuasion checks. Count one size larger (max Large) for carrying.

feat:iron-gut.description: +1 Strength, Constitution, or Charisma (max 20). Advantage on saves against Poisoned and on Survival checks to forage. Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Bonus Action spend a Hit Die and heal its roll + Con mod.

feat:lightning-caster.prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
feat:lightning-caster.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). When you cast a single-target action cantrip, a Bonus Action lets it target a second creature in range. Once per Long Rest, a spell you cast as a Reaction uses no slot.

feat:medician-of-the-morbus-doctore.description: Blood and Bone lets the creature spend up to three Hit Dice, or spend three to end Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned instead of healing (or cure one Grievous Wound).

feat:nimble-physique.description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution (max 20). Without armor or a Shield, Dodge as a Bonus Action. While Grappled or Restrained your attacks don't have Disadvantage and attacks against you don't have Advantage.

feat:sangromantic-initiate.prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
feat:sangromantic-initiate.description: Pick a Sangromancy spell of a level you have slots for: always prepared, once per Long Rest without a slot, or with slots. You also have two d12 Sangromancy Dice to spend instead of Hit Dice on Sangromancy spells, refilled on a Long Rest.

feat:shadowsteel-adept.prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
feat:shadowsteel-adept.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). Shadowsteel curses are always prepared and castable with any slots. While holding your Shadowsteel Focus, +1 to spell attacks and spell save DCs, and if it is a weapon it is +1.

feat:shadowsteel-master.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (max 20). With your Shadowsteel Focus, one creature you hit or that fails a save against your slot spell takes 1d4 Necrotic per slot level. A weapon Focus becomes +2 and once per turn adds 2d8 Necrotic on a hit.

feat:syndicate-spy.description: Proficiency with Thieves' Tools (craft a key in 10 minutes with the lock), Disguise Kit (10-minute costume changes your apparent features and even species, not size or shape), and Forgery Kit (no word limit mimicking handwriting). Hide from non-Hostile creatures while only Lightly Obscured, using Charisma if you like.

feat:thrown-weapon-master.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity (max 20). After an Attack action with a Simple Thrown weapon, make two more Simple Thrown attacks as a Bonus Action. As a Bonus Action, gather and stow or wield all Simple Thrown weapons within 5 feet (free hand needed). Your proficient Simple Thrown weapons gain the Returning property.

feat:witch-hunter.description: +1 Strength, Constitution, or Wisdom (max 20). When a spell targets only you with no area, take a Reaction for a Wisdom save against its DC; on a success the caster must pick a new target or the spell is wasted. Melee or Unarmed Strike hits on spellcasters cut their Speed by 15 feet until your next turn. Advantage on saves against Shadowsteel curses and spells lasting over 10 minutes.

feat:advanced-weapon-proficiency.prerequisite: Fighting Style feature (or level 8+ as a General feat)
feat:advanced-weapon-proficiency.description: Proficiency with Advanced weapons, including use of their mastery properties.

feat:close-combat-artillerist.description: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't give your Ranged weapon attacks Disadvantage, and your ranged hits on creatures within 5 feet deal +2 damage.

feat:dual-shot.description: When you attack with a bow or crossbow as part of the Attack action, you can add one extra attack against a creature within 10 feet of the first target; both attacks have Disadvantage.

feat:flurry.description: Once per turn, give up Advantage on a weapon or Unarmed Strike attack; afterward attack a different creature within 5 feet of the first target and in reach.

feat:mobile-combatant.description: When you take the Attack action, your Speed increases by 10 feet and Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage until the end of your turn.

feat:opportunist.description: Attacks you make as part of a Reaction get +2 to attack and damage rolls.

feat:prone-defense.description: Being Prone doesn't give your attacks Disadvantage or attacks against you Advantage, and standing up costs only 5 feet of movement.

feat:boon-of-magic-resistance.description: +1 Intelligence or Wisdom (max 30). Once per Short or Long Rest, turn a failed saving throw into a success.

feat:boon-of-perfect-flight.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity (max 30). Fly Speed 40 feet with hover, and falls slow to 60 feet per round.

feat:brutal-grip.description: +1 Strength (max 20). Wield a Two-Handed melee weapon in one hand, and a Versatile melee weapon held in one hand counts as Light.

feat:field-commander.description: +1 Charisma (max 20). As an action, an ally within 60 feet who hears you can immediately use its Reaction to Attack (one attack), Dash, Dodge, Hide, Influence, Search, Study, or Utilize. Enemies can't have Advantage on attacks against you while you're within 5 feet of two or more active allies.

feat:focused-critical.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity (max 20). Your weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks crit on 19 or 20.

feat:iron-hero.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity (max 20). +2 AC against attacks from creatures whose CR exceeds your level. Advantage on attacks against a creature that dropped an ally to 0 HP since your last turn. PB times per Long Rest, take a Reaction to stop a Legendary Action you can see.

feat:familiar-keeper.description: +1 Int, Wis, or Cha (max 20). Find Familiar always prepared, once per Long Rest as a Magic action with no slot or components; your familiar can also be an Imp, Pseudodragon, Quasit, Sphinx of Wonder, or Sprite. PB times per Long Rest, take a Reaction to give Disadvantage to an attack made by a creature within 5 feet of your familiar.

feat:flex-caster.description: +1 Int, Wis, or Cha (max 20). When casting a spell that scales, spend an extra slot to raise its effective level by 1 (max 9). Or cast a spell with a higher slot at its base level and regain a level 1 slot.

feat:magitechnician.description: +1 Int, Wis, or Cha (max 20). Your magic items' save DCs can use 8 + that ability's modifier + PB if higher. Once per Long Rest, after a Short Rest, recharge one magic item as if it were dawn.

feat:metabolistic-magic.prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
feat:metabolistic-magic.description: +1 Int, Wis, or Cha (max 20). When you fail a D20 Test, spend a spell slot to add 2 + its level. Once per Long Rest, after a Short Rest, spend up to PB Hit Dice to recover spell slots of that total level.

feat:pyromaniac.description: +1 Int, Wis, or Cha (max 20). Learn Fire Bolt and always have Burning Hands and Scorching Ray prepared, each once per Long Rest without a slot. When a Fire damage die rolls its maximum, roll it again and add it, repeating, up to PB extra dice.

feat:shock-trooper.description: +1 Str or Dex (max 20). When you roll Initiative without Disadvantage, draw a weapon and attack with it. Your Speed is doubled during the first round of combat.

feat:showman.description: +1 Cha (max 20). Performance proficiency, or Expertise if you have it. PB times per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action taunt a creature within 15 feet that can hear you: Disadvantage on its next attack against anyone else before the end of its next turn.

feat:spellblade.description: +1 Int, Wis, or Cha (max 20). Learn two of Arc Blade, Burning Blade, Frigid Blade, or True Strike (swappable each level), and replace one Attack action attack with casting one. PB times per Long Rest, add your Int, Wis, or Cha mod (min +1) to a proficient weapon attack roll.

feat:altered.description: An obvious augmentation of your choice. Aquatic Adaptation: breathe water and Swim Speed equal to your Speed. Natural Armor: AC 13 + Dex or Con mod. Natural Weapons: Unarmed Strikes deal 1d8 Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing. Night Vision: Darkvision 60 feet (or +30).

feat:charm-twister.description: Old Blessing: once per Long Rest cast Bless only on creatures carrying your wicker charms (or with slots), using Int, Wis, or Cha. Twisted Hex: as a Magic action curse a charm with an ability; whoever carries it, or whose home holds it, has Disadvantage on checks and attacks with that ability, and on such a failure can make a Cha save (DC 8 + PB + that modifier) to destroy it. One hex charm at a time.

feat:crimson-ritualist.description: Learn the Blood Bolt cantrip (Int, Wis, or Cha). After a Long Rest, a 1-minute ritual bleeds up to PB Hit Dice into a vial; a creature drinking it as a Bonus Action rolls those dice and heals the total + its Con mod. It keeps until your next Long Rest.

feat:cult-initiate.description: Learn two Warlock cantrips and always have one level 1 Warlock spell prepared, castable once per Short or Long Rest without a slot or with slots (Int, Wis, or Cha). Swap one choice when you gain a level.

feat:dread-speech.description: Eldritch Word: as a Bonus Action a creature within 60 feet makes a Wis save (DC 8 + PB + Int, Wis, or Cha mod) or is Frightened until your next turn; free once per Short or Long Rest, and extra uses cost you 1d6 Necrotic that can't be reduced. Shred Fate: Bane always prepared, once per Long Rest without a slot or Material components.

feat:fate-gambler.description: Gain Heroic Inspiration (if you lack it) when you win a contested check, drop a creature to 0 HP, or a creature fails a save you forced, unless it has no CR or CR 0. As a Bonus Action spend Heroic Inspiration for temp HP equal to your level.

feat:ghostlight-medium.description: Ignore the damage Resistances of creatures with Incorporeal Movement. Once per Short or Long Rest after a detection, as a Bonus Action sense the distance and direction of Undead and Ethereal creatures within 60 feet.

feat:grave-keeper.description: Gain one Channel Divinity use for Turn Undead (DC 8 + Wis mod + PB), or add a use to an existing Channel Divinity. A 10-minute rite with 10 GP of trappings keeps a Medium or smaller corpse from becoming Undead.

feat:hunter-of-hunters.description: As a Bonus Action study a creature; your next damage to it before your next turn ignores its Resistances. Advantage on checks to recall lore about creatures.

feat:memory-starved.description: Advantage on Investigation checks, and on saves against Charmed and against having your memories read or altered.

feat:reveling-fool.description: A fool's mask and costume give you a separate identity that can get away with small affronts to authority. Hideous Laughter always prepared, once per Long Rest without a slot or Material components (Int, Wis, or Cha).

feat:unreflected.description: You cast no reflection or shadow. Insight checks against you have Disadvantage. Among at least two creatures of your type within one size of you, you can Hide from those outside the group with Deception instead of Stealth, needing no cover; straying more than 5 feet from them reveals you.

feat:death-defier.description: +1 Constitution (max 20). Add Con mod (min 1) to Death Saving Throws. Once per Long Rest, an effect that would kill you outright or drop you to 0 HP without damage leaves you at HP equal to your level.

feat:swift-witchcraft.prerequisite: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
feat:swift-witchcraft.description: +1 Int, Wis, or Cha (max 20). Once per Long Rest, cast a 1-minute spell as an action.

feat:blessing-of-baldur.description: Protective Aegis: once per Long Rest, when you or an ally within 10 feet takes damage, use your Reaction to reduce it by your Proficiency Bonus + Charisma modifier (minimum 1). Radiant Aura: as a Bonus Action, shed bright light 10 feet and dim light 10 more (Bonus Action to end). Sunlance: you know Sacred Flame (Charisma).

feat:blessing-of-boreas.description: Cold Aegis: when you take Cold damage, use your Reaction to gain Resistance to Cold until the end of your next turn, Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. Winter Magic: you know Ray of Frost and always have Armor of Agathys or Ice Knife prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma).

feat:blessing-of-eir.description: You have Vitality Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest. Vitality Surge: Bonus Action and 1 point to regain 1d4 Hit Points, or stabilize yourself while Dying (no action). Channel Vitality: Bonus Action and 1 point to heal a creature you touch 1d4.

feat:blessing-of-freyr-and-freyja.description: Proficiency in Animal Handling or Nature. You learn Druidcraft and Thorn Whip and always have Entangle or Hail of Thorns prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma).

feat:blessing-of-jormungandr.description: Poison Resilience: when you take Poison damage, use your Reaction to gain Resistance to Poison until the end of your next turn, Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. Serpent Kinship: Animal Friendship and Speak with Animals always prepared, each once per Long Rest without a slot (snakes and serpents only) or with slots. You know Draconic.

feat:blessing-of-loki.description: Proficiency in Deception (Expertise if already proficient). You learn Minor Illusion and Vicious Mockery and always have Disguise Self or Charm Person prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma).

feat:blessing-of-sif.description: Gift of Dexterity: add your Proficiency Bonus to a Dexterity check (again if already added), Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. You know True Strike and always have Hunter's Mark or Longstrider prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

feat:blessing-of-thor.description: Gift of Strength: add your Proficiency Bonus to a Strength check (again if already added), Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. You know Shocking Grasp or Thunderclap and always have Thunderous Smite prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

feat:blessing-of-volund.description: Proficiency with one Artisan's Tool (Advantage with it if already proficient). You learn Elementalism and Mending and always have Burning Hands or Shield prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

feat:blessing-of-wotan.description: Proficiency in Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion (Expertise if already proficient). You know Guidance and always have one level 1 spell of your choice prepared, castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

feat:brewer.description: Proficiency with Brewer's Supplies and a 50% discount on food and drink. After a Long Rest with Brewer's Supplies you brew a mead; a creature that drinks it (Utilize action) gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. It keeps until your next Long Rest.

feat:cold-plunge-training.description: In water you have Advantage on saves against extreme cold and on Strength (Athletics) checks to swim. On a turn you dive from land into water, you swim at full Speed.

feat:fisher.description: Proficiency in Survival. Advantage on d20 Tests to operate water vehicles. With access to water, 1 hour of fishing feeds up to 6 people for a day.

feat:norn-touched.description: Fates' Favor: once per day, add your Proficiency Bonus to a d20 Test after seeing the roll. Fates' Scorn: once per day, subtract your Proficiency Bonus from another creature's attack roll or ability check after seeing the roll.

feat:northern-raider.description: Proficiency with Navigator's Tools. Advantage on attack rolls and ability checks on a turn you exit the water or a ship.

feat:sea-wolf.description: Advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks to board vehicles. When you score a melee Critical Hit, make another melee attack against that creature or an adjacent one as a Bonus Action.

feat:snowrunner.description: Advantage on saves and checks to keep your balance on slippery surfaces and snow, and on Wisdom (Survival) checks in snowy or icy terrain.

feat:well-versed.description: Proficiency with one musical instrument and one of Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion. Give yourself Advantage on an Intelligence (Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion) check Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

feat:axe-fighter.prerequisite: Level 4+, Strength 13+, Proficiency with Martial Weapons
feat:axe-fighter.description: +1 Strength. Once per turn when you hit with a Handaxe, attack with a Handaxe as a Bonus Action. Battleaxe Topple saves have Disadvantage. Greataxe Cleave reaches extra creatures equal to half your Proficiency Bonus.

feat:axe-thrower.description: +1 Strength. When you miss a ranged attack with a thrown Handaxe, use a Bonus Action that turn to catch it as it returns.

feat:battle-cry.description: +1 Strength or Charisma. As a Bonus Action once per Short Rest, roll Charisma (Intimidation); a creature that can hear you within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save against the result or is Frightened for 1d4 rounds (save each turn). Two creatures at level 9; three and 60 feet at level 15.

feat:blessing-of-angrboda-and-bergelmir.prerequisite: Level 4+, Giantkin or Trollkin (or GM permission)
feat:blessing-of-angrboda-and-bergelmir.description: +1 Strength or Wisdom. Thunderous Strike: add 1d6 Thunder to a melee weapon hit, Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. Prophetic Vision: once per Long Rest as a Magic action, cast a 1-action Divination spell of a level up to half your character level without a slot (Wisdom).

feat:blessing-of-bragi.description: +1 Wisdom or Charisma. Proficiency in Persuasion and Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks.

feat:blessing-of-heimdall.description: +1 Strength or Constitution. Proficiency in Perception (Expertise if already proficient), and give yourself Advantage on Perception checks Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. Proficiency with the horn. Once per Long Rest, reroll Initiative and use the new result.

feat:blessing-of-hel.description: Advantage on Death Saving Throws. When you become Stable after a third success or are stabilized by another creature, regain 1d6 + Proficiency Bonus Hit Points. You know Spare the Dying and Toll the Dead (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma).

feat:blessing-of-njord.description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. Cast Find Steed (a sea serpent) once per Long Rest without a slot, or with slots. You breathe water, automatically succeed on saves against extreme cold while submerged, and have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

feat:blessing-of-skadi.description: +1 Constitution. Once per Short or Long Rest, give yourself Advantage on a ranged weapon attack made with the Attack action. +10 feet Speed on ice or snow, which are never Difficult Terrain for you.

feat:blessing-of-the-snow-queen.description: +1 Constitution. You know Ice Knife and can cast it without a slot Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest, or with slots. Once per Long Rest, turn a failed save against a Cold-damage spell or effect into a success.

feat:blessing-of-tyr.description: +1 Strength or Charisma. Advantage on saves to avoid or end Frightened. Justicar: as a Magic action, touch a creature; on a failed Charisma save it can't deliberately lie for 1 minute (once per Long Rest per creature).

feat:blood-of-the-berserker.description: +1 Strength or Constitution. Once per Long Rest while Bloodied, enter a 1-minute fury as a Bonus Action: melee weapon attacks deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you don't fall Unconscious at 0 Hit Points (you still make Death Saves).

feat:bloodied-resilience.description: +1 Constitution. While Bloodied, when you take damage, spend a Hit Die as a Reaction to reduce it by the roll. A successful Strength or Constitution save against half-damage effects means no damage.

feat:bloody-resolve.description: +1 Constitution. When you take damage, +1 to saves until the end of your next turn; while Bloodied, +2 to saves and +1 to attack and damage rolls instead.

feat:boisterous-roar.description: +1 Charisma. When you score a Critical Hit, you and allies within 5 feet have Resistance to all damage and enemies within 5 feet have Vulnerability to all damage until the end of your next turn.

feat:brazen-courage.description: +1 Wisdom or Charisma. Advantage on saves against Frightened, and end Frightened on yourself as a Bonus Action Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

feat:chosen-by-fate.description: +1 Charisma. If a Heroic Inspiration reroll fails, it isn't expended (but can't be reused on that test). Using Heroic Inspiration heals you by the die roll, with any excess as Temporary Hit Points.

feat:clout.description: +1 Strength. Advantage on Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion) checks with warriors and martial folk, and add your Strength modifier to Inspiring Leader's Temporary Hit Points.

feat:cold-water-warrior.description: Automatically succeed on Strength checks to move through rough water. Immune to frigid water for hours equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Long and High Jumps while swimming (10 feet of swimming is a running start). Advantage on Initiative when starting combat partly submerged.

feat:combat-flyting.description: +1 Charisma. As a Bonus Action, taunt a creature within 30 feet that can hear and understand you: on a failed Charisma save (DC 8 + Charisma modifier + Proficiency Bonus) it takes -1 to attacks against you. Repeat each turn with a Bonus Action to stack penalties up to your Charisma modifier (new save each time). Ends if you drop to 0, are Incapacitated, skip a Bonus Action, it moves over 30 feet away, or after Proficiency Bonus rounds. A success grants 24-hour immunity.

feat:cut-down-the-nithingr.description: +1 Strength or Charisma. +2 damage against Frightened creatures, and Frightened durations you cause are doubled.

feat:endurance-conditioning.description: +1 Constitution. Once per day a Short Rest removes 1 Exhaustion level, and a Long Rest removes 2.

feat:faster-crafting.description: +1 to any ability. Proficiency with an Artisan's Tool, or Advantage with one you already know. In combat, as a Bonus Action craft one item from the Fast Crafting table with proficient tools; it lasts until the end of your next turn or until you craft another. You can also craft one during a Short Rest, lasting until the end of the day or your next Long Rest.

feat:fjord-jumper.description: +1 Strength. Jump distances +10 feet, and Advantage on attacks, Acrobatics, and Athletics checks right after jumping at least 10 feet high or 20 feet long. When you fall into liquid, a Reaction and a DC 15 Athletics or Acrobatics check (with Advantage) negates the fall damage.

feat:frost-eyed.description: +1 Wisdom. Advantage on Perception checks in Bright Light and no Disadvantage on Perception in Dim Light. Proficiency in Survival, snow and ice count as normal terrain, and Advantage on Survival in snow or ice.

feat:frost-touched.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. You know Frostbite or Ray of Frost, and always have Gust of Wind and one level 1 Cold-damage Druid, Sorcerer, or Wizard spell prepared, each castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

feat:giant-slayer.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Within 5 feet of a Large or larger creature, Dodge as a Bonus Action. Large or larger creatures have Disadvantage on saves against your Topple mastery.

feat:greater-blessing-of-baldur.description: +1 Dexterity or Constitution. After each Long Rest, gain Resistance to one damage type of your choice until your next Long Rest.

feat:greater-blessing-of-boreas.description: +1 Strength or Constitution. Resistance to Cold damage, and when you would take Fire damage, use your Reaction to gain Resistance to Fire until the start of your next turn.

feat:greater-blessing-of-freyr-and-freyj.prerequisite: Level 4+, Blessing of Freyr and Freyja Feat
feat:greater-blessing-of-freyr-and-freyj.description: +1 Wisdom or Charisma. Cure Wounds always prepared, castable without a slot Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest or with slots; healing is doubled on Beasts and Plants.

feat:greater-blessing-of-jormungandr.description: +1 Strength or Charisma. As an action, up to Proficiency Bonus creatures within 30 feet that can see you make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Charisma modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or are Frightened for 1 minute (save each turn). Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

feat:greater-blessing-of-loki.description: +1 Intelligence or Charisma. Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks. Alter Self always prepared, once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

feat:greater-blessing-of-sif.description: +1 Dexterity or Constitution. As a Bonus Action, for 1 minute your ranged weapon hits deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus once per turn. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

feat:greater-blessing-of-thor.description: +1 Strength or Constitution. As a Bonus Action, for 1 minute your melee weapon hits deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus once per turn. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

feat:greater-blessing-of-wotan.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Advantage on checks with your Lore Bound skill. Augury always prepared, once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

feat:heroic-rush.description: +1 Constitution or Charisma. On a Critical Hit, +10 feet Speed and Advantage on attacks until the end of your next turn. When you drop a creature to 0 with an attack, an ally within 30 feet gains Heroic Inspiration to use by the end of its next turn (twice per Short or Long Rest).

feat:holmganga-master.description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. Advantage on Initiative at the start of a duel. As a Bonus Action, a successful Charisma (Intimidation) check against your duel opponent gives you Advantage on your next attack against it and it Disadvantage on its next attack against you.

feat:hunter.description: +1 Wisdom or Intelligence. Advantage on Perception and Survival checks to follow or identify tracks, and on Stealth checks outdoors.

feat:ice-mastery.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest, when a spell of level 1+ deals Cold damage to a creature, add one: Disadvantage on Dexterity checks for 1 minute; Restrained in ice until it saves (Dexterity) or takes 10 Bludgeoning or Fire; or Vulnerability to Cold for 1 minute (Constitution save each turn).

feat:lightning-mastery.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest, when a spell of level 1+ deals Lightning damage to a creature, add one: Stunned until the end of your next turn if it failed its save; half the Lightning damage again at the start of its next turn (save negates); or Vulnerability to Lightning for 1 minute (Constitution save each turn).

feat:living-off-the-land.description: +1 Constitution or Wisdom. A Long Rest in a natural area yields materials for a Healer's Kit and food for one Medium creature for a day. In 30 minutes build a shelter for 4 to 5 Medium humanoids; inside, they automatically succeed on saves against extreme cold and heat.

feat:long-haft-strike.description: +1 Strength. Reach weapon attacks ignore a target's Shield bonus to AC, and you have +1 AC while wielding a Reach weapon.

feat:moon-touched.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. You know Dancing Lights or Light, and always have Moonbeam and one level 1 light spell from the Druid, Sorcerer, or Wizard list prepared, each castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

feat:mounted-leap.prerequisite: Level 4+, Strength or Dexterity 13+, Proficiency in Animal Handling
feat:mounted-leap.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Your mount's jump distance is doubled. Jumping from a moving mount uses its Speed if better; a melee hit after the jump adds 1d8 damage or knocks a target up to one size larger Prone (once per turn).

feat:northlands-hardiness.description: +1 Constitution. Advantage on saves against extreme cold (and against Cold damage if you already resist it). Your first Exhaustion level each day doesn't reduce your Speed, and you can ignore Exhaustion on a d20 Test.

feat:primal.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Barkskin and two of Animal Friendship, Entangle, Goodberry, or Speak with Animals always prepared, each castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

feat:ravens-friend.description: +1 Intelligence or Wisdom. Proficiency in Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, or Religion. Give yourself Advantage when you take the Study action, Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

feat:spear-expert.prerequisite: Level 4+, Strength or Dexterity 13+, Weapon Mastery class feature
feat:spear-expert.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity. +1 AC while holding a Spear, thrown Spear range 30/90, and Advantage on Readied Spear attacks.

feat:surtr-s-touch.description: +1 Strength or Constitution. As a Bonus Action, for 1 minute your melee weapon hits deal extra Fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

feat:trickster-s-toolbox.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Hideous Laughter and two level 1 Enchantment or Illusion spells always prepared, each castable once per Long Rest without a slot or with slots.

feat:wild-lore.description: +1 Intelligence. Advantage on Intelligence (Nature) checks, and you can find food and water for yourself and up to three others each day.

feat:glima.description: When you hit a creature within 5 feet that is no more than one size larger with an Unarmed Strike, you can force a Strength save (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Strength modifier) or it has the Prone condition.

feat:raider-s-rush.description: If you move at least 15 feet and stop within 5 feet of an ally, you have Advantage on attacks against creatures within 5 feet of that ally.

feat:savagery.description: On your first melee weapon attack each turn, you can attack savagely: add your Proficiency Bonus to melee weapon damage rolls but take -2 AC until the start of your next turn.

feat:shield-wall.description: When a creature you can see hits an adjacent ally, use your Reaction to add your Shield's AC bonus to the ally against that attack. You and an adjacent ally both wielding shields each gain +1 AC.

feat:skirmisher.description: +10 feet Speed. Once per turn, after moving at least 15 feet, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage of a Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing hit.

feat:underfoot.description: You can end your move in the space of a creature two sizes larger. While sharing its space you have Advantage on attacks against it and it has Disadvantage on attacks against you.

feat:pouncing.description: After moving 15 feet or more toward a creature, +2 to your next Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike attack roll against it, or +2 to the save DC of a Grapple or Shove against it.

feat:born-in-yatamon.prerequisite: Lived in Yatamon for at least 1 year
feat:born-in-yatamon.description: Proficiency in the Salvage skill (Expertise if already proficient). You learn Naku Naku and Torum. Twice per Long Rest, when targeted by a level 1+ spell from yourself or an ally, regain Hit Points equal to twice the spell's level. You learn one Wizard cantrip.

feat:connoisseur.description: +1 Constitution or Wisdom. A satisfying meal during a rest grants Heroic Inspiration or 1d10 + level Temporary Hit Points. Advantage on Charisma checks at formal events. Proficiency with Brewer's Supplies or Cook's Utensils, and 10 minutes identifies an ingredient's or potion's properties.

feat:feline-instincts.description: Advantage against the Prone condition, and standing costs at most 10 feet. Speak with felines as if by Speak with Animals. Add half your Proficiency Bonus to Wisdom (Perception) checks, even if already proficient.

feat:haggler.description: +1 Intelligence or Charisma. When a creature within 10 feet fails a Charisma D20 Test, gain Advantage on your next Intimidation or Persuasion against it within an hour, or Heroic Inspiration (once per Long Rest). Reroll a failed Charisma check or save, but the DC rises by 3. 5 percent off purchases, and spend Heroic Inspiration for a further 10 + 1d10 percent.

feat:motorist.description: +1 Dexterity or Intelligence. Vehicles you drive get +1 AC, you add your Proficiency Bonus to Maneuvering checks, small vehicles count as Nimble and Simple for you, and you add it to ram save DCs.

feat:yoka-scout.prerequisite: Level 4+, Member of the Yoka Scouts
feat:yoka-scout.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity. When an ally misses a creature within 10 feet of you, take a Reaction to let it reroll; if it hits, regain the Reaction (half Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest). +2 to ability checks an ally succeeded on in the last minute. Advantage on Search checks related to Demons.

feat:faithful.description: Once per Long Rest, turn a failed save against Charmed or Frightened into a success. Whenever you roll a 1 on a D20 Test, you gain Heroic Inspiration.

feat:grizzled.description: Add your Proficiency Bonus to saves against Frightened. You need half the food and water and have Advantage on Survival checks to forage. Once per Short or Long Rest, gain Heroic Inspiration right after damage makes you Bloodied.

feat:brutalizer.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Wield a Two-Handed weapon in one hand if the other hand holds no Two-Handed weapon or Shield. After attacking with a Two-Handed weapon in the Attack action, make a Bonus Action attack with a Light weapon (no ability modifier to damage unless negative or you have Two-Weapon Fighting).

feat:cannoneer.description: +1 Strength. Proficiency with Cannons; reload one as a Bonus Action if you haven't moved (Speed 0 afterward). From level 11 it doesn't stop you and can replace an attack; at level 20 ignore the Artillery property. Double damage to objects and structures, and Cannons and Cannonballs weigh half for you.

feat:i-fought-i-lived.description: Once per Long Rest while Bloodied, treat a hit's damage roll as the maximum. If Frightened at the start of your turn, roll a d20; on 10 or higher the condition ends.

feat:i-hid-from-the-terror.description: Attack without ending the Invisible condition, Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. You can hide from larger creatures while lightly obscured or more than 30 feet away. Perception checks to detect you while Invisible have Disadvantage.

feat:i-pierced-the-illusion.description: If Charmed at the start of your turn, roll a d20; on 10 or higher it ends. Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest, tell whether an NPC speaking to you is knowingly lying. Advantage on Insight checks against creatures you are speaking with.

feat:i-opened-the-gate.description: Learn three languages. Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest, give a spell's save DC +2, but you are Paralyzed until the start of your next turn.

feat:i-survived-to-tell-the-tale.description: Once per Long Rest when damage would drop you to 0, regain Hit Points equal to your level. +10 feet Speed. When you would be Grappled, roll a d20; on 10 or higher you aren't.

feat:aereni-expertise.description: Proficiency in one skill of your choice, and Expertise in that skill.

feat:aquatic-adaptation.description: You can breathe underwater (removing any Limited Amphibiousness dependence on water), gain proficiency in Athletics, and have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

feat:envoy-specialist.description: Proficiency with one tool of your choice. One tool you're proficient with is built into your body and can't be removed; with a hand free you can use it, and add 1d4 to ability checks made with it.

feat:khesh-dar-training.description: Proficiency and Expertise in Stealth. When you take the Hide action, the DC to succeed is 10.

feat:focused-personas.description: Define two personas. Adept Persona: while in it, proficiency with a chosen tool and +1d4 to checks with it. Expert Persona: while in it, Expertise in a chosen skill you're proficient in. You also know Skin Cant.

feat:thoughtsinger.description: Your Mind Link reaches 120 feet or 10 times your level. You can message everyone you're linked to at once and let them talk telepathically with each other, and you can Help an ally's attack from any distance while linked.

feat:uul-dhakaan.prerequisite: Dhakaani Ghaal'dar, Dhakaani Golin'dar, or Dhakaani Guul'dar
feat:uul-dhakaan.description: You dream lucidly and remember your dreams. A spirit mentor in the Uul Dhakaan may send visions, missions, or clues after a Long Rest. Resistance to Psychic damage.

feat:aereni-half-life.description: +1 Intelligence or Wisdom. Advantage on Death Saving Throws, Resistance to Necrotic and Radiant damage, and spells that deal Necrotic can deal Radiant instead.

feat:changeling-metamorphosis.description: +1 Constitution or Dexterity. +1 AC. Each time you use Shape-Shifter, gain one until you shift again: gills and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed; Darkvision 60 feet; or natural weapons (claws, fangs, horns, or hooves) dealing 1d6 with your Unarmed Strike, using Strength or Dexterity.

feat:juggernaut-plating.description: +1 Strength or Constitution. Armor you wear can't be targeted by effects against your will while you live, and Critical Hits against you become normal hits.

feat:quori-bond.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Pick a quori lineage: Du'ulora (Intimidation, Crown of Madness), Hashalaq (Persuasion, Suggestion), Kalaraq (Perception, Mind Spike), or Tsucora (Intimidation, Shatter dealing Psychic). Add 1d4 to checks with that skill; the spell is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots.

feat:superior-shifting.description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom. You can shift at the start of your turn with no action, shifting lasts 10 minutes, and you gain one extra use (one use back on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest).

feat:siberys-mark-of-detection.description: Advantage on Investigation checks. True Seeing is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

feat:siberys-mark-of-finding.description: Advantage on Perception checks. Commune with Nature and Find the Path are always prepared, each free once per Short Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

feat:siberys-mark-of-handling.description: Advantage on Animal Handling checks. Dominate Beast is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots; you have Advantage on its Concentration checks, it lasts up to 8 hours, and you can hold it while asleep. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

feat:siberys-mark-of-healing.description: Advantage on Medicine checks. Heal is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

feat:siberys-mark-of-hospitality.description: Advantage on Persuasion checks. Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

feat:siberys-mark-of-making.description: Advantage on Investigation checks. Fabricate (free once per Short Rest) and Create Homunculus (free once per Long Rest) are always prepared and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

feat:siberys-mark-of-passage.description: Advantage on Acrobatics checks. Teleport is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

feat:siberys-mark-of-scribing.description: Advantage on Insight checks and Calligrapher's Supplies checks. Symbol is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

feat:siberys-mark-of-sentinel.description: Advantage on Perception checks. Globe of Invulnerability is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

feat:siberys-mark-of-shadow.description: Advantage on Stealth checks. Project Image is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

feat:siberys-mark-of-storm.description: Advantage on Acrobatics checks and Navigator's Tools checks. Control Weather is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

feat:siberys-mark-of-warding.description: Advantage on Investigation checks and Thieves' Tools checks. Forbiddance is always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and castable with slots. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability (chosen on receipt). One Siberys mark per character.

feat:ashbound-initiate.description: +1 Wisdom or Charisma. Proficiency in Intimidation. When a creature you can see casts a spell, you have Advantage on attacks against it until the end of your next turn. With slots of each level, always prepared: Guiding Bolt, Shining Smite, Nondetection, Aura of Purity, Circle of Power.

feat:gatekeeper-initiate.description: +1 Wisdom or Charisma. Proficiency in Arcana. Add 1d4 to saves against an Aberration's spells or magical abilities. With slots of each level, always prepared: Detect Evil and Good, Warding Bond, Magic Circle, Banishment, Dispel Evil and Good.

feat:greensinger-initiate.description: +1 Wisdom or Charisma. Proficiency in Performance. When you Charm a creature, use your Reaction to move half your Speed without provoking. Your spells and abilities that affect Humanoids also affect Fey. With slots of each level, always prepared: Tasha's Hideous Laughter, Enthrall, Major Image, Compulsion, Mislead.

feat:hewn-for-battle.description: +1 Strength or Constitution. After a rest, set unarmored AC to 14 + Dexterity or 18 (shields still apply); your hide can be enchanted like armor; claws deal 1d6 + Strength Slashing with Unarmed Strikes.

feat:orb-expert.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. After a rest roll 1d6; once before it's lost, add it to a spell attack through an Orb or subtract it from one target's save. Holding an Orb, Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage, and when a creature enters within 5 feet you can use your Reaction to move your Speed without provoking.

feat:rod-expert.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Through a Rod: reroll 1s and 2s on cantrip damage against targets within 20 feet, no Disadvantage on ranged spell attacks within 5 feet of an enemy, and after a ranged spell attack, a Bonus Action melee attack with the Rod as a Club.

feat:shadow-s-gift-of-stone.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. The Medusa Spells (Ensnaring Strike, Hold Person, Hypnotic Pattern, Stoneskin, Hold Monster) are always prepared as you reach their levels, each free once per Long Rest and castable with slots, using your Petrifying Gaze ability.

feat:staff-expert.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Through a Staff: Bonus Action to double a spell's range, reroll 1s and 2s on cantrip damage, and if every target is beyond half range, one creature you hit or that fails its save is knocked Prone.

feat:stone-eyes.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. When a creature you Restrained or Paralyzed fails its save to end it by 5 or more, you can Petrify it for 1 minute with Concentration; held the full minute, it stays stone until Greater Restoration.

feat:voice-of-the-fury.description: +1 Dexterity, Wisdom, or Charisma. The Harpy Spells (Charm Person, Suggestion, Enemies Abound, Charm Monster, Dominate Person) are always prepared as you reach their levels, each free once per Long Rest and castable with slots, using your Harpy's Charms ability.

feat:wand-expert.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Through a Wand: Advantage on spell attacks against targets that haven't taken a turn, no Disadvantage on ranged spell attacks within 5 feet of an enemy, and drawing or stowing a Wand is free.

feat:warden-initiate.description: +1 Wisdom or Charisma. Proficiency in Animal Handling. Once per Short or Long Rest, when a creature hits another within 5 feet of you, use your Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d6 + Proficiency Bonus. With slots of each level, always prepared: Sanctuary, Detect Thoughts, Blink, Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound, Hold Monster.

feat:wings-of-stone.description: +1 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. You have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

feat:winter-initiate.description: +1 Wisdom or Constitution. Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus after taking Necrotic damage, and creatures you conjure can be Undead. With slots of each level, always prepared: False Life, Ray of Enfeeblement, Bestow Curse, Death Ward, Enervation.

feat:wandslinger.description: +1 to attack rolls with spells, and +1 to the save DC of your cantrips.

feat:naturalist.description: Survival rolls of 1 to 9 count as 10 when identifying remains; Expertise in Survival when tracking beasts; the first time you meet a new beast, learn its AC, maximum HP, or one Resistance.

feat:miner.description: A belt lamp (20 feet bright, 20 dim); Tremorsense 30 feet underground (+20 if you already have it); Advantage on checks and saves to escape falling natural rock.

feat:stone-whisperer.description: +1 Wisdom. Cast Stone Shape without materials or a slot once per day (3 at level 10, 5 at 15, unlimited at 20). Tremorsense 10 feet.

feat:behaviourist.description: +1 Intelligence. Expertise in Animal Handling, and creatures you tame gain +1 to AC, attack rolls, and damage.

feat:crocodile-wrangler.description: +1 Strength or Constitution. Advantage on Animal Handling, Beasts have Disadvantage on saves against your Grapple, and a Small to Large Beast you grapple can't target you.

feat:volcanologist.description: +1 Intelligence or Constitution. Resistance to Fire. Study a visible volcano for 10 minutes to estimate when it will erupt, and the safe distance if within 7 days.

feat:action-hero.description: +1 Strength or Dexterity. When a bite or maw attack hits you, use your Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + your level. Your first failed Athletics check each day succeeds instead.

feat:arcane-enchanter.description: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. As an Action, enchant one touched item for 1 minute: a weapon deals +1d6 of a damage type your spells deal (+PB at 16); armor grants Resistance to one such type (two at 16); a wondrous item grants Advantage against one condition (two at 16). One enchantment at a time.

feature:feature:fighting-style.description:
You have honed your martial prowess and gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice (see "Feats"). Defense is recommended.

Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace the feat you chose with a different Fighting Style feat.

feature:metamagic:metamagic.description:
Because your magic flows from within, you can alter your spells to suit your needs; you gain two Metamagic options of your choice from "Metamagic Options" later in this class's description. You use the chosen options to temporarily modify spells you cast. To use an option, you must spend the number of Sorcery Points that it costs.

You can use only one Metamagic option on a spell when you cast it unless otherwise noted in one of those options.

Whenever you gain a Sorcerer level, you can replace one of your Metamagic options with one you don't know. You gain two more options at Sorcerer level 10 and two more at Sorcerer level 17.

feature:feature:eldritch-invocations.description:
You have unearthed Eldritch Invocations, pieces of forbidden knowledge that imbue you with an abiding magical ability or other lessons. You gain one invocation of your choice, such as Pact of the Tome. Invocations are described in the "Eldritch Invocation Options" section later in this class's description.

Prerequisites. If an invocation has a prerequisite, you must meet it to learn that invocation. For example, if an invocation requires you to be a level 5+ Warlock, you can select the invocation once you reach Warlock level 5.
