Changing Your Prepared Spells. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your list of prepared spells, replacing any of the spells there with spells from your spellbook.

Spellcasting Ability. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your Wizard spells.

Spellcasting Focus. You can use an Arcane Focus or your spellbook as a Spellcasting Focus for your Wizard spells.

> ### Expanding and Replacing a Spellbook

> The spells you add to your spellbook as you gain levels reflect your ongoing magical research, but you might find other spells during your adventures that you can add to the book. You could discover a Wizard spell on a Spell Scroll, for example, and then copy it into your spellbook.

>Copying a Spell into the Book. When you find a level 1+ Wizard spell, you can copy it into your spellbook if it's of a level you can prepare and if you have time to copy it. For each level of the spell, the transcription takes 2 hours and costs 50 GP. Afterward you can prepare the spell like the other spells in your spellbook.

> Copying the Book. You can copy a spell from your spellbook into another book. This is like copying a new spell into your spellbook but faster, since you already know how to cast the spell. You need spend only 1 hour and 10 GP for each level of the copied spell.

> If you lose your spellbook, you can use the same procedure to transcribe the Wizard spells that you have prepared into a new spellbook. Filling out the remainder of the new book requires you to find new spells to do so. For this reason, many wizards keep a backup spellbook.

feature:feature:scholar.description: While studying magic, you also specialized in another field of study. Choose one of the following skills in which you have proficiency: Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion. You have Expertise in the chosen skill.

feature:feature:memorize-spell.description: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, you can study your spellbook and replace one of the level 1+ Wizard spells you have prepared for your Spellcasting feature with another level 1+ spell from the book.

feature:feature:spell-mastery.description:
You have achieved such mastery over certain spells that you can cast them at will. Choose a level 1 and a level 2 spell in your spellbook that have a casting time of an action. You always have those spells prepared, and you can cast them at their lowest level without expending a spell slot. To cast either spell at a higher level, you must expend a spell slot.

Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can study your spellbook and replace one of those spells with an eligible spell of the same level from the book.

feature:feature:signature-spells.description: Choose two level 3 spells in your spellbook as your signature spells. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each of them once at level 3 without expending a spell slot. When you do so, you can't cast them in this way again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. To cast either spell at a higher level, you must expend a spell slot.

feature:feature:artificer:spellcasting.description: Half-caster preparing from the Artificer list with Intelligence, through Thieves' Tools, Tinker's Tools or Artisan's Tools as a focus (an M component). Two cantrips (three at level 10, four at 14), prepared spells from 2 at level 1 to 15 at level 20, slots up to level 5. Change prepared spells and one cantrip after a Long Rest.

feature:feature:tinker-s-magic.description: Mending cantrip. Magic action with Tinker's Tools: create a mundane item from a short list of adventuring gear within 5 feet; it lasts until your next Long Rest. INT mod uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:replicate-magic-item.description: Learn magic item plans (4 at level 2 rising to 8 at 18) from tiered plan tables (levels 2, 6, 10, 14). After a Long Rest with Tinker's Tools, create items from different plans you know, up to the Magic Items column (2 at level 2 rising to 6 at 18); you can attune on creation. Created wands and weapons work as spellcasting focuses. Swap one plan per Artificer level.

feature:feature:magic-item-tinker.description: For items from Replicate Magic Item: Charge (Bonus Action, spend a slot to restore that many charges), Drain (Bonus Action, turn an item into a level 1 or 2 slot, once per Long Rest), and Transmute (Magic action, turn it into another known plan, once per Long Rest).

feature:feature:flash-of-genius.description: Reaction when you or a creature within 30 feet fails an ability check or save: add INT mod (min +1). INT mod uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:magic-item-adept.description: Attune to up to four magic items.

feature:feature:spell-storing-item.description: After a Long Rest, store a level 1 to 3 action Artificer spell in a weapon or focus; a holder can cast it with a Magic action using your modifier, twice INT mod times (min 2), once per turn.

feature:feature:advanced-artifice.description: Attune to up to five magic items, and regain a Flash of Genius use on a Short Rest.

feature:feature:magic-item-master.description: Attune to up to six magic items.

feature:feature:soul-of-artifice.description: Cheat Death: at 0 Hit Points, destroy Uncommon or Rare Replicate items to return at 20 Hit Points per item. Magical Guidance: regain all Flash of Genius uses on a Short Rest while attuned to a magic item.

feature:feature:quick-draw.description: You roll Initiative with Advantage. You can also draw or stow two weapons without the Two-Handed property in the time it normally takes to draw or stow one.

feature:feature:gunslinger:weapon-master.description: Use the mastery properties of two kinds of Simple or Martial Ranged weapons you choose; swap one choice after a Long Rest. The number of kinds rises to 3 at Gunslinger level 4 and 4 at level 10 (Weapon Mastery column).

feature:feature:firearms.description: The class is built around the book's firearm rules. Firearms come in three eras the GM picks from: Renaissance (Blunderbuss 1d12, Musket 1d12, Pistol 1d10; all Martial with Loading), Industrial Age (Simple: Double-Barrel Shotgun 2d6, Hunting Rifle 2d6, Parlor Gun 2d4, Revolver 2d6; Martial: Cannon 2d8 Fire, Gatling Gun 2d6, Magnum 2d8) and Modern (Simple: Flare Gun 2d6 Fire, Handgun 2d4; Martial: Assault Rifle 2d6, Pump Shotgun 2d8, Sniper Rifle 2d8, Submachine Gun 2d4). New properties: Firearm (no ability modifier added to damage unless a rule says otherwise; ammunition is destroyed when fired), Recoil (after attacking with it you can't make ranged attacks past its normal range for the rest of the turn), and Reload (N) (N attacks between reloads; reloading takes an Action or, if proficient, a Bonus Action). New masteries: Automatic (make two attacks in place of one, both always at Disadvantage, can't be replaced, double ammunition), Explode (once per turn replace an attack with a 5-foot-radius Sphere within normal range, Dexterity save DC 8 + Strength or Dexterity modifier + Proficiency Bonus, weapon damage without a positive modifier, half on a success), Scatter (no Disadvantage on ranged attacks for having an enemy within 5 feet), and Sighted (long range imposes no Disadvantage, and on a long-range hit you may reroll any damage dice, keeping the new result).

feature:feature:critical-shot.description: Ranged weapon attacks score a Critical Hit on a d20 roll of 19 or 20; this widens to 18 to 20 at Gunslinger level 9 and 17 to 20 at level 17.

feature:feature:risk.description: You gain Risk Dice that fuel maneuvers: four d8s at level 2, five d8s at 6, five d10s at 10, six d10s at 14, and six d12s at 18. A die is spent when used, and all spent dice return on a Short or Long Rest. A maneuver that calls for a save uses DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your Proficiency Bonus.

feature:feature:maneuver-options.description: You know all of these maneuvers. Bite the Bullet: Bonus Action, spend 1 die to gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Gunslinger level. Blindfire: Bonus Action, spend 1 die for 30-foot Blindsight until the end of the turn. Dodge Roll: Bonus Action, spend 1 die to move up to 15 feet, ignoring Difficult Terrain and without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and reload any Ranged weapon you hold. Grazing Shot: once per turn when a ranged weapon attack misses, spend 1 die (no action) to deal the die roll plus your Dexterity modifier (minimum 1) of the weapon's damage type to the target; only a higher ability modifier can raise this damage. Maverick Spirit: once per turn when you fail an Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma check or save, spend 1 die and add it to the roll. Skin of Your Teeth: Reaction when a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, spend 1 die and add the roll to your AC against that attack.

feature:feature:gunslinger:extra-attack.description: Taking the Attack action on your turn lets you attack twice.

feature:feature:gut-shot.description: When you land a Critical Hit with a ranged weapon attack on a Large or smaller creature, the projectile stays lodged: for 1 minute the target's Speed is halved and it attacks with Disadvantage. The effect ends early if the target gives up one of its attacks to pull the projectile out.

feature:feature:gunslinger:evasion.description: On a Dexterity save against an effect that deals half damage on a success, you take no damage if you succeed and half if you fail. This doesn't work while you are Incapacitated.

feature:feature:overkill.description: Ranged weapon damage that wouldn't include your ability modifier (such as Firearm weapons) adds it anyway. If the damage already includes the modifier, the target instead takes an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's type.

feature:feature:cheat-death.description: When you drop to 0 Hit Points without being killed outright, you can go to 1 Hit Point instead and then regain Hit Points equal to your Gunslinger level. Once per Short or Long Rest.

feature:feature:dire-gambit.description: You regain one spent Risk Die each time you roll Initiative or score a Critical Hit.

feature:feature:deft-maneuver.description: Once on each of your turns you get an extra Bonus Action that can be used only for a maneuver.

feature:feature:headshot.description: When you score a Critical Hit with a Ranged weapon, you may declare it a Headshot: a target with fewer than 100 Hit Points dies, and any other target takes an extra 10d10 damage of the weapon's type. Once per Short or Long Rest, or restore the use by spending three Risk Dice (no action).

feature:feature:esoteric-eye.description: Bonus Action: study a creature you can see. Through the end of your next turn, your Magus spell attacks against it have Advantage and it makes saves against your Magus spells at Disadvantage. Uses equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1); one use returns on a Short Rest and all return on a Long Rest.

feature:feature:magus:spellcasting.description: Half-caster preparing from the Magus spell list with Intelligence. Two cantrips (three at level 10, four at 14), swapping one cantrip whenever you gain a Magus level. Prepared level 1+ spells run from 2 at level 1 to 20 at level 19, slots up to level 5 (see the class table), all slots back on a Long Rest. On each Magus level you may swap one prepared spell for another Magus spell you have slots for; always-prepared spells from Magus features don't count against your total.

feature:feature:magus:weapon-mastery.description: Use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons you are proficient with. You can change both choices after each Long Rest.

feature:feature:mystic-mark.description: Bonus Action: pick a prepared level 1+ Magus spell whose casting time is an action or Bonus Action, spend a slot of at least its level, and choose Force or one damage type the spell deals. Gain one benefit: Aegis (Resistance to that type) or Enspell (your weapon and Unarmed Strike damage can become that type). You can hold at most one Aegis and one Enspell at once. While a mark is active, a Bonus Action releases it and casts the stored spell; the mark and benefit last 1 hour or until the spell is released.

feature:feature:arcane-ability.description: After failing an ability check, add your Intelligence modifier plus the level of your highest unexpended spell slot to it, which can make it succeed. Once per Short or Long Rest, or restore the use by spending a spell slot (no action).

feature:feature:sword-and-sorcery.description: When you take the Attack action without benefiting from Extra Attack, you can also cast an action-time Magus cantrip as part of it. When you take the Magic action on your turn, you can make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:magical-recovery.description: Once per Long Rest, when you finish a Short Rest, recover expended slots whose levels total up to half your Magus level (round up); none can be level 6 or higher.

feature:feature:rite-of-return.description: If your Mystic Mark expires without the spell being released, you get the spent slot back. You can also end the mark as a Bonus Action and regain that slot.

feature:feature:all-seeing-eye.description: Once per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action spend an Esoteric Eye use to gain Truesight to 60 feet for 10 minutes; during that time Esoteric Eye's Bonus Action costs no uses.

feature:feature:sigil-surge.description: Mystic Mark improves. Aegis: at the start of each of your turns gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the spent slot's level plus your Intelligence modifier. Enspell: your weapon and Unarmed Strike damage deals an extra 1d6 of the chosen type.

feature:feature:sorcerous-shielding.description: Magic Resistance: Resistance to one of Force, Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant, and you can switch the type at the start of each of your turns. Spell Parry: Advantage on saves against spells, and spell attacks against you have Disadvantage.

feature:feature:spell-surge.description: Pick one level 6 Magus spell as your surge spell. Once per Long Rest you can cast it with no slot, and doing so also restores one expended slot of level 5 or lower of your choice.

feature:feature:archmagus.description: Intelligence and your choice of Strength or Dexterity each rise by 2, to a maximum of 23. Magical Recovery can be used twice, both uses returning on a Long Rest.

feature:feature:monster-grimoire.description: You keep a personal grimoire of monster lore. Pick two creature types from Aberrations, Beasts, Celestials, Constructs, Dragons, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, Giants, Monstrosities, Oozes, Plants, or Undead; you add your Proficiency Bonus to Intelligence and Wisdom checks about those types, or double it if you are already proficient in the skill involved. You also learn one language from the monster-type chart (Aberration or Ooze: Deep Speech or Undercommon; Beast, Fey, or Plant: Sylvan; Celestial: Celestial; Construct or Dragon: Draconic; Elemental: Primordial; Fiend or Undead: Abyssal or Infernal; Giant: Giant; Monstrosity: Deep Speech). If the grimoire is lost you keep its benefits, but you can't add to it or gain Monster Hunter levels until you rebuild it with 8 hours of work and 50 GP of materials.

feature:feature:monster-hunter:weapon-ma.description: Choose two kinds of weapons you are proficient with; you can use their mastery properties. After a Long Rest you may swap one choice. The number of kinds rises per the Weapon Mastery column (3 at level 5, 4 at level 11, 5 at level 17).

feature:feature:studied-response.description: When a creature you can see within 60 feet makes a melee or ranged attack against you or someone else, you can use your Reaction before the roll to make one weapon or Unarmed Strike attack against that creature. On a miss, your Reaction is restored.

feature:feature:monster-hunter-subclass-.description: Choose a guild subclass (Carver, Devourer, Occultist, or Trapper). It grants features at Monster Hunter levels 3, 7, 10, 15, and 18.

feature:feature:expert-strike.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to attack and damage rolls with your weapons and Unarmed Strikes.

feature:feature:improved-monster-grimoir.description: Add a third creature type you haven't already picked to your grimoire; all grimoire benefits extend to it. Your weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks against grimoire creature types now score a Critical Hit on a 19 or 20.

feature:feature:knowledgeable-defense.description: When a creature of a type in your grimoire forces you to make a saving throw, you can roll an Intelligence saving throw in its place.

feature:feature:monster-hunter:extra-att.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can attack twice.

feature:feature:monster-hunter:improved-.description: Add a fourth, previously unchosen creature type to your grimoire, gaining all grimoire benefits against it.

feature:feature:lair-sense.description: You have Advantage on saving throws against, and Resistance to damage from, any creature's lair actions and regional effects. You gain the same Advantage and Resistance against the Legendary Actions of creature types in your grimoire.

feature:feature:slayer-s-aid.description: When you use Studied Response, pick a Friendly creature that can see or hear you; it can spend its Reaction on one weapon or Unarmed Strike attack against the triggering creature, resolved after your attack but before the enemy's attack roll. If that ally has already used its Reaction, it regains it but must spend it on this attack. The ability renews at the start of your turn.

feature:feature:grave-strike.description: Your weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks against grimoire creature types score a Critical Hit on an 18 to 20. When you land such a Critical Hit, the target makes a Constitution saving throw with a DC equal to the damage dealt (maximum DC 30): on a failure it drops to 0 Hit Points, on a success it just takes the damage. Uses equal your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1), regained on a Long Rest.

feature:feature:fisticuffs.description: Pugilist weapons are Simple Melee weapons and improvised weapons. While unarmed or holding only Pugilist weapons, in Light or no armor and without a Shield: you can make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action; you may roll your Fisticuffs die (1d8, rising to 1d10 at level 5, 1d12 at 11, 2d6 at 17) instead of the normal damage of Unarmed Strikes and Pugilist weapons; and you can use mastery properties of improvised weapons, all of which have the Sap mastery for you.

feature:feature:iron-chin.description: In Light or no armor and without a Shield, your base AC is 12 + your Constitution modifier.

feature:feature:moxie.description: You have Moxie Points equal to the Moxie Points column (2 at level 2 rising to 12 at level 20), all regained on a Short or Long Rest. Brace Up (Bonus Action, 1 point): gain Temporary Hit Points equal to a Fisticuffs die roll + your Pugilist level + your Constitution modifier, lasting up to 10 minutes. One-Two Punch (1 point): make two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action. Stick and Move (Bonus Action, 1 point): make one Unarmed Strike and take the Dash or Disengage action.

feature:feature:bloodied-but-unbowed.description: Reaction when you take damage: regain every expended Moxie Point. If you are Bloodied at the time, also gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 4 times your Pugilist level, which last until you finish a Short Rest. Once per Short or Long Rest.

feature:feature:swagger-streak.description: After failing a Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, or Charisma check, spend 1 Moxie Point to roll your Fisticuffs die and add it to the total. If the check still fails, the point is refunded but this feature is unusable until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

feature:feature:heavy-hitter.description: On an Unarmed Strike hit, you can apply the Damage option and also either the Grapple or the Shove option.

feature:feature:dig-deep.description: Bonus Action: for 10 minutes you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage and ignore the effects of Exhaustion below level 6. Once per Long Rest, or take 1 Exhaustion level (no action) to restore the use.

feature:feature:pugilist:extra-attack.description: Attack twice, instead of once, when you take the Attack action on your turn.

feature:feature:haymaker.description: When attacking with an Unarmed Strike or Pugilist weapon, spend 1 Moxie Point: if the attack hits, it deals maximum damage and the point is refunded.

feature:feature:moxie-fueled-fists.description: Damage from your Unarmed Strikes and improvised weapon attacks can be Force or its normal type, your choice.

feature:feature:down-but-not-out.description: When you use Bloodied But Unbowed while Bloodied, for 1 minute your Unarmed Strikes and Pugilist weapon attacks gain a damage bonus equal to your Constitution modifier + your Exhaustion levels. Once per Long Rest.

feature:feature:school-of-hard-knocks.description: Once per turn, an Unarmed Strike or Pugilist weapon hit deals an extra 1d12 damage of the attack's type. Instead of the extra damage you can choose Endanger (the next attack to hit the target deals maximum damage dice) or Provoke (the target has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the end of your next turn).

feature:feature:herculean.description: Your Strength counts double for carrying capacity, your Unarmed Strike hits against objects are Critical Hits, and your jump distance doubles.

feature:feature:shake-it-off.description: At the start of your turn (no action), remove 1 Exhaustion level or end one of these on yourself: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Restrained, or Stunned. Once per Long Rest, or take 1 Exhaustion level (no action) to restore the use.

feature:feature:dig-deeper.description: Bonus Action: for 1 minute you get all Dig Deep benefits and can use School of Hard Knocks twice per turn. Once per Long Rest; twice per Long Rest from level 20.

feature:feature:unbreakable.description: Advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws. After failing any save, you can spend 1 Moxie Point to reroll it and must keep the new result.

feature:feature:pugnacious.description: On rolling Initiative, you can remove 1 Exhaustion level and regain your uses of Dig Deep, Down But Not Out, and Shake It Off. Once per Long Rest.

feature:feature:fighting-spirit.description: When dropped to 0 Hit Points without dying outright, you can go to 1 Hit Point instead, gaining Temporary Hit Points equal to half your Hit Point maximum, all expended Moxie Points, and Resistance to all damage but Force for 1 minute. Once per Long Rest.

feature:feature:peak-physical-condition.description: Strength and Constitution each rise by 2, to a maximum of 23. Finishing a Long Rest removes all Exhaustion levels. Finishing a Short Rest restores Hit Points equal to twice your Pugilist level.

feature:feature:improved-critical.description: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

feature:feature:remarkable-athlete.description: Thanks to your athleticism, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks.

feature:feature:additional-fighting-styl.description: You gain another Fighting Style feat of your choice.

feature:feature:heroic-warrior.description: The thrill of battle drives you toward victory. During combat, you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration whenever you start your turn without it.

feature:feature:superior-critical.description: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes can now score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18 - 20 on the d20.

feature:feature:survivor.description:
You attain the pinnacle of resilience in battle, giving you these benefits.

Defy Death. You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws. Moreover, when you roll 18 - 20 on a Death Saving Throw, you gain the benefit of rolling a 20 on it.

Heroic Rally. At the start of each of your turns, you regain Hit Points equal to 5 plus your Constitution modifier if you are Bloodied and have at least 1 Hit Point.

feature:feature:circle-of-the-land-spell.description:
Whenever you finish a Long Rest, choose one type of land: arid, polar, temperate, or tropical. Consult the table below that corresponds to the chosen type; you have the spells listed for your Druid level and lower prepared.

Table: Arid Land

|Druid Level|Circle Spells|
|---|---|
|3|Blur, Burning Hands, Fire Bolt|
|5|Fireball|
|7|Blight|
|9|Wall of Stone|

Table: Polar Land
|Druid Level|Circle Spells|
|---|---|
|3|Fog Cloud, Hold Person, Ray of Frost|
|5|Sleet Storm|
|7|Ice Storm|
|9|Cone of Cold|

Table: Temperate Land
|Druid Level|Circle Spells|
|---|---|
|3|Misty Step, Shocking Grasp, Sleep|
|5|Lightning Bolt|
|7|Freedom of Movement|
|9|Tree Stride|

Table: Tropical Land
|Druid Level|Circle Spells|
|---|---|
|3|Acid Splash, Ray of Sickness, Web|
|5|Stinking Cloud|
|7|Polymorph|
|9|Insect Plague|

feature:feature:land-s-aid.description:
As a Magic action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape and choose a point within 60 feet of yourself. Vitality-giving flowers and life-draining thorns appear for a moment in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Each creature of your choice in the Sphere must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 2d6 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. One creature of your choice in that area regains 2d6 Hit Points.

The damage and healing increase by 1d6 when you reach Druid levels 10 (3d6) and 14 (4d6).

feature:feature:natural-recovery.description:
You can cast one of the level 1+ spells that you have prepared from your Circle Spells feature without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you do so again.

In addition, when you finish a Short Rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your Druid level (round up), and none of them can be level 6+. For example, if you're a level 6 Druid, you can recover up to three levels' worth of spell slots. You can recover a level 3 spell slot, a level 2 and a level 1 spell slot, or three level 1 spell slots. Once you recover spell slots with this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

feature:feature:nature-s-ward.description:
As a Magic action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape and cause spectral trees and vines to appear in a 15-foot Cube on the ground within 120 feet of yourself. They last there for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition or die. You and your allies have Half Cover while in that area, and your allies gain the current Resistance of your Nature's Ward while there.

As a Bonus Action, you can move the Cube up to 60 feet to ground within 120 feet of yourself.

feature:feature:nature-s-sanctuary.description:
You can cast one of the level 1+ spells that you have prepared from your Circle Spells feature without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you do so again.

In addition, when you finish a Short Rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your Druid level (round up), and none of them can be level 6+. For example, if you're a level 6 Druid, you can recover up to three levels' worth of spell slots. You can recover a level 3 spell slot, a level 2 and a level 1 spell slot, or three level 1 spell slots. Once you recover spell slots with this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

feature:feature:bonus-proficiencies.description: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

feature:feature:cutting-words.description: You learn to use your wit to supernaturally distract, confuse, and otherwise sap the confidence and competence of others. When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, you can take a Reaction to expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration; roll your Bardic Inspiration die, and subtract the number rolled from the creature's roll, reducing the damage or potentially turning the success into a failure.

feature:feature:magical-discoveries.description:
You learn two spells of your choice. These spells can come from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list or any combination thereof (see a class's section for its spell list). A spell you choose must be a cantrip or a spell for which you have spell slots, as shown in the Bard Features table.

You always have the chosen spells prepared, and whenever you gain a Bard level, you can replace one of the spells with another spell that meets these requirements.

feature:feature:peerless-skill.description: When you make an ability check or attack roll and fail, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration; roll the Bardic Inspiration die, and add the number rolled to the d20, potentially turning a failure into a success. On a failure, the Bardic Inspiration isn't expended.

feature:feature:draconic-resilience.description:
The magic in your body manifests physical traits of your draconic gift. Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and it increases by 1 whenever you gain another Sorcerer level.

Parts of you are also covered by dragon-like scales. While you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.

feature:feature:draconic-spells.description:
When you reach a Sorcerer level specified in the Draconic Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Table: Draconic Spells

|Sorcerer Level|Spells|
|---|---|
|3|Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon's Breath|
|5|Fear, Fly|
|7|Arcane Eye, Charm Monster|
|9|Legend Lore, Summon Dragon|

feature:feature:elemental-affinity.description:
Your draconic magic has an affinity with a damage type associated with dragons. Choose one of those types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.

You have Resistance to that damage type, and when you cast a spell that deals damage of that type, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

feature:feature:dragon-wings.description:
As a Bonus Action, you can cause draconic wings to appear on your back. The wings last for 1 hour or until you dismiss them (no action required). For the duration, you have a Fly Speed of 60 feet.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you spend 3 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

feature:feature:dragon-companion.description:
You can cast Summon Dragon without a Material component. You can also cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest.

Whenever you start casting the spell, you can modify it so that it doesn't require Concentration. If you do so, the spell's duration becomes 1 minute for that casting.

feature:feature:evocation-savant.description:
Choose two Wizard spells from the Evocation school, each of which must be no higher than level 2, and add them to your spellbook for free.

In addition, whenever you gain access to a new level of spell slots in this class, you can add one Wizard spell from the Evocation school to your spellbook for free. The chosen spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

feature:feature:potent-cantrip.description: Your damaging cantrips affect even creatures that avoid the brunt of the effect. When you cast a cantrip at a creature and you miss with the attack roll or the target succeeds on a saving throw against the cantrip, the target takes half the cantrip's damage (if any) but suffers no additional effect from the cantrip.

feature:feature:sculpt-spells.description: You can create pockets of relative safety within the effects of your evocations. When you cast an Evocation spell that affects other creatures that you can see, you can choose a number of them equal to 1 plus the spell's level. The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their saving throws against the spell, and they take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.

feature:feature:empowered-evocation.description: Whenever you cast a Wizard spell from the Evocation school, you can add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

feature:feature:overchannel.description:
You can increase the power of your spells. When you cast a Wizard spell with a spell slot of levels 1 - 5 that deals damage, you can deal maximum damage with that spell on the turn you cast it.

The first time you do so, you suffer no adverse effect. If you use this feature again before you finish a Long Rest, you take 2d12 Necrotic damage for each level of the spell slot immediately after you cast it. This damage ignores Resistance and Immunity.

Each time you use this feature again before finishing a Long Rest, the Necrotic damage per spell level increases by 1d12.

feature:feature:dark-one-s-blessing.description: When you reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Warlock level (minimum of 1 Temporary Hit Point). You also gain this benefit if someone else reduces an enemy within 10 feet of you to 0 Hit Points.

feature:feature:fiend-spells.description:
The magic of your patron ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Warlock level specified in the Fiend Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Table: Fiend Spells

|Warlock Level|Spells|
|---|---|
|3|Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, Suggestion|
|5|Fireball, Stinking Cloud|
|7|Fire Shield, Wall of Fire|
|9|Geas, Insect Plague|

feature:feature:dark-one-s-own-luck.description:
You can call on your fiendish patron to alter fate in your favor. When you make an ability check or a saving throw, you can use this feature to add 1d10 to your roll. You can do so after seeing the roll but before any of the roll's effects occur.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), but you can use it no more than once per roll. You regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

feature:feature:fiendish-resilience.description: Choose one damage type, other than Force, whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest. You have Resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one with this feature.

feature:feature:hurl-through-hell.description:
Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can try to instantly transport the target through the Lower Planes. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC, or the target disappears and hurtles through a nightmare landscape. The target takes 8d10 Psychic damage if it isn't a Fiend, and it has the Incapacitated condition until the end of your next turn, when it returns to the space it previously occupied or the nearest unoccupied space.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you expend a Pact Magic spell slot (no action required) to restore your use of it.

feature:feature:hunter-s-lore.description: You can call on the forces of nature to reveal certain strengths and weaknesses of your prey. While a creature is marked by your Hunter's Mark, you know whether that creature has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, and if the creature has any, you know what they are.

feature:feature:hunter-s-prey.description:
You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

Colossus Slayer. Your tenacity can wear down even the most resilient foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon, the weapon deals an extra 1d8 damage to the target if it's missing any of its Hit Points. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

Horde Breaker. Once on each of your turns when you make an attack with a weapon, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target, that is within the weapon's range, and that you haven't attacked this turn.

feature:feature:defensive-tactics.description:
You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

Escape the Horde. Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.

Multiattack Defense. When a creature hits you with an attack roll, that creature has Disadvantage on all other attack rolls against you this turn.

feature:feature:superior-hunter-s-prey.description: Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature marked by your Hunter's Mark, you can also deal that spell's extra damage to a different creature that you can see within 30 feet of the first creature.

feature:feature:superior-hunter-s-defens.description: When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to give yourself Resistance to that damage and any other damage of the same type until the end of the current turn.

feature:feature:disciple-of-life.description: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains additional Hit Points on the turn you cast the spell. The additional Hit Points equal 2 plus the spell slot's level.

feature:feature:life-domain-spells.description:
Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Life Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Table: Life Domain Spells

|Cleric Level|Prepared Spells|
|---|---|
|3|Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration|
|5|Mass Healing Word, Revivify|
|7|Aura of Life, Death Ward|
|9|Greater Restoration, Mass Cure Wounds|

feature:feature:preserve-life.description: As a Magic action, you present your Holy Symbol and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to evoke healing energy that can restore a number of Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level. Choose Bloodied creatures within 30 feet of yourself (which can include you), and divide those Hit Points among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half its Hit Point maximum.

feature:feature:blessed-healer.description: The healing spells you cast on others heal you as well. Immediately after you cast a spell with a spell slot that restores Hit Points to one or more creatures other than yourself, you regain Hit Points equal to 2 plus the spell slot's level.

feature:feature:supreme-healing.description: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore Hit Points to a creature with a spell or Channel Divinity, don't roll those dice for the healing; instead use the highest number possible for each die. For example, instead of restoring 2d6 Hit Points to a creature with a spell, you restore 12.

feature:feature:sacred-weapon.description:
When you take the Attack action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to imbue one Melee weapon that you are holding with positive energy. For 10 minutes or until you use this feature again, you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls you make with that weapon (minimum bonus of +1), and each time you hit with it, you cause it to deal its normal damage type or Radiant damage.

The weapon also emits Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light 20 feet beyond that.

You can end this effect early (no action required). This effect also ends if you aren't carrying the weapon.

feature:feature:oath-of-devotion-spells.description:
The magic of your oath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of Devotion Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Table: Oath of Devotion Spells

|Paladin Level|Spells|
|---|---|
|3|Protection from Evil and Good, Shield of Faith|
|5|Aid, Zone of Truth|
|9|Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic|
|13|Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith|
|17|Commune, Flame Strike|

feature:feature:aura-of-devotion.description: You and your allies have Immunity to the Charmed condition while in your Aura of Protection. If a Charmed ally enters the aura, that condition has no effect on that ally while there.

feature:feature:smite-of-protection.description: Your magical smite now radiates protective energy. Whenever you cast Divine Smite, you and your allies have Half Cover while in your Aura of Protection. The aura has this benefit until the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:holy-nimbus.description:
As a Bonus Action, you can imbue your Aura of Protection with holy power, granting the benefits below for 10 minutes or until you end them (no action required). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 5 spell slot (no action required).

Holy Ward. You have Advantage on any saving throw you are forced to make by a Fiend or an Undead.

Radiant Damage. Whenever an enemy starts its turn in the aura, that creature takes Radiant damage equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus.

Sunlight. The aura is filled with Bright Light that is sunlight.

feature:feature:frenzy.description: If you use Reckless Attack while your Rage is active, you deal extra damage to the first target you hit on your turn with a Strength-based attack. To determine the extra damage, roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and add them together. The damage has the same type as the weapon or Unarmed Strike used for the attack.

feature:feature:mindless-rage.description: You have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions while your Rage is active. If you're Charmed or Frightened when you enter your Rage, the condition ends on you.

feature:feature:retaliation.description: When you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against that creature, using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

feature:feature:intimidating-presence.description:
As a Bonus Action, you can strike terror into others with your menacing presence and primal power. When you do so, each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the Frightened creature's turns, the creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you expend a use of your Rage (no action required) to restore your use of it.

feature:feature:fast-hands.description:
As a Bonus Action, you can do one of the following.

Sleight of Hand. Make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to pick a lock or disarm a trap with Thieves' Tools or to pick a pocket.

Use an Object. Take the Utilize action, or take the Magic action to use a magic item that requires that action.

feature:feature:second-story-work.description:
You've trained to get into especially hard-to-reach places, granting you these benefits.

Climber. You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

Jumper. You can determine your jump distance using your Dexterity rather than your Strength.

feature:feature:supreme-sneak.description: You gain the following Cunning Strike option. Stealth Attack (Cost: 1d6). If you have the Hide action's Invisible condition, this attack doesn't end that condition on you if you end the turn behind Three-Quarters Cover or Total Cover.

feature:feature:use-magic-device.description:
You've learned how to maximize use of magic items, granting you the following benefits.

Attunement. You can attune to up to four magic items at once.

Charges. Whenever you use a magic item property that expends charges, roll 1d6. On a roll of 6, you use the property without expending the charges.

Scrolls. You can use any Spell Scroll, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability for the spell. If the spell is a cantrip or a level 1 spell, you can cast it reliably. If the scroll contains a higher-level spell, you must first succeed on an Intelligence (Arcana) check (DC 10 plus the spell's level). On a successful check, you cast the spell from the scroll. On a failed check, the scroll disintegrates.

feature:feature:thief-s-reflexes.description: You are adept at laying ambushes and quickly escaping danger. You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal Initiative and your second turn at your Initiative minus 10.

feature:feature:open-hand-technique.description:
Whenever you hit a creature with an attack granted by your Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of the following effects on that target.

Addle. The target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

Push. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from you.

Topple. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition.

feature:feature:wholeness-of-body.description:
You gain the ability to heal yourself. As a Bonus Action, you can roll your Martial Arts die. You regain a number of Hit Points equal to the number rolled plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1 Hit Point regained).

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

feature:feature:fleet-step.description: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also use Step of the Wind immediately after that Bonus Action.

feature:feature:quivering-palm.description:
You gain the ability to set up lethal vibrations in someone's body. When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you can expend 4 Focus Points to start these imperceptible vibrations, which last for a number of days equal to your Monk level. The vibrations are harmless unless you take an action to end them. Alternatively, when you take the Attack action on your turn, you can forgo one of the attacks to end the vibrations. To end them, you and the target must be on the same plane of existence. When you end them, the target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d12 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

You can have only one creature under the effect of this feature at a time. You can end the vibrations harmlessly (no action required).

feature:feature:arcana-domain-spells.description: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Detect Magic, Magic Missile, Magic Weapon, Nystul's Magic Aura; 5 Counterspell, Dispel Magic; 7 Arcane Eye, Leomund's Secret Chest; 9 Bigby's Hand, Teleportation Circle.

feature:feature:modify-magic.description: Spend a Channel Divinity use as you cast a spell (no action). Fortifying Spell: one target gains 2d8 + Cleric level Temporary Hit Points. Tenacious Spell: a creature that succeeds on a save against your spell takes a 1d6 penalty on its first save against the spell's effect.

feature:feature:student-of-arcana.description: Gain Arcana proficiency (or another level 1 Cleric skill) and two Wizard cantrips; swap one cantrip for another Wizard cantrip whenever you gain a Cleric level.

feature:feature:dispelling-recovery.description: Right after a slot-cast spell restores HP or ends a condition, cast Dispel Magic as part of the same action, Bonus Action, or Reaction with no slot. Once per Short or Long Rest; a Channel Divinity use recharges it.

feature:feature:magical-mastery.description: Learn one Wizard spell each of levels 6, 7, 8, and 9; they are always prepared, and you can swap one for another of the same level when you gain a Cleric level.

feature:feature:arcane-archer-lore.description: Learn Druidcraft or Prestidigitation (Intelligence). Gain Arcana and Nature proficiency, substituting other Fighter skills for any you already have.

feature:feature:arcane-shot.description: Know two Arcane Shot options (one more at Fighter 7, 10, 15, and 18, swapping one each time). Once per turn on a damaging ranged hit with an Ammunition weapon, apply an option. Uses equal to Intelligence modifier (min 1) per Short or Long Rest. Arcane Shot Die d6, rising to d8 (10), d10 (15), d12 (18). Save DC 8 + Intelligence modifier + Proficiency Bonus.

feature:feature:banishing-shot.description: Arcane Shot option. +1 Arcane Shot Die Psychic; Charisma save or the target is banished, Incapacitated with Speed 0, returning at the end of its next turn.

feature:feature:beguiling-shot.description: Arcane Shot option. +2 Arcane Shot Dice Psychic; Wisdom save or Charmed by you or an ally within 30 feet of it until your next turn, ending early if the charmer harms it.

feature:feature:bursting-shot.description: Arcane Shot option. The target and every creature in a 10-foot Emanation around it take 2 Arcane Shot Dice of Force damage.

feature:feature:enfeebling-shot.description: Arcane Shot option. +2 Arcane Shot Dice Necrotic; Constitution save or Poisoned until the end of its next turn, subtracting 1 Arcane Shot Die from each of its hits' damage.

feature:feature:grasping-shot.description: Arcane Shot option. +1 Arcane Shot Die Slashing; Strength save or Restrained for 1 minute. An Athletics check against your DC (as an action) frees it.

feature:feature:piercing-shot.description: Arcane Shot option. No attack roll: a 30-foot Line that ignores cover. Dexterity save: normal hit damage plus 2 Arcane Shot Dice Piercing, half on a success.

feature:feature:seeking-shot.description: Arcane Shot option. No attack roll: pick a creature seen in the last minute and the shot curves to it, ignoring Half and Three-Quarters Cover. Dexterity save: hit damage plus 2 Arcane Shot Dice Force and you learn its location, half on a success.

feature:feature:shadow-shot.description: Arcane Shot option. +1 Arcane Shot Die Psychic; Wisdom save or Blinded until the end of its next turn.

feature:feature:curving-shot.description: After a ranged Ammunition attack misses, use a Bonus Action to redirect it at another creature within 60 feet of the first target and roll a new attack.

feature:feature:magical-ammunition.description: Magic action: fire enchanted ammunition at a surface. Darkening (15-foot shadow, -5 Perception, douses flames, 1 minute), Unlocking (opens one nonmagical lock or bar per object in 15 feet, loudly), or Vine (120-foot climbable vine for 10 minutes). Once per Short or Long Rest, or spend a Second Wind use.

feature:feature:ever-ready-shot.description: Regain one expended Arcane Shot use when you roll Initiative.

feature:feature:indomitable-teleport.description: When Indomitable turns a failed save into a success, teleport up to 60 feet to a space you can see.

feature:feature:masterful-shots.description: Reaction when a creature misses you: move up to half your Speed without provoking, then make a ranged attack against it if it's in range.

feature:feature:warrior-of-the-mystic-ar.description: Third-caster using the Sorcerer list and Wisdom, with an Arcane Focus allowed. Two Sorcerer cantrips (a third at Monk 10). Prepared spells grow from 3 at Monk 3 to 13 at Monk 20, with slots up to level 4 (level 4 at Monk 19). Swap one prepared spell per Monk level. Counts one third of Monk levels for multiclass slots.

feature:feature:mystic-fighting-style.description: When you take the Attack action, one Unarmed Strike can be replaced with an action-cast Sorcerer cantrip.

feature:feature:mystic-focus.description: Expend a spell slot to regain Focus Points equal to its level. On a Short Rest or Uncanny Metabolism, spend Focus Points to recover one slot: level 1 for 2 FP (Monk 6), 2 for 3 FP (Monk 7), 3 for 5 FP (Monk 13), 4 for 6 FP (Monk 19).

feature:feature:focused-strike.description: A Stunning Strike target, whether it saves or not, has Disadvantage on saves against your spells until the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:improved-mystic-fighting.description: With Flurry of Blows, swap two Unarmed Strikes for an action-cast level 1 or 2 Sorcerer spell, cast as part of that Bonus Action.

feature:feature:vestige-companion.description: A Small Celestial, Fiend, or Undead companion (AC 13 + Charisma modifier, HP 4 + 4 per Warlock level, Fly 30 hover) acts on your turn. It Dodges unless you spend a Bonus Action, or give up one of your attacks, to have it act. Vestige's Strike: spell-attack, 5 feet or 60 feet, 1d6 + 3 + Charisma modifier damage of its type. Divine Power once per day: Undead curse (Disadvantage attacking you and it), Fiend place-swap within 60 feet, or Celestial heal 2d8 + Charisma modifier and end Blinded, Deafened, or Poisoned. Re-manifest with a 1-minute ceremony; reshape it on a Long Rest.

feature:feature:vestige-spells.description: Choose the Life, Light, Trickery, or War domain. Its domain spells count as Warlock spells and are always prepared when your Warlock level reaches the listed Cleric level.

feature:feature:vestige-power.description: Divine Power recharges on a Short or Long Rest or when you use Magical Cunning. Within 30 feet of the vestige, you share its damage Resistance.

feature:feature:vestige-recovery.description: Reaction when the vestige would drop to 0 HP: spend a Pact Magic slot to restore it to full HP and teleport it 30 feet. Once per Long Rest.

feature:feature:semblance-of-life.description: Magic action, vestige within 90 feet: for 1 hour it becomes a Celestial, Fiendish, or Undead Spirit from the matching Summon spell at half your Warlock level (max 9), keeping its personality, Divine Power, HP, and Hit Dice, plus Temporary Hit Points equal to the spirit's HP. Once per Long Rest.

feature:feature:benign-transposition.description: Bonus Action: teleport 30 feet, or swap places with a willing Medium or smaller creature in range. Uses equal to Intelligence modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

feature:feature:conjuration-savant.description: Add two Conjuration spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, plus one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

feature:feature:distant-transposition.description: Benign Transposition reaches 60 feet, and a level 3+ slot restores one use.

feature:feature:durable-summons.description: Creatures you summon or create with a slot-cast Conjuration spell arrive with Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wizard level, and resist all damage except Force, Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant while those last.

feature:feature:focused-conjuration.description: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on Conjuration spells.

feature:feature:splintered-summons.description: When a slot-cast spell summons a spirit with its own stat block (Summon Aberration and the like), summon two at half HP each. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a level 5+ slot.

feature:feature:enchanting-conversationa.description: Gain Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion proficiency and add your Intelligence modifier (min +1) to checks with it.

feature:feature:enchantment-savant.description: Add two Enchantment spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, plus one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

feature:feature:hypnotic-presence.description: Magic action, creature within 10 feet that can see or hear you: Wisdom save or Charmed, Incapacitated, and Speed 0 for up to 1 minute (ends if it moves beyond 10 feet, loses sight and sound of you, or takes damage). Uses equal to Intelligence modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

feature:feature:split-enchantment.description: When slot-casting an Enchantment spell that adds targets at higher levels, treat it as one level higher. Uses equal to Intelligence modifier per Long Rest.

feature:feature:instinctive-charm.description: Reaction when a creature within 30 feet hits you: Wisdom save or the attack misses and is redirected, with the same roll, to another creature in range of your choice. Once per Long Rest; recharges when you slot-cast an Enchantment spell.

feature:feature:alter-memories.description: One creature you Charm with a slot-cast Enchantment spell doesn't know it was Charmed. Once during the spell, a Magic action forces an Intelligence save; on a failure it loses up to 1 + Intelligence modifier hours of memory, within the spell's duration.

feature:feature:necromancy-savant.description: Add two Necromancy spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, plus one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

feature:feature:necromancy-spellbook.description: Resistance to Necrotic damage. Find Familiar enters your spellbook with Skeleton or Zombie forms (or any form as Undead), and you can give up an attack for the familiar to attack with its Reaction. Undead Vitality: a slot-cast Necromancy spell heals an Undead within 60 feet for the slot level + your Wizard level.

feature:feature:grave-power.description: While holding your spellbook: Arcane Recovery also removes 1 Exhaustion level, and your Wizard spells and features ignore Necrotic Resistance.

feature:feature:undead-thralls.description: Animate Dead is always prepared, castable free once per Long Rest, and always cast one level higher. While holding your spellbook, undead you create or summon gain extra HP equal to Intelligence modifier + half your Wizard level, and your undead within 60 feet add your Intelligence modifier (min 1) in Necrotic damage to their hits.

feature:feature:harvest-undead.description: Reaction when damage leaves you Bloodied but above 0 HP: drop one of your visible undead to 0 HP and regain HP equal to your Wizard level.

feature:feature:death-s-master.description: While holding your spellbook. Bolster Undead: once per Long Rest, a Bonus Action gives your necromancy-made undead within 60 feet Temporary Hit Points equal to your Wizard level. Extinguish Undead: an undead you see dropping to 0 HP explodes in a 10-foot Emanation (d6s equal to half its remaining Hit Dice, Dexterity save for half, no Reactions on a failure); one you don't control costs a Reaction and a level 5+ slot.

feature:feature:transmutation-savant.description: Add two Transmutation spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, plus one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

feature:feature:transmuter-s-stone.description: On a Long Rest, make a stone (also a Spellcasting Focus). Its bearer gains Constitution save proficiency plus one of: Darkvision 60 feet (or +60), Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder, or +10 Speed. Change the benefit when you slot-cast a Transmutation spell.

feature:feature:wondrous-alteration.description: Alter Self is always prepared and castable free once per Long Rest, with bonuses: Dash as a Bonus Action underwater, Advantage on Deception checks while disguised, or 2d6 natural weapons plus Advantage on Concentration saves.

feature:feature:empowered-transmutation.description: Slot-cast Transmutation spells that make no attack roll and force no save count as one level higher. Uses equal to Intelligence modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

feature:feature:potent-stone.description: Your stone carries two benefits (Resistance can be taken twice for different types), and adds Mighty Build (Advantage on Strength saves, carry as one size larger) and Tremorsense 30 feet to the options.

feature:feature:shape-shifter.description: Polymorph is always prepared and castable free once per Long Rest. Once per Long Rest, polymorphing yourself lets you keep your mind, mental scores, proficiencies, class features, and feats, and cast Transmutation spells without costly or consumed materials.

feature:feature:master-transmuter.description: Magic action: spend the stone's power (a level 7+ slot keeps it intact). Major Transformation (10 minutes to turn a nonmagical object up to a 10-foot Cube into another of similar size and equal or lesser value), Panacea (heal half max HP, cure magical contagions and curses, end Poisoned and Petrified), Restore Life (free Raise Dead), or Restore Youth (Exhaustion to 0, 3d10 years younger).

feature:feature:animal-speaker.description: Cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals as Rituals only, using Wisdom.

feature:feature:rage-of-the-wilds.description: Each time you Rage pick one: Bear (Resistance to all damage but Force, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant), Eagle (Disengage and Dash as part of the Rage Bonus Action, and as a Bonus Action while raging), or Wolf (allies have Advantage on attacks against enemies within 5 feet of you).

feature:feature:aspect-of-the-wilds.description: Pick one, changeable after a Long Rest: Owl (Darkvision 60 feet, or +60 if you have it), Panther (Climb Speed equal to Speed), or Salmon (Swim Speed equal to Speed).

feature:feature:nature-speaker.description: Cast Commune with Nature as a Ritual only, using Wisdom.

feature:feature:power-of-the-wilds.description: Each time you Rage pick one: Falcon (Fly Speed equal to Speed while unarmored), Lion (enemies within 5 feet have Disadvantage attacking anyone but you), or Ram (melee hits can knock a Large or smaller creature Prone).

feature:feature:vitality-of-the-tree.description: Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Barbarian level when you Rage. While raging, at the start of each turn give another creature within 10 feet Temporary Hit Points equal to a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus; they vanish when the Rage ends.

feature:feature:branches-of-the-tree.description: Reaction while raging when a creature starts its turn within 30 feet: Strength save (DC 8 + Strength mod + Proficiency Bonus) or it is teleported next to you, and you can drop its Speed to 0 for the turn.

feature:feature:battering-roots.description: On your turn, +10 feet reach with Heavy or Versatile melee weapons, and a hit can also apply Push or Topple alongside the weapon's other mastery.

feature:feature:travel-along-the-tree.description: Teleport up to 60 feet when you Rage and as a Bonus Action while raging. Once per Rage, make it 150 feet and bring up to six willing creatures within 10 feet.

feature:feature:divine-fury.description: While raging, the first creature you hit each turn with a weapon or Unarmed Strike takes an extra 1d6 + half your Barbarian level, Necrotic or Radiant.

feature:feature:warrior-of-the-gods.description: A pool of four d12s (5 at level 6, 6 at 12, 7 at 17) to spend as a Bonus Action healing yourself; refills on a Long Rest.

feature:feature:fanatical-focus.description: Once per Rage, reroll a failed save with a bonus equal to your Rage Damage bonus.

feature:feature:zealous-presence.description: Bonus Action: up to ten creatures within 60 feet gain Advantage on attacks and saves until your next turn. Once per Long Rest, or restore it by spending a Rage use.

feature:feature:rage-of-the-gods.description: When you Rage, become a divine warrior for 1 minute, once per Long Rest: fly and hover at your Speed, Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant, and a Reaction plus a Rage use to set a creature within 30 feet dropping to 0 Hit Points to your Barbarian level instead.

feature:feature:dazzling-footwork.description: Without armor or a Shield: Advantage on dance Performance checks, AC 10 + DEX + CHA, an Unarmed Strike whenever you spend Bardic Inspiration as part of an action, Bonus Action or Reaction, and Unarmed Strikes that use DEX and deal your Bardic Inspiration die + DEX Bludgeoning.

feature:feature:inspiring-movement.description: Reaction when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet: spend Bardic Inspiration to move half your Speed, and an ally within 30 feet can use its Reaction to do the same, without Opportunity Attacks.

feature:feature:tandem-footwork.description: When you roll Initiative, spend Bardic Inspiration: you and allies within 30 feet add the die roll to Initiative.

feature:feature:leading-evasion.description: Dexterity saves for half damage: none on a success, half on a failure, and creatures within 5 feet making the same save share it.

feature:feature:beguiling-magic.description: Charm Person and Mirror Image always prepared. After casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell with a slot, a creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed or Frightened for 1 minute (repeats each turn). Once per Long Rest, or restore it with Bardic Inspiration.

feature:feature:mantle-of-inspiration.description: Bonus Action, spend Bardic Inspiration: up to CHA mod creatures within 60 feet gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice the die roll and can move their Speed as a Reaction without Opportunity Attacks.

feature:feature:mantle-of-majesty.description: Command always prepared. Bonus Action: cast Command without a slot and keep casting it as a Bonus Action for 1 minute while concentrating; your Charmed targets auto-fail. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a level 3+ slot.

feature:feature:unbreakable-majesty.description: Bonus Action for 1 minute: the first attack roll that hits you each turn misses unless the attacker passes a Charisma save. Once per Short or Long Rest.

feature:feature:combat-inspiration.description: A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration can add the die to its AC against a hit (Reaction) or to the damage of a hit.

feature:feature:martial-training.description: Proficiency with Martial weapons, training with Medium armor and Shields, and Simple or Martial weapons work as a Bard Spellcasting Focus.

feature:feature:college-of-valor:extra-a.description: Attack twice with the Attack action, and one attack can be an action cantrip.

feature:feature:battle-magic.description: After casting an action spell, make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:light-domain-spells.description: Always prepared: Burning Hands, Faerie Fire, Scorching Ray, See Invisibility (3); Daylight, Fireball (5); Arcane Eye, Wall of Fire (7); Flame Strike, Scrying (9).

feature:feature:radiance-of-the-dawn.description: Magic action, spend Channel Divinity: a 30-foot Emanation dispels magical Darkness, and chosen creatures make a Constitution save for 2d10 + Cleric level Radiant, half on a success.

feature:feature:warding-flare.description: Reaction: impose Disadvantage on an attack roll by a creature within 30 feet. WIS mod uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:improved-warding-flare.description: Warding Flare recharges on a Short Rest too, and its target gains 2d6 + WIS mod Temporary Hit Points.

feature:feature:corona-of-light.description: Magic action: 60-foot Bright Light aura for 1 minute; enemies in it have Disadvantage on saves against Radiance of the Dawn and Fire or Radiant spells. WIS mod uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:blessing-of-the-trickste.description: Magic action: you or a willing creature within 30 feet has Advantage on Stealth checks until your next Long Rest or until you use it again.

feature:feature:trickery-domain-spells.description: Always prepared: Charm Person, Disguise Self, Invisibility, Pass without Trace (3); Hypnotic Pattern, Nondetection (5); Confusion, Dimension Door (7); Dominate Person, Modify Memory (9).

feature:feature:invoke-duplicity.description: Bonus Action, spend Channel Divinity: an illusory double within 30 feet for 1 minute. Cast spells from its space, gain Advantage against creatures within 5 feet of both of you, and move it 30 feet as a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:trickster-s-transpositio.description: When you create or move the double, you can swap places with it.

feature:feature:improved-duplicity.description: You and allies have Advantage attacking creatures within 5 feet of the double, and when it ends you or a creature within 5 feet of it regains Hit Points equal to your Cleric level.

feature:feature:guided-strike.description: Spend Channel Divinity to add +10 to a missed attack roll by you or (as a Reaction) a creature within 30 feet.

feature:feature:war-domain-spells.description: Always prepared: Guiding Bolt, Magic Weapon, Shield of Faith, Spiritual Weapon (3); Crusader's Mantle, Spirit Guardians (5); Fire Shield, Freedom of Movement (7); Hold Monster, Steel Wind Strike (9).

feature:feature:war-priest.description: Bonus Action weapon attack or Unarmed Strike, WIS mod uses per Short or Long Rest.

feature:feature:war-god-s-blessing.description: Spend Channel Divinity to cast Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon without a slot and without Concentration, lasting 1 minute.

feature:feature:avatar-of-battle.description: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.

feature:feature:circle-forms.description: Wild Shape forms up to CR Druid level / 3, AC at least 13 + WIS mod, and Temporary Hit Points equal to three times your Druid level.

feature:feature:circle-of-the-moon-spell.description: Always prepared, and castable in Wild Shape: Cure Wounds, Moonbeam, Starry Wisp (3); Conjure Animals (5); Fount of Moonlight (7); Mass Cure Wounds (9).

feature:feature:improved-circle-forms.description: In Wild Shape, attacks can deal Radiant instead of their normal type, and add WIS mod to Constitution saves.

feature:feature:moonlight-step.description: Bonus Action teleport 30 feet with Advantage on your next attack this turn. WIS mod uses per Long Rest; restore one per level 2+ slot.

feature:feature:lunar-form.description: Once per turn an extra 2d10 Radiant on a Wild Shape hit, and Moonlight Step can bring a willing creature within 10 feet.

feature:feature:circle-of-the-sea-spells.description: Always prepared: Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Ray of Frost, Shatter, Thunderwave (3); Lightning Bolt, Water Breathing (5); Control Water, Ice Storm (7); Conjure Elemental, Hold Monster (9).

feature:feature:wrath-of-the-sea.description: Bonus Action, spend Wild Shape: a 5-foot Emanation for 10 minutes. On creation and as a Bonus Action, a creature in it makes a Constitution save or takes WIS mod d6 Cold and, if Large or smaller, is pushed 15 feet.

feature:feature:aquatic-affinity.description: The Emanation grows to 10 feet, and you gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

feature:feature:stormborn.description: While Wrath of the Sea is active: Fly Speed equal to your Speed and Resistance to Cold, Lightning and Thunder.

feature:feature:oceanic-gift.description: Place the Emanation on a willing creature within 60 feet instead, or on both of you for two Wild Shape uses.

feature:feature:star-map.description: A Tiny star chart that is a Spellcasting Focus. While holding it, Guidance and Guiding Bolt are prepared and Guiding Bolt can be cast without a slot WIS mod times per Long Rest.

feature:feature:starry-form.description: Bonus Action, spend Wild Shape: a glowing form for 10 minutes with one constellation. Archer: Bonus Action ranged spell attack for 1d8 + WIS Radiant. Chalice: healing spells also heal a creature within 30 feet for 1d8 + WIS. Dragon: treat 9 or lower as 10 on INT and WIS checks and Concentration saves.

feature:feature:cosmic-omen.description: After a Long Rest roll a die: even lets you add 1d6 to a D20 Test within 30 feet, odd lets you subtract 1d6, as a Reaction. WIS mod uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:twinkling-constellations.description: Archer and Chalice become 2d8, Dragon grants Fly 20 feet with hover, and you can switch constellation at the start of each turn.

feature:feature:full-of-stars.description: In Starry Form, Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.

feature:feature:combat-superiority.description: Four d8 Superiority Dice (five at level 7, six at 15), regained on a Short or Long Rest. Learn three maneuvers, two more at levels 7, 10 and 15, swapping one each time. One maneuver per attack; save DC 8 + STR or DEX mod + Proficiency Bonus.

feature:feature:student-of-war.description: Proficiency with one type of Artisan's Tools and one Fighter skill of your choice.

feature:feature:know-your-enemy.description: Bonus Action: learn a creature's Immunities, Resistances and Vulnerabilities within 30 feet. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a Superiority Die.

feature:feature:relentless.description: Once per turn, use a d8 for a maneuver instead of spending a Superiority Die.

feature:feature:eldritch-knight:spellcas.description: Third-caster from the Wizard list using Intelligence: two Wizard cantrips (three at level 10), prepared spells from 3 at level 3 to 13 at level 20, spell slots up to level 4 (level 4 at Fighter 19). Swap a cantrip each Fighter level.

feature:feature:war-bond.description: A 1-hour ritual bonds up to two weapons: you cannot be disarmed of them unless Incapacitated, and you can summon one to your hand as a Bonus Action from the same plane.

feature:feature:war-magic.description: Replace one attack of the Attack action with an action-cast Wizard cantrip.

feature:feature:eldritch-strike.description: A weapon hit gives the target Disadvantage on its next save against your spell before the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:arcane-charge.description: Teleport up to 30 feet when you use Action Surge, before or after the extra action.

feature:feature:improved-war-magic.description: Replace two attacks of the Attack action with an action-cast level 1 or 2 Wizard spell.

feature:feature:psionic-power.description: Psionic Energy Dice: four d6 at level 3, six d8 at 5, eight d8 at 9, eight d10 at 11, ten d10 at 13, twelve d12 at 17; regain one on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest. Protective Field: Reaction, spend a die to cut damage to you or a creature within 30 feet by the roll + INT mod. Psionic Strike: once per turn after a weapon hit within 30 feet, spend a die for roll + INT mod Force. Telekinetic Movement: Magic action, move a Large or smaller loose object or willing creature 30 feet, once per Short Rest or by spending a die.

feature:feature:telekinetic-adept.description: Psi-Powered Leap: Bonus Action Fly Speed of twice your Speed this turn, once per Short Rest or by spending a die. Telekinetic Thrust: a Psionic Strike target makes a Strength save (DC 8 + INT mod + Proficiency Bonus) or is knocked Prone or moved 10 feet.

feature:feature:guarded-mind.description: Resistance to Psychic damage, and spend a die at the start of your turn to end Charmed and Frightened effects on you.

feature:feature:bulwark-of-force.description: Bonus Action: up to INT mod creatures within 30 feet gain Half Cover for 1 minute. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a die.

feature:feature:telekinetic-master.description: Telekinesis always prepared and castable without slot or components using INT, with a Bonus Action weapon attack each turn while concentrating. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a die.

feature:feature:hand-of-harm.description: Once per turn on an Unarmed Strike hit, spend 1 Focus Point for an extra Martial Arts die + WIS mod Necrotic.

feature:feature:hand-of-healing.description: Magic action, 1 Focus Point: touch heals a Martial Arts die + WIS mod. One Flurry of Blows strike can be replaced by a free Hand of Healing.

feature:feature:implements-of-mercy.description: Proficiency in Insight and Medicine and with the Herbalism Kit.

feature:feature:physician-s-touch.description: Hand of Harm can also Poison until the end of your next turn; Hand of Healing can also end Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned or Stunned.

feature:feature:flurry-of-healing-and-ha.description: With Flurry of Blows, replace each strike with a free Hand of Healing, and apply Hand of Harm free on a Flurry hit (still once per turn). WIS mod uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:hand-of-ultimate-mercy.description: Magic action, 5 Focus Points: return a creature dead under 24 hours to life with 4d10 + WIS mod Hit Points, clearing those five conditions. Once per Long Rest.

feature:feature:shadow-arts.description: Spend 1 Focus Point to cast Darkness without components, seeing through it and moving it within 60 feet each turn. Darkvision 60 feet (or +60). Minor Illusion with Wisdom.

feature:feature:shadow-step.description: In Dim Light or Darkness, Bonus Action teleport 60 feet to another such space, with Advantage on your next melee attack this turn.

feature:feature:improved-shadow-step.description: Spend 1 Focus Point to ignore the light requirement, and make an Unarmed Strike right after teleporting.

feature:feature:cloak-of-shadows.description: Magic action in dim light or darkness, 3 Focus Points: for 1 minute you are Invisible, move through occupied spaces, and use Flurry of Blows for free.

feature:feature:elemental-attunement.description: At the start of your turn spend 1 Focus Point for 10 minutes of: Unarmed Strike reach +10 feet, and hits can deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder with a Strength save to move the target 10 feet.

feature:feature:elemental-burst.description: Magic action, 2 Focus Points: 20-foot-radius Sphere within 120 feet, Dexterity save for three Martial Arts dice of a chosen element, half on a success.

feature:feature:stride-of-the-elements.description: While attuned, Fly and Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

feature:feature:elemental-epitome.description: While attuned: Resistance to a chosen element (changeable each turn), Step of the Wind adds 20 feet and deals a Martial Arts die to creatures you pass, and once per turn an Unarmed Strike adds a Martial Arts die.

feature:feature:inspiring-smite.description: Right after casting Divine Smite, spend Channel Divinity to share 2d8 + Paladin level Temporary Hit Points among creatures within 30 feet, you included.

feature:feature:oath-of-glory-spells.description: Always prepared: Guiding Bolt, Heroism (3); Enhance Ability, Magic Weapon (5); Haste, Protection from Energy (9); Compulsion, Freedom of Movement (13); Legend Lore, Yolande's Regal Presence (17).

feature:feature:peerless-athlete.description: Bonus Action, spend Channel Divinity: for 1 hour, Advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics and +10 feet to Long and High Jumps.

feature:feature:aura-of-alacrity.description: Speed +10 feet, and an ally entering or starting its turn in your Aura of Protection gets +10 feet Speed until the end of its next turn.

feature:feature:glorious-defense.description: Reaction when you or a creature within 10 feet is hit: add CHA mod (min +1) to its AC against the attack, and if it misses, attack the attacker. CHA mod uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:living-legend.description: Bonus Action for 10 minutes: Advantage on Charisma checks, a Reaction reroll of a failed save, and once per turn a missed weapon attack hits. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a level 5 slot.

feature:feature:nature-s-wrath.description: Magic action, spend Channel Divinity: chosen creatures within 15 feet make a Strength save or are Restrained for 1 minute (repeats each turn).

feature:feature:oath-of-the-ancients-spe.description: Always prepared: Ensnaring Strike, Speak with Animals (3); Misty Step, Moonbeam (5); Plant Growth, Protection from Energy (9); Ice Storm, Stoneskin (13); Commune with Nature, Tree Stride (17).

feature:feature:aura-of-warding.description: You and allies in your Aura of Protection have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant damage.

feature:feature:undying-sentinel.description: Once per Long Rest, drop to 1 Hit Point instead of 0 and regain three times your Paladin level. You stop aging and cannot be aged magically.

feature:feature:elder-champion.description: Bonus Action for 1 minute: enemies in your aura have Disadvantage on saves against your spells and Channel Divinity, you regain 10 Hit Points each turn, and action spells can be cast as a Bonus Action. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a level 5 slot.

feature:feature:oath-of-vengeance-spells.description: Always prepared: Bane, Hunter's Mark (3); Hold Person, Misty Step (5); Haste, Protection from Energy (9); Banishment, Dimension Door (13); Hold Monster, Scrying (17).
