feature:feature:vow-of-enmity.description: When you take the Attack action, spend Channel Divinity: Advantage on attacks against a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute; move the vow if it drops to 0 Hit Points.

feature:feature:relentless-avenger.description: An Opportunity Attack hit drops the target's Speed to 0 for the turn, and you can move half your Speed without provoking.

feature:feature:soul-of-vengeance.description: Reaction after your Vow of Enmity target makes an attack roll: make a melee attack against it.

feature:feature:avenging-angel.description: Bonus Action for 10 minutes: Fly 60 feet with hover, and enemies starting their turn in your aura make a Wisdom save or are Frightened for 1 minute (attacks against them have Advantage). Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a level 5 slot.

feature:feature:primal-companion.description: A primal beast (Land, Sea or Sky stat block) that acts on your turn and Dodges unless you spend a Bonus Action to command it, or replace one of your attacks with its Beast's Strike. AC 13 + WIS mod; Hit Points 5 + 5 per Ranger level (Sky: 4 + 4 per level). Revive it within an hour with a Magic action and a spell slot; swap it after a Long Rest.

feature:feature:exceptional-training.description: When commanded with a Bonus Action, the beast can also Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help as its Bonus Action, and its hits can deal Force damage.

feature:feature:bestial-fury.description: Beast's Strike happens twice when commanded, and the first hit each turn on your Hunter's Mark target adds that spell's bonus damage as Force.

feature:feature:share-spells.description: A spell you cast on yourself also affects the beast if it is within 30 feet.

feature:feature:dreadful-strikes.description: Once per turn per target, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d4 Psychic (1d6 at level 11).

feature:feature:fey-wanderer-spells.description: Always prepared: Charm Person (3), Misty Step (5), Summon Fey (9), Dimension Door (13), Mislead (17). Also a cosmetic Feywild gift.

feature:feature:otherworldly-glamour.description: Add WIS mod (min +1) to Charisma checks, and gain proficiency in Deception, Performance or Persuasion.

feature:feature:beguiling-twist.description: Advantage against Charmed and Frightened. Reaction when a creature within 120 feet succeeds against either: another creature makes a Wisdom save or is Charmed or Frightened for 1 minute.

feature:feature:fey-reinforcements.description: Summon Fey needs no Material component, once per Long Rest without a slot, and can drop Concentration for a 1-minute duration.

feature:feature:misty-wanderer.description: Misty Step without a slot WIS mod times per Long Rest, bringing a willing creature within 5 feet.

feature:feature:dread-ambusher.description: Speed +10 feet on your first turn of combat; add WIS mod to Initiative; once per turn a weapon hit can add 2d6 Psychic, WIS mod uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:gloom-stalker-spells.description: Always prepared: Disguise Self (3), Rope Trick (5), Fear (9), Greater Invisibility (13), Seeming (17).

feature:feature:umbral-sight.description: Darkvision 60 feet (or +60), and while in Darkness you are Invisible to creatures relying on Darkvision.

feature:feature:iron-mind.description: Proficiency in Wisdom saves, or Intelligence or Charisma saves if you already have it.

feature:feature:stalker-s-flurry.description: Dreadful Strike becomes 2d8 and adds Sudden Strike (another attack against a creature within 5 feet of the target) or Mass Fear (the target and creatures within 10 feet make a Wisdom save or are Frightened until your next turn).

feature:feature:shadowy-dodge.description: Reaction when attacked: impose Disadvantage, then teleport up to 30 feet.

feature:feature:arcane-trickster:spellca.description: Third-caster from the Wizard list using Intelligence: Mage Hand plus two Wizard cantrips (one more at level 10), prepared spells from 3 at level 3 to 13 at level 20, spell slots up to level 4. Swap one spell or cantrip (not Mage Hand) each Rogue level; Arcane Focus allowed.

feature:feature:mage-hand-legerdemain.description: Cast Mage Hand as a Bonus Action, make the hand Invisible, control it as a Bonus Action, and make Sleight of Hand checks through it.

feature:feature:magical-ambush.description: While Invisible, a creature you cast a spell on has Disadvantage on its saves against that spell this turn.

feature:feature:versatile-trickster.description: Your Cunning Strike Trip can also hit another creature within 5 feet of your Mage Hand.

feature:feature:spell-thief.description: Reaction to a spell that targets or includes you: the caster makes an Intelligence save or the spell fails against you and you steal a level 1+ spell you can cast, prepared for 8 hours while the caster loses it. Once per Long Rest.

feature:feature:assassinate.description: Advantage on Initiative; in the first round, Advantage on attacks against creatures that have not acted, and a Sneak Attack hit adds damage equal to your Rogue level.

feature:feature:assassin-s-tools.description: A Disguise Kit and Poisoner's Kit, with proficiency in both.

feature:feature:infiltration-expertise.description: Mimic speech or handwriting after an hour of study, and Steady Aim no longer drops your Speed to 0.

feature:feature:envenom-weapons.description: Cunning Strike Poison also deals 2d6 Poison on a failed save, ignoring Resistance.

feature:feature:death-strike.description: A first-round Sneak Attack hit forces a Constitution save (DC 8 + DEX mod + Proficiency Bonus) or the damage is doubled.

feature:feature:soulknife:psionic-power.description: Psionic Energy Dice (four d6 at 3, six d8 at 5, eight d8 at 9, eight d10 at 11, ten d10 at 13, twelve d12 at 17); one back on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest. Psi-Bolstered Knack: add a die to a failed proficient check, spent only if it then succeeds. Psychic Whispers: Magic action, telepathy with up to Proficiency Bonus creatures for hours equal to a die roll, free once per Long Rest.

feature:feature:psychic-blades.description: On the Attack action or an Opportunity Attack, attack with a Psychic Blade: Simple Melee, Finesse, Thrown 60/120, 1d6 Psychic + ability mod, Vex mastery. A second blade as a Bonus Action deals 1d4.

feature:feature:soul-blades.description: Homing Strikes: add a die to a missed Psychic Blade attack, spent if it hits. Psychic Teleportation: Bonus Action, spend a die and teleport up to 10 times its roll in feet.

feature:feature:psychic-veil.description: Magic action: Invisible for 1 hour, ending when you deal damage or force a save. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a die.

feature:feature:rend-mind.description: Psychic Blade Sneak Attack forces a Wisdom save (DC 8 + DEX mod + Proficiency Bonus) or Stunned for 1 minute (repeats each turn). Once per Long Rest, or restore it with three dice.

feature:feature:psionic-spells.description: Always prepared: Arms of Hadar, Calm Emotions, Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Mind Sliver (3); Hunger of Hadar, Sending (5); Evard's Black Tentacles, Summon Aberration (7); Rary's Telepathic Bond, Telekinesis (9).

feature:feature:telepathic-speech.description: Bonus Action: telepathy with a creature within 30 feet, at a range of CHA mod miles, for minutes equal to your Sorcerer level.

feature:feature:psionic-sorcery.description: Cast a level 1+ Psionic Spell by spending Sorcery Points equal to its level instead of a slot, with no Verbal, Somatic or non-costly Material components.

feature:feature:psychic-defenses.description: Resistance to Psychic damage and Advantage against Charmed and Frightened.

feature:feature:revelation-in-flesh.description: Bonus Action, 1+ Sorcery Points for 10 minutes, one benefit per point: Swim at twice Speed and breathe water, Fly at Speed with hover, see Invisible creatures within 60 feet, or squeeze through 1-inch gaps and slip restraints.

feature:feature:warping-implosion.description: Magic action: teleport up to 120 feet; creatures within 30 feet of where you left make a Strength save or take 3d10 Force and are pulled toward that space (half damage on a success). Once per Long Rest, or restore it with 5 Sorcery Points.

feature:feature:clockwork-spells.description: Always prepared: Aid, Alarm, Lesser Restoration, Protection from Evil and Good (3); Dispel Magic, Protection from Energy (5); Freedom of Movement, Summon Construct (7); Greater Restoration, Wall of Force (9). Plus a cosmetic manifestation of order.

feature:feature:restore-balance.description: Reaction: cancel Advantage and Disadvantage on a d20 roll by a creature within 60 feet. CHA mod uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:bastion-of-law.description: Magic action, 1 to 5 Sorcery Points: a ward of that many d8s on you or a creature within 30 feet, spent to reduce damage, lasting until your next Long Rest.

feature:feature:trance-of-order.description: Bonus Action for 1 minute: attacks against you cannot have Advantage, and treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower as 10. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with 5 Sorcery Points.

feature:feature:clockwork-cavalcade.description: Magic action: a 30-foot Cube heals up to 100 Hit Points split as you like, repairs objects, and ends spells of level 6 or lower on chosen targets. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with 7 Sorcery Points.

feature:feature:wild-magic-surge.description: Once per turn after casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, roll a d20; on a 20, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table in the Player's Handbook.

feature:feature:tides-of-chaos.description: Give yourself Advantage on one D20 Test. Recharges when you cast a Sorcerer spell with a slot (which triggers a surge roll) or finish a Long Rest.

feature:feature:bend-luck.description: Reaction, 1 Sorcery Point: add or subtract 1d4 from another creature's d20 roll.

feature:feature:controlled-chaos.description: Roll twice on the Wild Magic Surge table and pick either.

feature:feature:tamed-surge.description: After casting a Sorcerer spell with a slot, choose any surge effect but the last row instead of rolling. Once per Long Rest.

feature:feature:archfey-spells.description: Always prepared: Calm Emotions, Faerie Fire, Misty Step, Phantasmal Force, Sleep (3); Blink, Plant Growth (5); Dominate Beast, Greater Invisibility (7); Dominate Person, Seeming (9).

feature:feature:steps-of-the-fey.description: Misty Step without a slot CHA mod times per Long Rest, adding Refreshing Step (you or a creature within 10 feet gains 1d10 Temporary Hit Points) or Taunting Step (creatures within 5 feet of where you left make a Wisdom save or have Disadvantage attacking anyone but you).

feature:feature:misty-escape.description: Cast Misty Step as a Reaction to taking damage, and add Disappearing Step (Invisible until your next turn or until you attack, deal damage or cast) and Dreadful Step (Wisdom save or 2d10 Psychic near either space).

feature:feature:beguiling-defenses.description: Immune to Charmed. Reaction when hit: halve the damage and the attacker makes a Wisdom save or takes the same Psychic damage. Once per Long Rest, or restore it with a Pact Magic slot.

feature:feature:bewitching-magic.description: After casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell with an action and a slot, cast Misty Step free as part of that action.

feature:feature:celestial-spells.description: Always prepared: Aid, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Light, Sacred Flame (3); Daylight, Revivify (5); Guardian of Faith, Wall of Fire (7); Greater Restoration, Summon Celestial (9).

feature:feature:healing-light.description: A pool of d6s equal to 1 + Warlock level; Bonus Action, spend up to CHA mod dice to heal you or a creature within 60 feet. Refills on a Long Rest.

feature:feature:radiant-soul.description: Resistance to Radiant damage, and once per turn add CHA mod to one target of a Radiant or Fire spell.

feature:feature:celestial-resilience.description: On Magical Cunning or a Short or Long Rest, gain Temporary Hit Points of Warlock level + CHA mod, and up to five creatures gain half your level + CHA mod.

feature:feature:searing-vengeance.description: When you or an ally within 60 feet is about to make a Death Saving Throw, it regains half its Hit Point maximum and can stand, and chosen creatures within 30 feet take 2d8 + CHA mod Radiant and are Blinded this turn. Once per Long Rest.

feature:feature:awakened-mind.description: Bonus Action: telepathy with a creature within 30 feet, at a range of CHA mod miles, for minutes equal to your Warlock level.

feature:feature:great-old-one-spells.description: Always prepared: Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Phantasmal Force, Tasha's Hideous Laughter (3); Clairvoyance, Hunger of Hadar (5); Confusion, Summon Aberration (7); Modify Memory, Telekinesis (9).

feature:feature:psychic-spells.description: Warlock damage spells can deal Psychic instead, and Warlock Enchantment and Illusion spells need no Verbal or Somatic components.

feature:feature:clairvoyant-combatant.description: When you link with Awakened Mind, the creature makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage attacking you while you have Advantage attacking it for the link's duration. Once per Short or Long Rest, or restore it with a Pact Magic slot.

feature:feature:eldritch-hex.description: Hex always prepared, and its target also has Disadvantage on saves of the chosen ability.

feature:feature:thought-shield.description: Your thoughts cannot be read without consent, Resistance to Psychic damage, and creatures that deal Psychic damage to you take the same amount.

feature:feature:create-thrall.description: Summon Aberration can skip Concentration for a 1-minute duration, gains Temporary Hit Points of Warlock level + CHA mod, and adds your Hex bonus to its first hit each turn on the hexed target.

feature:feature:abjuration-savant.description: Add two Abjuration Wizard spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, and one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

feature:feature:arcane-ward.description: Casting an Abjuration spell with a slot creates a ward (once per Long Rest) with Hit Points of twice your Wizard level + INT mod that absorbs damage to you. Abjuration spells restore twice the slot level; a Bonus Action and a slot does the same.

feature:feature:projected-ward.description: Reaction: your Arcane Ward absorbs damage to a creature within 30 feet.

feature:feature:spell-breaker.description: Counterspell and Dispel Magic always prepared; Dispel Magic as a Bonus Action adding your Proficiency Bonus; a failed attempt keeps the slot.

feature:feature:spell-resistance.description: Advantage on saves against spells and Resistance to spell damage.

feature:feature:divination-savant.description: Add two Divination Wizard spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, and one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

feature:feature:portent.description: After each Long Rest roll two d20s; before any D20 Test by you or a creature you can see, replace the roll with one of them, once per turn.

feature:feature:expert-divination.description: Casting a Divination spell with a level 2+ slot restores one lower-level expended slot (level 5 or lower).

feature:feature:the-third-eye.description: Bonus Action until your next rest, once per Short or Long Rest: Darkvision 120 feet, read any language, or cast See Invisibility without a slot.

feature:feature:illusion-savant.description: Add two Illusion Wizard spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, and one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

feature:feature:improved-illusions.description: Illusion spells need no Verbal components and gain 60 feet of range if they reach 10+ feet. Learn Minor Illusion (or another Wizard cantrip) free; it makes sound and image together and can be cast as a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:phantasmal-creatures.description: Summon Beast and Summon Fey always prepared; cast either as Illusion, once each per Long Rest without a slot at half Hit Points.

feature:feature:illusory-self.description: Reaction when hit by an attack: it misses. Once per Short or Long Rest, or restore it with a level 2+ slot.

feature:feature:illusory-reality.description: Bonus Action while an Illusion spell cast with a slot lasts: make one inanimate, nonmagical object in it real for 1 minute; it cannot deal damage or conditions.

feature:feature:tools-of-the-trade.description: Proficiency with Alchemist's Supplies and the Herbalism Kit (another Artisan's Tools for each you already have); crafting potions takes half the time.

feature:feature:alchemist-spells.description: Always prepared: Healing Word, Ray of Sickness (3); Flaming Sphere, Melf's Acid Arrow (5); Gaseous Form, Mass Healing Word (9); Death Ward, Vitriolic Sphere (13); Cloudkill, Raise Dead (17).

feature:feature:experimental-elixir.description: After a Long Rest with Alchemist's Supplies, make two random elixirs (three at level 5, four at 9, five at 15) that vanish at your next Long Rest; drinking or giving one is a Bonus Action. Magic action and a spell slot: make one more, choosing its effect.

feature:feature:alchemical-savant.description: Spells cast through Alchemist's Supplies add INT mod (min +1) to one healing roll or one Acid, Fire or Poison damage roll.

feature:feature:restorative-reagents.description: Cast Lesser Restoration through Alchemist's Supplies without a slot or preparing it, INT mod times per Long Rest.

feature:feature:chemical-mastery.description: Once per turn add 2d8 Force to an Artificer spell's Acid, Fire or Poison damage; Resistance to Acid and Poison and immunity to Poisoned; Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron through Alchemist's Supplies without slot, preparation or Material components once per Long Rest.

feature:feature:armorer:tools-of-the-tra.description: Heavy armor training and proficiency with Smith's Tools (or another Artisan's Tools); crafting armor takes half the time.

feature:feature:armorer-spells.description: Always prepared: Magic Missile, Thunderwave (3); Mirror Image, Shatter (5); Hypnotic Pattern, Lightning Bolt (9); Fire Shield, Greater Invisibility (13); Passwall, Wall of Force (17).

feature:feature:arcane-armor.description: Magic action with Smith's Tools: the armor you wear becomes Arcane Armor, with no Strength requirement, don and doff as a Utilize action, cannot be removed against your will, and works as a spellcasting focus.

feature:feature:armor-model.description: Choose a model, changeable on a Short or Long Rest; its weapon uses INT for attack and damage. Dreadnaught: Force Demolisher (Reach, 1d10 Force, push or pull a smaller creature 10 feet) and Giant Stature (Bonus Action: Large and +5 feet reach for 1 minute, INT mod uses per Long Rest). Guardian: Thunder Pulse (1d8 Thunder; the target has Disadvantage attacking others) and Defensive Field (Bonus Action while Bloodied: Temporary Hit Points equal to Artificer level). Infiltrator: Lightning Launcher (ranged 90/300, 1d6 Lightning, +1d6 once per turn), Powered Steps (+5 feet Speed), and Advantage on Stealth.

feature:feature:armorer:extra-attack.description: Attack twice with the Attack action.

feature:feature:improved-armorer.description: Learn an extra Armor plan and create one extra Armor item with Replicate Magic Item, and +1 to attack and damage with your model weapon.

feature:feature:perfected-armor.description: Dreadnaught: 2d6 demolisher, Giant Stature reaches 10 feet and Large or Huge with Advantage on Strength checks and saves. Guardian: 1d10 pulse and a Reaction pull of 25 feet toward you with a melee attack if adjacent (INT mod uses per Long Rest). Infiltrator: 2d6 launcher whose targets glow and have Disadvantage attacking you, and a Bonus Action Fly Speed of twice your Speed this turn (INT mod uses per Long Rest).

feature:feature:artillerist:tools-of-the.description: Proficiency with Martial Ranged weapons and Woodcarver's Tools (or another Artisan's Tools); crafting wands takes half the time.

feature:feature:artillerist-spells.description: Always prepared: Shield, Thunderwave (3); Scorching Ray, Shatter (5); Fireball, Wind Wall (9); Ice Storm, Wall of Fire (13); Cone of Cold, Wall of Force (17).

feature:feature:eldritch-cannon.description: Magic action with Smith's or Woodcarver's Tools: a Small or Tiny cannon (AC 18, Hit Points 5 per Artificer level) for 1 hour, once per Long Rest or by spending a slot. Bonus Action within 60 feet: move it 15 feet and fire Flamethrower (15-foot Cone, Dexterity save, 2d8 Fire), Force Ballista (ranged spell attack within 120 feet, 2d8 Force and push 5 feet), or Protector (it and chosen creatures within 10 feet gain 1d8 + INT mod Temporary Hit Points).

feature:feature:arcane-firearm.description: After a Long Rest, carve a Rod, Staff, Wand or Martial Ranged weapon into an Arcane Firearm; spells cast through it add 1d8 to one damage roll.

feature:feature:explosive-cannon.description: Cannon damage and Protector gain +1d8, and a Reaction when it is damaged detonates it: 20-foot Dexterity save for 3d10 Force, half on a success.

feature:feature:fortified-position.description: Keep two cannons, created and commanded together, and you and allies within 10 feet of a cannon have Half Cover.

feature:feature:battle-smith:tools-of-th.description: Proficiency with Smith's Tools (or another Artisan's Tools); crafting weapons takes half the time.

feature:feature:battle-smith-spells.description: Always prepared: Heroism, Shield (3); Shining Smite, Warding Bond (5); Aura of Vitality, Conjure Barrage (9); Aura of Purity, Fire Shield (13); Banishing Smite, Mass Cure Wounds (17).

feature:feature:battle-ready.description: Use INT for attack and damage with magic weapons, proficiency with Martial weapons, and proficient weapons work as a spellcasting focus.

feature:feature:steel-defender.description: A Medium construct companion (AC 12 + INT mod, Hit Points 5 + 5 per Artificer level, Speed 40) that acts on your turn and Dodges unless you command it with a Bonus Action. Force-Empowered Rend: 1d8 + 2 + INT mod Force. Repair three times a day, and Deflect Attack as a Reaction. Revive it within an hour with a Magic action and a slot; rebuild it after a Long Rest with Smith's Tools.

feature:feature:battle-smith:extra-attac.description: Attack twice with the Attack action; one attack can instead command the Steel Defender to Rend.

feature:feature:arcane-jolt.description: Once per turn when your magic weapon or Steel Defender hits: an extra 2d6 Force, or heal a creature within 30 feet of the target 2d6. INT mod uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:improved-defender.description: Arcane Jolt becomes 4d6, and Deflect Attack deals 1d4 + INT mod Force to the attacker.

feature:feature:cartographer:tools-of-th.description: Proficiency with Calligrapher's Supplies and Cartographer's Tools (another Artisan's Tools for each you already have); scribing Spell Scrolls takes half the time.

feature:feature:cartographer-spells.description: Always prepared: Faerie Fire, Guiding Bolt, Healing Word (3); Locate Object, Mind Spike (5); Call Lightning, Clairvoyance (9); Banishment, Locate Creature (13); Scrying, Teleportation Circle (17).

feature:feature:adventurer-s-atlas.description: After a Long Rest with Cartographer's Tools, give magic maps to 2 to 1 + INT mod creatures (you can be one). Holders add 1d4 to Initiative, know each other's locations on the plane, and can target each other without sight within range.

feature:feature:mapping-magic.description: Faerie Fire without a slot INT mod times per Long Rest. Portal Jump: spend half your Speed to teleport 10 feet, or next to a map holder within 30 feet.

feature:feature:guided-precision.description: Once per turn add INT mod to one damage roll of a Cartographer spell or an attack against a creature under your Faerie Fire, and damage cannot break your Concentration on Faerie Fire.

feature:feature:ingenious-movement.description: When you use Flash of Genius, you or a willing creature within 30 feet can also teleport 30 feet.

feature:feature:superior-atlas.description: Safe Haven: a map holder dropping to 0 Hit Points can destroy its map to instead have twice your Artificer level in Hit Points and teleport next to a holder. Unerring Path: cast Find the Path free once per Long Rest while holding a map.

feature:feature:moon-s-inspiration.description: Inspired Eclipse: when you give Bardic Inspiration as a Bonus Action, you can also turn Invisible and teleport up to 30 feet (invisible until your next turn starts or you attack, deal damage or cast). Lunar Vitality: once per turn when a spell of yours heals a creature, expend a Bardic Inspiration die to add its roll to the healing, and the creature gains +10 feet Speed until the end of its next turn.

feature:feature:primal-lore.description: Learn Druidic and one Druid cantrip (a Bard spell for you, not counted against cantrips known; swappable on each Bard level). Gain proficiency in Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception or Survival.

feature:feature:blessing-of-moonlight.description: Moonbeam is always prepared. Once per Long Rest, cast it glowing (Dim Light 5 feet): whenever a creature fails its save against that Moonbeam, another creature you see within 60 feet regains 2d4 HP.

feature:feature:eventide-s-splendor.description: Shadow of the New Moon: the creature receiving your Inspired Eclipse die can also turn Invisible and use its Reaction to teleport 30 feet. Vibrance of the Full Moon: Lunar Vitality can use a d6 roll instead of expending a Bardic Inspiration die.

feature:feature:blessings-of-knowledge.description: Proficiency with one Artisan's Tools and two of Arcana, History, Nature or Religion, with Expertise in those two skills.

feature:feature:knowledge-domain-spells.description: Always prepared: Command, Comprehend Languages, Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Identify, Mind Spike (3); Dispel Magic, Nondetection, Tongues (5); Arcane Eye, Banishment, Confusion (7); Legend Lore, Scrying, Synaptic Static (9).

feature:feature:mind-magic.description: Magic action and one Channel Divinity: cast a prepared Divination spell from your domain list without a slot or Material components.

feature:feature:unfettered-mind.description: Telepathy 60 feet, contacting up to Wis mod creatures at once (min 1). Proficiency in Intelligence saves (or another save if you have it).

feature:feature:divine-foreknowledge.description: Bonus Action: Advantage on D20 Tests for 1 hour. Once per Long Rest, or restore with a level 6+ slot.

feature:feature:knightly-envoy.description: Cast Comprehend Languages as a Ritual (Cha). Learn a language, swappable after a Long Rest for one you met in the last 24 hours. Proficiency in Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion or Performance.

feature:feature:group-recovery.description: When Second Wind heals you, up to Cha mod allies (min 1) in a 30-foot Emanation regain 1d4 + Fighter level HP. Once per Short or Long Rest.

feature:feature:team-tactics.description: Allies healed by Group Recovery have Advantage on D20 Tests until your next turn starts.

feature:feature:rallying-surge.description: When you Action Surge, up to Cha mod allies (min 1) in a 30-foot Emanation can each use a Reaction to attack once or move half Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

feature:feature:shared-resilience.description: Reaction when an ally you see within 60 feet fails a save: expend Indomitable to let it reroll with a bonus equal to your Fighter level.

feature:feature:inspiring-commander.description: Group Recovery and Rallying Surge reach 60 feet. Immunity to Charmed and Frightened.

feature:feature:elemental-smite.description: Right after casting Divine Smite, spend Channel Divinity for one effect: Dao's Crush (target Grappled and Restrained, escape DC = spell DC); Djinni's Escape (teleport 30 feet and turn semi-incorporeal until your next turn ends: resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, immune to Grappled, Prone, Restrained); Efreeti's Fury (target takes 2d4 Fire, then a second creature within 30 feet takes 2d4 Fire); Marid's Surge (target and chosen creatures in a 10-foot Emanation make a Str save or are pushed 15 feet and knocked Prone).

feature:feature:genie-spells.description: Always prepared: Chromatic Orb, Elementalism, Thunderous Smite (3); Mirror Image, Phantasmal Force (5); Fly, Gaseous Form (9); Conjure Minor Elementals, Summon Elemental (13); Banishing Smite, Contact Other Plane (17).

feature:feature:genie-s-splendor.description: Unarmored, AC = 10 + Dex + Cha (Shield allowed). Proficiency in Acrobatics, Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion.

feature:feature:aura-of-elemental-shield.description: You and allies in your Aura of Protection resist one of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder, changeable at the start of each turn.

feature:feature:elemental-rebuke.description: Reaction when hit by an attack roll: halve the damage, and the attacker makes a Dex save against your spell DC, taking 2d10 + Cha mod of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder (half on success). Cha mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

feature:feature:noble-scion.description: Bonus Action, 10 minutes: Fly Speed 60 feet (hover), and a Reaction to turn a failed D20 Test by you or an ally in your aura into a success. Once per Long Rest, or restore with a level 5 slot.

feature:feature:frigid-explorer.description: Your weapon attacks, Ranger spells and features ignore Cold resistance; you resist Cold. Once per turn a weapon hit can deal an extra 1d4 Cold (1d6 at Ranger 11).

feature:feature:hunter-s-rime.description: Casting Hunter's Mark grants 1d10 + Ranger level Temporary HP; a marked creature can't Disengage.

feature:feature:winter-walker-spells.description: Always prepared: Ice Knife (3), Hold Person (5), Remove Curse (9), Ice Storm (13), Cone of Cold (17).

feature:feature:fortifying-soul.description: Magic action, once per Long Rest: up to Wis mod creatures you see (min 1) regain 1d10 + Ranger level HP and have Advantage on saves against Frightened for 1 hour.

feature:feature:chilling-retribution.description: Reaction when hit by an attack roll: the attacker makes a Wis save against your spell DC or is Stunned with Speed 0 until the end of your next turn. Wis mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

feature:feature:frozen-haunt.description: When you cast Hunter's Mark, take a ghostly snow form for its duration: immunity to Cold, chosen creatures in a 15-foot Emanation take 2d4 Cold when it starts and at the start of each of your turns; immunity to Grappled, Prone, Restrained, and you move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (1d10 Force if you end inside one). Once per Long Rest, or a level 4+ slot.

feature:feature:bloodthirst.description: Reaction when an enemy you see within 30 feet becomes Bloodied without dying: teleport within 5 feet of it and make one melee attack. Int mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

feature:feature:dread-allegiance.description: Choose a Dead Three god (changeable after a Long Rest): Bane (Psychic resistance, Minor Illusion), Bhaal (Poison resistance, Blade Ward) or Myrkul (Necrotic resistance, Chill Touch); Int is your spellcasting ability.

feature:feature:strike-fear.description: New Cunning Strike, Terrify (cost 1d6): Wis save or Frightened for 1 minute, with you having Advantage on attacks against it (repeats the save each turn end).

feature:feature:aura-of-malevolence.description: When you teleport with Bloodthirst, chosen creatures within 10 feet of your start or end space take damage equal to your Int mod, of your Dread Allegiance type, ignoring resistance.

feature:feature:dread-incarnate.description: Regain one Bloodthirst use on a Short Rest. Treat 1s and 2s on Sneak Attack dice as 3s.

feature:feature:spellfire-burst.description: Once per turn, when you spend Sorcery Points as part of a Magic action or Bonus Action: Bolstering Flames (you or a creature within 30 feet gains 1d4 + Cha mod Temporary HP) or Radiant Fire (a creature within 30 feet takes 1d4 Fire or Radiant).

feature:feature:spellfire-spells.description: Always prepared: Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Scorching Ray (3); Aura of Vitality, Dispel Magic (5); Fire Shield, Wall of Fire (7); Greater Restoration, Flame Strike (9).

feature:feature:absorb-spells.description: Counterspell is always prepared; when a target fails its save against your Counterspell, regain 1d4 Sorcery Points.

feature:feature:honed-spellfire.description: Bolstering Flames adds your Sorcerer level; Radiant Fire deals 1d8.

feature:feature:crown-of-spellfire.description: When you use Innate Sorcery, empower it: once per turn when hit, spend up to Cha mod Hit Point Dice to reduce the damage by the roll; Fly Speed 60 feet (hover); Evasion-style protection on half-damage saves unless Incapacitated. Once per Long Rest, or 5 Sorcery Points.

feature:feature:bladesong.description: Bonus Action, unarmored and without a Shield, 1 minute: +Int mod AC (min +1), +10 feet Speed, Advantage on Acrobatics; use Int for proficient weapon attacks and damage; add Int mod to Concentration saves. Ends if Incapacitated, you don armor or a Shield, or you attack two-handed. Int mod uses per Long Rest (min 1); regain one with Arcane Recovery.

feature:feature:training-in-war-and-song.description: Proficiency with Melee Martial weapons lacking Two-Handed and Heavy; use a proficient Melee weapon as a Spellcasting Focus. Proficiency in Acrobatics, Athletics, Performance or Persuasion.

feature:feature:bladesinger:extra-attack.description: Attack twice with the Attack action; one attack can be replaced by an action-cost Wizard cantrip.

feature:feature:song-of-defense.description: Reaction when damaged during Bladesong: expend a spell slot to reduce the damage by five times its level.

feature:feature:song-of-victory.description: After casting an action-time spell, make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:reanimator-spells.description: Always prepared: False Life, Spare the Dying, Witch Bolt (3); Blindness/Deafness, Enhance Ability (5); Animate Dead, Lightning Bolt (9); Blight, Death Ward (13); Antilife Shell, Raise Dead (17).

feature:feature:reanimator-s-skill-set.description: Jolt to Life: Int mod times per Long Rest, a Spare the Dying you cast also restores HP equal to your Artificer level, and chosen creatures in a 10-foot Emanation from the target make a Dex save or take 2d4 Lightning (half on success; 3d4 at 11, 4d4 at 17). Reanimator's Tools: proficiency with Alchemist's Supplies (or another Artisan's Tools).

feature:feature:reanimated-companion.description: Magic action with Artisan's Tools: create a Medium Undead companion (AC 10 + Int, HP 5 + 5 x Artificer level, Speed 30, resists Necrotic and Poison, immune to Lightning, Charmed, Exhaustion, Poisoned, Blindsight 60). Death Burst on death: 10-foot Emanation, Dex save vs your DC, 2d4 Necrotic (half on success). Lightning Absorption heals it. Dreadful Swipe: spell attack, 1d4 + Int Necrotic and no Opportunity Attacks for the target. Lasts until a Long Rest; once per Long Rest or by expending a slot. Acts on your turn, Dodging unless you command it with a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:strange-modifications.description: Each companion gets one option: Arcane Conduit (cast spells from its space; once per turn add Int to an Evocation or Necromancy Artificer spell's damage roll) or Ferocity (Dreadful Swipe die becomes 1d6).

feature:feature:improved-reanimation.description: Death Burst deals 4d4, and the companion's Necrotic damage ignores Resistance.

feature:feature:macabre-modifications.description: Two modification options, adding Bloated (Large, Swipe pushes 10 feet, Int added to Death Burst), Gaunt (Speed 45, spider climb, chosen creatures starting within 10 feet make a Wis save or are Frightened) and Moist (swim speed, squeezes through 1 inch, attackers within 10 feet take Int mod Acid).

feature:feature:refined-reanimation.description: Facilitated Revival: cast Raise Dead once per Long Rest without a slot or Material components using your tools. Life Transfer: Reaction when you or the companion takes damage, gain HP equal to its current HP and it dies (Death Burst). Superior Modifications: three modification options.

feature:feature:channeler.description: Know Guidance with a 60-foot range. Gain playing cards with proficiency; cards, a crystal or orb, a Candle or an Ink Pen work as your Bard focus.

feature:feature:spirits-from-beyond.description: When you give Bardic Inspiration, roll the die to channel a random spirit (or spend a Bardic Inspiration use as a Bonus Action to pick one up to your die size). Magic action: unleash it on a creature within 30 feet. 1 Beloved (heal die + Cha), 2 Sharpshooter (Force die + Cha), 3 Avenger (melee attackers take a die of Force), 4 Renegade (target teleports 30 feet), 5 Fortune Teller (Advantage on D20 Tests), 6 Wayfarer (temp HP die + Bard level, +10 Speed), 7 Trickster (Wis save, 2 dice Psychic and Charmed), 8 Shade (Invisible, then a Con save burst of 2 dice Necrotic), 9 Arsonist (Dex save, 4 dice Fire), 10 Coward (30-foot Wis save, Frightened and slowed), 11 Brute (30-foot Str save, 3 dice Thunder and Prone), 12 Priest (heal 2 dice and end a condition).

feature:feature:empowered-channeling.description: Power from Beyond: once per turn add 1d6 to a slot-cast Bard spell's damage or healing. Spiritual Manifestation: Spirit Guardians always prepared, one free cast per Long Rest; once per Short or Long Rest the casting also grants you and allies inside it Half Cover.

feature:feature:mystical-connection.description: Roll twice on the Spirits from Beyond table and choose; doubles let you pick any spirit.

feature:feature:grave-domain-spells.description: Always prepared: Detect Evil and Good, False Life, Gentle Repose, Ray of Enfeeblement, Spare the Dying (3); Revivify, Vampiric Touch (5); Blight, Death Ward (7); Dispel Evil and Good, Raise Dead (9).

feature:feature:circle-of-mortality.description: Pull of Death: once per turn, +1d4 Necrotic (1d6 at 11) when you damage a creature missing HP with a spell or attack. Return to Life: Spare the Dying as a Bonus Action. Healing dice on a creature at 0 HP are maximized.

feature:feature:path-to-the-grave.description: Bonus Action and a Channel Divinity: curse a creature within 30 feet until your next turn (Disadvantage on attacks and saves). When you or an ally hits it, end the curse to add Necrotic or Radiant damage equal to your Cleric level.

feature:feature:sentinel-at-death-s-door.description: Reaction when you or a Bloodied creature within 60 feet is hit: halve the damage and cancel Critical Hit effects. Wis mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

feature:feature:divine-reaper.description: Enhanced Necromancy: spend Channel Divinity to add a second target to a level 5 or lower single-target Necromancy spell or a domain spell. Keeper of Souls: when an enemy dies within 60 feet, you or a creature within 60 feet regains twice your Cleric level HP; once per Short or Long Rest or by a level 6+ slot.

feature:feature:hollow-warden-spells.description: Always prepared: Wrathful Smite (3), Alter Self (5), Phantom Steed (9), Dominate Beast (13), Steel Wind Strike (17).

feature:feature:wrath-of-the-wild.description: Bonus Action and a Favored Enemy use: ghastly form for 1 minute. Ancient Armor: +1 AC (+2 at 11). Prowling Retribution: Opportunity Attack against a creature within 5 feet right after it damages you or an ally. Unnerving Aura: on transforming and at the start of your turns, chosen creatures in a 10-foot Emanation make a Wis save or are Frightened until your next turn.

feature:feature:hungering-might.description: Add Wis mod (min +1) to Con saves. While transformed and Bloodied, once per turn a hit restores 1d10 + Wis mod HP.

feature:feature:rot-and-violence.description: While transformed: creatures failing the Unnerving Aura save can't regain HP or take Reactions until your next turn, and weapon hits can add the Sap or Slow mastery alongside another mastery.

feature:feature:ancient-might.description: Hits on Frightened creatures add Wis mod damage. Persistent Wrath: when dropped to 0 HP while transformed, go to twice your Ranger level instead (once per Long Rest or a level 4+ slot). Immunity to Exhaustion.

feature:feature:wails-from-the-grave.description: Right after dealing Sneak Attack on your turn, a second creature within 30 feet of the first takes Necrotic equal to half your Sneak Attack dice (round up). Dex mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

feature:feature:whispers-of-the-dead.description: After a Short or Long Rest, gain one skill or tool proficiency you lack until you choose another.

feature:feature:tokens-of-the-departed.description: Gain two soul trinkets (max 3 at 13, 4 at 17; refill to two on a Long Rest; Reaction to gain one when a creature within 30 feet dies). While you hold one, Advantage on Death Saves and Con saves. Destroy one to use Wails from the Grave free, or as a Magic action to cast Augury (or ask the trinket's spirit one question).

feature:feature:voice-of-death.description: Cast Speak with Dead once per Short or Long Rest without a slot or components (Dex), optionally targeting a soul trinket.

feature:feature:ghost-walk.description: Bonus Action, 10 minutes: Fly Speed 10 (hover), attacks against you have Disadvantage, move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (1d10 Force if you end inside). Once per Long Rest, or destroy a soul trinket.

feature:feature:death-s-friend.description: Wails from the Grave damages both creatures. Gain a soul trinket on Initiative if you have none.

feature:feature:shadow-spells.description: Always prepared: Bane, Darkness, Inflict Wounds, Pass Without Trace (3); Hunger of Hadar, Nondetection (5); Greater Invisibility, Phantasmal Killer (7); Contagion, Creation (9).

feature:feature:power-of-shadow.description: Darkvision 120 and Blindsight 10; you see through your own spells' Darkness. Strength of the Grave: once per Long Rest, when dropped to 0 HP, a Cha save (DC 5 + damage) leaves you at Cha mod + Sorcerer level HP.

feature:feature:beasts-of-ill-omen.description: Spend 3 Sorcery Points to cast Summon Beast as a Bonus Action without a slot or Material components; enemies within 5 feet of it have Disadvantage on saves against your spells. Optionally no Concentration (1 minute, ends if recast).

feature:feature:shadow-walk.description: In Dim Light or Darkness, Bonus Action teleport 120 feet to another dim or dark space you see.

feature:feature:umbral-form.description: With Innate Sorcery, take a shadow form: move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (1d10 Force if you end inside) and resist all damage but Force and Radiant. Once per Long Rest, or 6 Sorcery Points.

feature:feature:form-of-dread.description: Bonus Action, 1 minute, Cha mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest: gain 1d10 + Warlock level temp HP, immunity to Frightened, and once per turn a hit forces a Wis save or Frightened until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:undead-spells.description: Always prepared: Bane, Blindness/Deafness, Phantasmal Force, Ray of Sickness (3); Speak with Dead, Summon Undead (5); Greater Invisibility, Phantasmal Killer (7); Antilife Shell, Cloudkill (9).

feature:feature:grave-touched.description: Your Necrotic damage ignores Necrotic resistance, and once per turn a damaging spell can switch to Necrotic. In Form of Dread, once per turn roll one extra damage die on a Necrotic hit. No need to eat, drink, breathe or sleep for Exhaustion purposes; magic can't put you to sleep.

feature:feature:necrotic-husk.description: Resistance to Necrotic (immunity in Form of Dread). Once per Short or Long Rest, when dropped to 0 HP, chosen creatures in a 30-foot Emanation make a Con save for 2d10 + Cha Necrotic (half on success); you return to twice your Warlock level HP and gain 1 Exhaustion.

feature:feature:superior-dread.description: In Form of Dread: resist Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing; Fly Speed equal to Speed (hover) and move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain (1d10 Force if you end inside); cast Conjuration and Necromancy Warlock spells with no V, S or non-costly M components.

feature:feature:despairing-strikes.description: You have Despairing Strike Dice: three d8s at level 3, four d10s at 10, five d12s at 15, all regained on a Short or Long Rest. Once per attack, when you hit with a weapon, spend one to add that roll as Psychic damage and optionally an effect (save DC 8 + Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus). Abandoned: Intelligence save or Deafened until the end of your next turn, treating every creature it sees as an enemy. Dread: Disadvantage on its next saving throw before the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:solemn-gaze.description: Darkvision 60 feet (or +60 feet if you already have it). Empathetic Inquiry: as a Magic action, a creature within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or you learn an emotion weighing on it (a worry, love, or hate); it knows if it can see you. Wisdom modifier uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

feature:feature:dreaded-appearance.description: When you use Tactical Shift you can teleport up to 30 feet instead of moving. Right after, once per Short or Long Rest, each creature you choose in a 10-foot Emanation makes a Wisdom save: on a failure it takes Psychic damage equal to one Despairing Strike die roll and is Frightened until the end of your next turn; on a success, half damage.

feature:feature:unsettled-strikes.description: New Despairing Strike options. Apathetic: Wisdom save or Incapacitated until the start of your next turn, answering only in single words. Lost: Charisma save or Blinded with Speed 0 until the end of its next turn; on a success its Speed is halved instead. Weary: Constitution save or 1 Exhaustion level (never above 2 from this), removed at the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:grim-constitution.description: Resistance to Necrotic and Psychic damage. When an effect would reduce your Hit Point maximum, make a DC 15 Constitution save to negate it; the DC rises by 5 for each later attempt and resets to 15 on a Short or Long Rest.

feature:feature:grieving-mantle.description: When you use Action Surge, for 1 minute (or until Incapacitated): Shade Form lets you take a Reaction when hit by an attack to reduce its damage to 0, and you are immune to Charmed and Frightened (ending either if present).

feature:feature:face-of-rage.description: While Raging you are unrecognizable to anyone who hasn't seen the change. Unarmed Strikes deal 1d8 and can deal Force instead of their normal type; on a hit, push 10 feet or force a Constitution save (DC 8 + Str mod + PB) or Prone. You count as one size larger for Grapples and your Unarmed Strike reach is +5 feet.

feature:feature:mask-of-civility.description: Proficiency in one of Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Persuasion, or Religion, plus one Artisan's Tools or one language.

feature:feature:brains-and-brawn.description: Not Raging: Resistance to Psychic damage. Raging: Resistance to every damage type except Force and Psychic.

feature:feature:cunning-and-brutal.description: Not Raging: Disengage or Help as a Bonus Action. Raging: Unarmed Strikes crit on 19-20.

feature:feature:better-half.description: Once per Long Rest, when reduced to 0 HP but not killed, drop to 1 HP and gain Temporary HP equal to half your HP maximum (lost after 1 minute). If Raging, the Rage ends; if not, you start Raging even with no uses left.

feature:feature:path-of-the-primal-spiri.description: Summon a spirit beast: Primal Guardian (AC 12 + Con mod, HP 6 + 6 x Barbarian level, Large on land or sea, gains half max HP as temp HP and enrages when Bloodied, Body Block reaction takes damage for an adjacent ally) or Primal Striker (AC 12 + Con mod, HP 5 + 4 x Barbarian level, faster, Advantage on attacks while you Rage). Pick Land, Sea, or Sky for its movement and extras. It adds your PB to checks, attacks, and saves, acts on your turn, Dodges unless you spend a Bonus Action (or give up one attack) to command it. Revive it within an hour with a Magic action and a Rage use; swap it on a Long Rest.

feature:feature:shared-rage.description: While you Rage, your companion has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

feature:feature:kin-to-beasts.description: Animal Friendship and Speak with Animals always prepared; each once per Short or Long Rest without a slot, or with slots. Constitution is the casting ability.

feature:feature:skinrider-s-trance.description: Once per Long Rest (or spend a Rage use to restore), take a Magic action to possess your companion or a Beast under your Animal Friendship within 60 feet, using its HP, Hit Dice, Str, Dex, Con, Speed and senses. Your body is catatonic. Lasts up to half your Barbarian level + Con mod hours.

feature:feature:shape-of-the-wild.description: Once per Short or Long Rest (or spend a Rage use), as a Bonus Action change your companion's form; its HP resets to the new maximum.

feature:feature:rage-of-the-dead.description: While Raging: ignore Difficult Terrain and move through creatures; +10 feet Speed and Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage; see Invisible things within 120 feet and into the Ethereal Plane.

feature:feature:final-night-catharsis.description: Choose an emotion, changeable on a Long Rest. Hate: after you miss a creature, Advantage on your next attack against it before the end of your next turn. Jealousy: Reaction to impose Disadvantage on a creature's check to escape your Grapple. Terror: while Bloodied, Dash or Disengage as a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:dark-doom-revisited.description: Once per Rage, as a Magic action, start an aura for 1 minute; chosen creatures in it make a save at the start of their turns (DC 8 + Con or Str mod + PB) and take a number of d6 equal to your Rage Damage bonus. Contamination (10 ft., Con save): Poison damage and Poisoned. Hypothermia (10 ft., Con save): Cold damage and halved Speed. Immolation (15 ft., Dex save): Fire damage until extinguished.

feature:feature:death-is-but-a-door.description: Advantage on Death Saving Throws and you die only after four failures. Once per Long Rest (or spend two Rage uses), cast Cure Wounds, Revivify, or Raise Dead with no Material components, gaining 1, 2, or 3 Exhaustion levels respectively. Constitution is the casting ability.

feature:feature:powered-by-pathos.description: Your Catharsis emotion adds a Raging benefit. Hate: crit on 19-20. Jealousy: Reaction when a creature starts its turn within 30 feet; Str or Dex save or Grappled until the end of its turn, or on a success its movement costs double. Terror: Reaction when a creature starts its turn within 30 feet to halve its Speed and give Opportunity Attacks against it Advantage until its next turn.

feature:feature:talented-adventurer.description: Learn one adventurer's talent, and one more at Bard levels 6 and 14. Barbarian: 1/Long Rest Bonus Action rampage for 1 minute with B/P/S Resistance (no Heavy armor, no Concentration). Cleric: 1/Short Rest Bonus Action, a creature within 30 feet gains temp HP of half your Bard level + Cha mod for 10 minutes, which it can spend on a hit as extra Radiant damage. Druid: 1/Long Rest Polymorph yourself only, max CR half your Bard level. Fighter: Martial weapons, Shields, and a Fighting Style feat. Monk: unarmored AC 10 + Dex + Cha, Dex for Unarmed Strikes, 1d6 Unarmed Strike, Bonus Action Unarmed Strike after the Attack action or an action spell. Paladin: 1/Short Rest smite with a slot, 1d6 + 1d6 per slot level Radiant (+1d6 vs Fiends and Undead). Ranger: Hunter's Mark prepared, cast at level 5 once per Long Rest without a slot. Rogue: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a Bonus Action. Sorcerer: 1/Short Rest apply one of Careful, Distant, Empowered, Extended, Seeking, Subtle, or Transmuted Spell to a Bard spell. Warlock: one Eldritch Invocation (Bard level counts). Wizard: two extra prepared Wizard spells that count as Bard spells.

feature:feature:party-planner.description: A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die can take the Help action as a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:well-rounded.description: Proficiency with one Artisan's Tools, one skill, and one language of your choice.

feature:feature:improvisational-talent.description: On a Long Rest, swap one adventurer's talent for another.

feature:feature:antagonistic-antics.description: Learn Vicious Mockery (or another Bard cantrip if you have it; it doesn't count against your cantrips) and always have Dissonant Whispers prepared. After you Dash, Disengage, or Influence, you can cast Vicious Mockery as a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:cruel-jest.description: When a creature you can see or hear within 30 feet fails a D20 Test, take a Reaction and spend a Bardic Inspiration: it takes Psychic damage equal to the roll + Cha mod and has Disadvantage on its next D20 Test before the end of its next turn.

feature:feature:gallows-humor.description: When a creature within 60 feet drops to 0 HP or dies, take a Reaction to regain a Bardic Inspiration use; a creature within 30 feet that hears you makes a Wisdom save or is Prone with Speed 0 until the end of its next turn. If it succeeds you keep this feature; otherwise once per Short or Long Rest.

feature:feature:last-laugh.description: Once per Long Rest, when you become Bloodied or take damage while Bloodied, take a Reaction to regain all Bardic Inspiration and gain Resistance to all damage for 1 minute. During that minute, when a creature within 60 feet hits you, spend up to three Inspiration dice: it makes a Charisma save or takes Psychic damage equal to the dice + Cha mod.

feature:feature:chilling-melody.description: Learn two Necromancy cantrips; they count as Bard spells and don't count against your cantrips known.

feature:feature:pluck-the-heartstrings.description: A creature with your Bardic Inspiration die can use it either when dropped to 0 HP (not killed), going to HP equal to the roll instead, or right after hitting with an attack, adding the roll as Necrotic damage.

feature:feature:stir-the-bones.description: Animate Dead is always prepared. When you spend Bardic Inspiration, up to Cha mod (min 1) Undead you control within 60 feet each gain an Inspiration die (outside your limit). Undead that spend one on a hit also add it to damage.

feature:feature:dual-death.description: Once per Long Rest (or spend a Bardic Inspiration use), a single-target Necromancy spell you cast can target a second creature in range.

feature:feature:eldritch-domain-spells.description: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Detect Thoughts, Tasha's Hideous Laughter, See Invisibility, Sleep; 5 Fear, Tongues; 7 Confusion, Phantasmal Killer; 9 Contact Other Plane, Dream.

feature:feature:eldritch-contagion.description: When you cast a slot spell with a Magic action that targets creatures, one target makes a Wisdom save or suffers a d8 Eldritch Effect for 1 minute (repeat save each turn; ends if you use this again): 1 can't speak or cast Verbal spells; 2 1d6 Psychic each turn; 3 falls Prone if it moves more than 5 feet; 4 Disadvantage on attacks and Perception; 5 action or Bonus Action, not both, and one attack; 6 Advantage on its attacks and on attacks against it; 7 Deafened and can't see beyond 30 feet; 8 Frightened.

feature:feature:prophecy-of-doom.description: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Magic action: roll an Eldritch Effect; each creature in a 15-foot-radius Sphere within 120 feet makes a Wisdom save or suffers it for 1 minute (repeat save each turn).

feature:feature:otherworldly-calm.description: Resistance to Psychic damage and Advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened. Your thoughts can't be read without permission; a creature that tries makes a Wisdom save or takes Psychic damage equal to your Cleric level.

feature:feature:sing-the-song-that-ends-.description: A creature that fails its save against Prophecy of Doom can take 10d10 Psychic damage; it is then immune to this for 10 minutes.

feature:feature:inquisition-domain-spell.description: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 See Invisibility, Silence; 5 Dispel Magic, Remove Curse; 7 Arcane Eye, Locate Creature; 9 Creation, Hallow.

feature:feature:witch-hunter-s-strike.description: Wisdom modifier times (min 1) per Long Rest, when you hit with a weapon or Unarmed Strike, add 1d8 Force (2d8 against a concentrating target); at Cleric 14 these become 2d8 and 3d8. If the target then fails its Concentration save, you gain temp HP equal to the extra damage.

feature:feature:spell-shield.description: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Bonus Action: a creature within 30 feet (or you) gains 1d10 + Cleric level temp HP for 10 minutes; while it has them it has Advantage on saves against spells and Resistance to spell damage.

feature:feature:rebuke-invoker.description: Wisdom modifier times (min 1) per Long Rest, take a Reaction when a creature within 60 feet casts a spell with a Magic action: Constitution save or 1d8 Force plus 1d8 per slot level (cantrips count as level 1), half on a success.

feature:feature:supernal-safeguard.description: Spell Shield can target up to your Wisdom modifier (min 1) creatures.

feature:feature:cleanse-with-fire.description: Wis mod + PB times (min 1) per Short or Long Rest, add 1d8 Fire to cantrip damage or a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit.

feature:feature:purification-domain-spel.description: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Detect Poison and Disease, Flame Blade; 5 Fear, Flash Fever; 7 Aura of Purity, Wall of Fire; 9 Flame Strike, Hold Monster.

feature:feature:unclean-brand.description: On a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, spend a Channel Divinity to brand the target instead of dealing normal damage: for 1 minute it has Disadvantage on saves against your spells and Vulnerability to your Fire damage, even if it resists or is immune.

feature:feature:ward-against-corruption.description: Advantage on saves against disease and against effects that change your form. As a Magic action, grant this to a willing creature for 1 hour; it takes Fire damage equal to your Wis mod (min 1), ignoring Resistance and Immunity.

feature:feature:sear-imperfections.description: Cast Lesser Restoration and Greater Restoration on a willing creature with no slot and no Material components; it takes 1d6 Fire per spell level, ignoring Resistance and Immunity.

feature:feature:circle-of-blood-spells.description: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Blood Rush, Crimson Lash, Sense Lifeblood; 5 Blood Bond, Sanguine Poppet; 7 Circle of Scarlet, Dark Sacrament; 9 Dominate Person, Mortality.

feature:feature:rite-of-the-blood-moon.description: Spend a Wild Shape use as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: gain temp HP equal to 3 x Druid level, +10 feet Speed and Dash as a Bonus Action, and your weapon or Unarmed Strike hits can add 1d6 Necrotic.

feature:feature:blood-boon.description: Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest (one back on a Short Rest), when a creature within 60 feet drops to 0 HP, take a Reaction to regain 1 Hit Die and give a creature within 60 feet temp HP equal to your Druid level.

feature:feature:blood-lust.description: During Blood Moon your extra Necrotic becomes 2d6 and you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

feature:feature:exsanguinate.description: Once per Long Rest, a Blood Boon instead restores Hit Dice equal to half your Druid level and gives up to Wis mod creatures within 60 feet temp HP equal to twice your Druid level.

feature:feature:catastrophic-power.description: After each Short or Long Rest pick one until the next rest. Elemental Cataclysm: Magic action, spend a slot for a 10-foot-radius Sphere within 60 feet; Dex save, 1d6 Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning per slot level and Vulnerability to that type for 1 minute (repeat save each turn), half and no Vulnerability on a success. Ruinous Smite: once per turn on a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, spend a slot for 1d8 + 1d8 per slot level Necrotic. Weapon Mastery: use the mastery property of one proficient weapon kind, changeable on a Long Rest.

feature:feature:ruin-incarnate.description: Spend a Wild Shape use as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: Advantage on attacks against Bloodied creatures, two attacks per Attack action, and base AC 17 + Wis mod if higher.

feature:feature:many-roads-to-ruin.description: During Ruin Incarnate, your weapon and Unarmed Strike hits can deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Necrotic instead, and you add Wis mod (min +1) to Strength and Dexterity saves.

feature:feature:shake-the-earth.description: Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action grow one size for 10 minutes; each creature in a 30-foot Emanation makes a Dex save or falls Prone, and grounded structures there take Druid-level d10 Bludgeoning. While enlarged, weapon and Unarmed Strike hits deal +1d4.

feature:feature:entropy-s-apex.description: Creatures hit by your Ruinous Smite suffer crits on 19-20 until the end of your next turn; Ruin Incarnate gives three attacks per Attack action; Shake the Earth recharges on a Short or Long Rest.

feature:feature:circle-of-mutation:circl.description: Wild Shape max CR equals Druid level / 3 (round down), Beast attacks deal +2 damage, and you can Dash, Disengage, or Influence as a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:mutate-shape.description: On entering Wild Shape, or as a Bonus Action in it, spend a slot to gain Mutation Points equal to its level and spend them on mutations (each once per Wild Shape unless repeatable) until you leave the form. Sea (1, +1 for double): swim speed and water breathing. Sky (3, +2 for 60 ft.): fly 30 ft. Darkvision (1): 60 ft. or +60. Disquieting Voice (1): talk with and Influence Beasts. Echolocation (3): Blindsight 30 ft. Enlarge (2, +2 for two sizes). Manipulate Objects (1): Utilize as a Bonus Action. Multiattack (2): two form attacks per Attack action. Natural Armor (2): +1 AC, up to three times. Reduce (1, +2 for two sizes). Venomous Attacks (2): once per turn +2d6 Poison and Con save or Poisoned 1 minute, up to three times for +2d6 each. Wall Crawler (1, +1 for double): climb speed.

feature:feature:unnatural-and-unnerving.description: Spending a level 2+ slot on Mutation Points returns one lower-level slot (max level 5). In Wild Shape your attacks can deal Force instead, and you have Advantage on Deception, Intimidation, and Animal Handling checks.

feature:feature:endless-evolution.description: Gain extra Mutation Points equal to Wis mod (min 1). New mutations: Creature of Earth (3, +2 for burrow): Tremorsense 30 ft. Elemental Inurement (2): Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder, repeatable for different types. Eldritch Assault (2): +1 to form attack and damage, up to three times. Mystic Monster (3): cast spells in Wild Shape, and at Druid 18 targets have Disadvantage on saves against them. Rapid Regeneration (5): regain Wis mod HP each turn. Supernatural Hide (5): B/P/S Resistance.

feature:feature:apex-predator.description: Once per turn a form attack hit deals +2d10 Force. As a Magic action, touch a Beast and spend a slot to give it mutations worth the slot level; they last until replaced or ended by Remove Curse or Greater Restoration.

feature:feature:protective-taunt.description: Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, the target has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the start of your next turn (one taunt per creature).

feature:feature:weather-the-storm.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Bonus Action for 1 minute, gain temp HP equal to Fighter level + Con mod at the end of each of your turns.

feature:feature:threatening-presence.description: Twice per Long Rest (three times at Fighter 15), as a Magic action, chosen creatures that can hear you in a 30-foot Emanation make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Con mod + PB) or take 5d6 Psychic and have Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you. Using it restores Weather the Storm.

feature:feature:aggressive-defense.description: Once on each of your turns, when you hit with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, spend up to half your Fighter level in temp HP to add that much damage.

feature:feature:improved-second-wind.description: When Second Wind heals you, you also gain temp HP equal to the roll's total.

feature:feature:halt-the-assault.description: When a creature within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, take a Reaction to become the target instead, with Resistance to all of that attack's damage.

feature:feature:compound-creator.description: Learn three compounds (two more at Fighter 7, 10, and 15, swapping one each time). On a Long Rest with Alchemist's Supplies, make any number; they vanish at the next Long Rest. Drink one as a Bonus Action, up to 1 + Con mod (min 1) per Long Rest; repeats of the same compound don't stack, and anyone else who drinks one makes a Con save (DC 8 + Int mod + PB) or is Poisoned for 1 minute. Options: Adrenal Injection (+10 ft. Speed and a 30-ft. jump for 10 ft. of movement, 1 minute); Allsense Injection (Blindsight 30 ft., 1 minute); Arcane Eye Oil (sense magic within 30 ft., 1 hour); six Draughts (Advantage on checks and saves of one ability, 10 minutes); Elfsight Oil (Darkvision 120 ft., 8 hours); Fleshknit Phosphate (regain PB HP each turn, 1 minute); Ironmind Injection (Advantage against Charmed and Frightened, 1 hour); Liquid Courage (temp HP 2 x Fighter level + Con mod); Liquid Rage (+1d4 weapon and Unarmed Strike damage, 1 minute); Presto Powder (Advantage on Initiative and Bonus Action Dash or Disengage, 10 minutes); Spellshine Ointment (Resistance to Force, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, 1 minute); Steelskin Ointment (B/P/S Resistance, 1 minute); Tenmen Tincture (one size larger for carrying, and swap a weapon's mastery for Topple, 1 hour).

feature:feature:student-of-alchemy.description: You gain Alchemist's Supplies and proficiency with them, with double Proficiency Bonus on their checks.

feature:feature:living-cauldron.description: You can safely drink 3 + Con mod compounds per Long Rest (5 + Con mod at Fighter 18).

feature:feature:rapid-consumption.description: When you drink a compound as a Bonus Action, you can drink a second one.

feature:feature:toxin-transmutation.description: Resistance to Poison damage. As a Bonus Action end Poisoned on yourself; once per Long Rest doing so grants temp HP equal to your Fighter level.

feature:feature:living-catalyst.description: On a Long Rest, swap one known compound for another.

feature:feature:skilled-guardian.description: Expertise in one skill you're proficient in, plus proficiency in two of Deception, History, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Perception, or Stealth.

feature:feature:ever-vigilant.description: Darkvision 60 feet (or +60). Advantage on Initiative and Wisdom (Perception). Warning Shout: once per Long Rest, when you roll Initiative, take a Reaction so chosen creatures within 30 feet can each use a Reaction to gain Advantage on Initiative and move half their Speed without provoking.

feature:feature:size-up.description: As a Bonus Action, mark a creature within 30 feet until the start of your next turn; when it attacks you or someone within 5 feet of you, take a Reaction to give that roll Disadvantage and the target Resistance to its damage.

feature:feature:night-stalker.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, Bonus Action Blindsight 30 feet for 10 minutes. Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage, and you don't provoke them while entirely in Dim Light or Darkness.

feature:feature:ready-for-action.description: Treat Initiative d20 rolls of 9 or lower as 10. On an Initiative roll of 18-20, take one extra action (not Magic) on your first turn.

feature:feature:beat-down.description: Right after you miss a creature you've Sized Up, use a Bonus Action or Reaction to make a melee attack against it with Advantage.

feature:feature:subtle-hand.description: On your turn your Unarmed Strike reach is +5 feet, and Unarmed Strikes from the Attack action can deal Psychic damage.

feature:feature:psionic-prowess.description: Learn Mage Hand, cast without Verbal or Somatic components, and its hand can be Invisible. As a Magic action, spend 1 Focus Point to cast Detect Evil and Good or Protection from Evil and Good, or 2 to cast Hold Person, Levitate, or Shatter (Wisdom, no Material components).

feature:feature:unsubtle-strike.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit with an Unarmed Strike or Monk weapon, the target makes a Strength save against your Focus save DC or you move it up to 10 feet toward or away from you.

feature:feature:psychic-crush.description: Each Unarmed Strike hit gives the target a Pressure Point (lost after 1 minute or when you mark another creature). Bonus Action, 1 Focus Point: it makes a Strength save; failure deals 1d8 Force per Point and Restrained until the end of your next turn, success half damage.

feature:feature:psionic-mastery.description: As a Magic action, spend 5 Focus Points to cast Dispel Evil and Good, Hold Monster, Telekinesis, or Wall of Force (Wisdom, no Material components).

feature:feature:tall-tales.description: Proficiency in Deception, Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion.

feature:feature:bruised-ego.description: When you spend a Focus Point, gain temp HP equal to Wis mod (min 1), doubled while Bloodied.

feature:feature:assertive-attacker.description: While Bloodied, add Wis mod to Unarmed Strike and Monk weapon damage.

feature:feature:irrational-retaliation.description: When a creature damages you, take a Reaction and spend 1 Focus Point to gain Advantage on attacks against it until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:redoubled-efforts.description: When you crit while Bloodied, roll one extra damage die.

feature:feature:ever-prideful.description: When dropped to 0 HP but not killed, spend 1 Focus Point to enter a trance: immune to Unconscious, can't speak or cast or concentrate, and a crit counts as only one failed Death Save. Spend 1 Focus Point each turn you start at 0 HP to keep it; you still make Death Saves.

feature:feature:egotistical.description: You count as Bloodied whenever you are below your Hit Point maximum.

feature:feature:shade-of-regret.description: Once per turn, spend 1 Focus Point (no action) to create an intangible shade within 10 feet until the end of your next turn. Flurry of Blows attacks can originate from it, dealing Necrotic or Force. Move it up to 60 feet as a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:the-road-not-traveled.description: When you Dash, you can instead teleport yourself or an ally within 60 feet to your shade's location.

feature:feature:aid-not-given.description: Help as a Bonus Action, or spend 1 Focus Point to touch a creature and heal one Martial Arts die + Wis mod.

feature:feature:crushing-guilt.description: Spend 3 Focus Points: chosen creatures in a 20-foot Emanation from you or your shade make a Wisdom save; failure deals three Martial Arts dice Psychic and Prone, success half damage.

feature:feature:relive-the-past.description: Your shade lasts 10 minutes, makes one extra Unarmed Strike after Flurry of Blows, and can deliver Stunning Strike.

feature:feature:debilitating-fever.description: On a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, spend a Channel Divinity: the target is Poisoned and Incapacitated for 1 minute, repeating a Constitution save each turn.

feature:feature:entropic-infection.description: Magic action, spend a Channel Divinity on a creature within 30 feet: for 1 minute your damage to it adds 2d6 Necrotic and it loses Necrotic Resistance and Immunity (Constitution save each turn ends it).

feature:feature:oath-of-pestilence-spell.description: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Bane, Inflict Wounds; 5 Melf's Acid Arrow, Ray of Enfeeblement; 9 Flash Fever, Stinking Cloud; 13 Blight, Confusion; 17 Contagion, Insect Plague.

feature:feature:aura-of-rampant-sickness.description: When a creature in your Aura of Protection is about to make a D20 Test, take a Reaction to give it Disadvantage.

feature:feature:disgusting-resilience.description: When dropped to 0 HP but not killed, spend and roll Hit Dice to reduce the damage by the total. If you die, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation makes a Constitution save, taking 8d6 Necrotic or half on a success.

feature:feature:plaguebringer.description: Once per Long Rest (or spend a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: immune to Poison and Poisoned, Resistance to Necrotic, HP maximum can't be reduced, and enemies starting their turn in your aura take Necrotic equal to Cha mod + PB.

feature:feature:frenzied-slaughter.description: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Bonus Action to frenzy until the end of your next turn: when you miss with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, take a Reaction to attack again, and Advantage on saves against Charmed, Frightened, and Stunned. Extend it each turn by attacking an enemy, forcing an enemy's save, or ending your turn Bloodied, up to 1 minute; it ends if you're Incapacitated.

feature:feature:oath-of-slaughter-spells.description: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Crimson Lash, Inflict Wounds; 5 Bloodletter, Shatter; 9 Fear, Suffocate; 13 Consume Mind, Supernal Smite; 17 Destructive Wave, Incite Riot.

feature:feature:bloodthirst-aura.description: Bloodied allies in your Aura of Protection add your Cha mod to weapon and Unarmed Strike damage. Take a Reaction to give a Bloodied creature in the aura Disadvantage on a save against a Sangromancy spell.

feature:feature:follow-through.description: When a creature in your Aura of Protection becomes Bloodied, take a Reaction to move half your Speed without provoking and make a melee attack with Advantage.

feature:feature:blood-knight.description: Once per Long Rest (or spend a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: gain 30 temp HP whenever an enemy Bloodies a creature in your aura; take a Reaction to attack a creature that hits you; and on a melee hit, chosen creatures within 5 feet of the target and in your reach take Force equal to Cha mod (min 1) + PB.

feature:feature:mark-of-the-heretic.description: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Bonus Action to mark a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute: your weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks against it crit on 19-20, and when it starts its turn in your reach you can take a Reaction to attack it.

feature:feature:oath-of-zeal-spells.description: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Detect Evil and Good, Hunter's Mark; 5 Detect Thoughts, Knock; 9 Fear, Tongues; 13 Divination, Locate Creature; 17 Insect Plague, Scrying.

feature:feature:aura-of-clarity.description: You and allies in your Aura of Protection are immune to Blinded there, and you see Invisible creatures in it.

feature:feature:compel-confession.description: Cast Zone of Truth without a slot. A creature that succeeds on its save takes 1d6 Psychic at the start of each of its turns in the zone until it chooses to fail.

feature:feature:apocalyptic-revelation.description: Once per Long Rest (or spend a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 1 minute: enemies starting their turn within 5 feet make a Constitution save or are Blinded until their next turn; Truesight 60 feet; and as a Bonus Action pick a creature within 60 feet that you and allies attack with Advantage.

feature:feature:envenomed-attack.description: Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action, poison a weapon or up to 20 ammunition for 1 minute: +1d4 Poison on hits. At Ranger 11, 2d4 and uses return on a Short or Long Rest.

feature:feature:toxic-tradecraft.description: Poisoner's Kit with proficiency and double PB on its checks; rebuild a lost kit with an hour of foraging during a rest. Once per turn when your weapon deals Poison damage, spend a slot for +1d6 Poison and Poisoned until the end of your next turn, plus a Toxin Effect by slot level. Level 1: Attenuate (Disadvantage on Str and Dex saves), Befuddled (can't speak, read or write; Disadvantage on Concentration), Uncoordinated (no Reactions, Disengage, or Dodge). Level 2: Debilitate (no healing 1 minute), Potent (loses Poison Resistance 1 minute), Suffer (+1d6 the first Poison damage each turn for 1 minute). Level 3: Lingering (Poisoned 10 minutes, save each turn with Disadvantage), Supernatural (loses Poisoned Immunity and is Poisoned 1 minute). Level 4: Flesh Eating (Poisoned 1 minute, 2d6 Acid each turn), Insensate (also Blinded and Deafened), Paraplegia (Speed 0, Disadvantage on Dex saves). Level 5: Enhanced (a level 4 effect plus a level 1 or 2 effect) or Stinging Application (once per turn +5d6 Acid, Necrotic, or Poison for 1 minute).

feature:feature:green-reaper-spells.description: Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Detect Poison and Disease; 5 Hold Person; 9 Bestow Curse; 13 Greater Invisibility; 17 Cloudkill.

feature:feature:poison-control.description: Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saves against Poisoned. Cast Protection from Poison without a slot Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest.

feature:feature:variegated-vexations.description: Your weapon Poison damage can be Acid or Necrotic instead.

feature:feature:pain-tolerance.description: Just before a creature within 60 feet damages you, take a Reaction to gain temp HP equal to that damage; leftovers vanish at the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:elemental-arrows.description: Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action imbue a Longbow or Shortbow for 1 minute: it deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder instead of its normal type plus 1d6 of that type. You can switch type at the start of each turn.

feature:feature:herbal-lore.description: Herbalism Kit with proficiency. Use it as a Bonus Action to stabilize a creature at 0 HP within 5 feet without a check; once per Short or Long Rest, a Utilize action instead brings it to 1 HP.

feature:feature:primordial-archer-spells.description: Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Hex; 5 Blindness/Deafness; 9 Call Lightning; 13 Polymorph; 17 Wall of Stone.

feature:feature:weave-the-elements.description: After an hour's work or a Long Rest with an Herbalism Kit, gain Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder until your next Long Rest.

feature:feature:witching-arrows.description: Once per turn when you hit with a Longbow or Shortbow, spend a slot for an effect; damage +2d6 per slot level above 1. Arcing Shot: attack a second creature within 30 feet, each hit takes 2d6 Lightning. Entangling Shot: Strength save or 2d6 Piercing and Restrained 1 minute (repeat save). Hexing Shot: Wisdom save or 2d6 Psychic and Charmed or Frightened 1 minute (repeat save), half on success. Viper Shot: Constitution save or 2d6 Poison and Poisoned 1 minute (repeat save), half on success.

feature:feature:primordial-magic.description: Damage can't break Concentration on your Ranger spells. Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action switch your Weave the Elements type and force a creature within 30 feet to make a Constitution save or take 6d6 of either type.

feature:feature:verminkin.description: Talk with Tiny Beasts. Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Magic action spend a slot to summon as many Swarms of Vermin as its level for 1 hour (AC 11 + slot level, HP 5 + 10 per slot level, B/P/S Resistance, Pack Tactics, Bites using your spell attack for 2d6 + 1 + slot level Piercing). They act on your turn and Dodge unless you command them all with one Bonus Action.

feature:feature:swarming-strikes.description: Wis mod + PB times per Short or Long Rest, a Bonus Action command makes all your swarms attack, or one swarm attack twice.
