feature:feature:vermin-lord-spells.description: Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Consumption; 5 Animal Messenger; 9 Flash Fever; 13 Freedom of Movement; 17 Contagion.

feature:feature:filth-and-fortitude.description: Immune to the Poisoned condition and proficient in Constitution saves.

feature:feature:infectious-spread.description: With Swarming Strikes each attacking swarm makes one more attack, and creatures they damage are Poisoned until the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:strength-of-the-swarm.description: When a creature within 10 feet damages you, take a Reaction to redirect the damage to one of your swarms within 5 feet.

feature:feature:hair-trigger.description: Proficiency with Blackpowder Pistols. When you roll Initiative without Disadvantage, take a Reaction to attack once, move your Speed without provoking, have your controlled mount move its Speed without provoking, or Dodge or Utilize.

feature:feature:trusty-mount.description: Find Steed always prepared; once per Long Rest cast it with no slot or components, using Intelligence.

feature:feature:ride-them-down.description: You don't need Advantage for Sneak Attack if you or your controlled mount moved at least 20 feet and you don't have Disadvantage.

feature:feature:horse-lord.description: Spend 1 minute grooming your mount to give it temp HP equal to twice your Rogue level. A mount you control can Dash, Disengage, or Dodge as a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:true-grit.description: Proficiency in Constitution saves; against half-damage Constitution saves you take none on a success and half on a failure.

feature:feature:desperado.description: When dropped to 0 HP but not killed, you can use Hair Trigger before falling Unconscious.

feature:feature:evil-eye.description: As a Bonus Action curse a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute (one at a time); you can Sneak Attack it whenever you don't have Disadvantage.

feature:feature:misfortunist.description: Learn two Misfortunes (one more at Rogue 9, 13, and 17; swap one per Long Rest). You have 4 Jinx Points (6 at Rogue 13), regained on a Short or Long Rest; save DC 8 + Cha or Int mod + PB. Most end the Evil Eye curse when used. Befuddled (2, Magic action): Wis save or Charmed 10 minutes. Clumsy (3, Reaction when it moves): Prone and Speed 0. Debilitated (1, Reaction when it takes damage): +1d12 Necrotic. Doomed (1, Reaction): reroll your missed attack. Fearful (2, Magic action): Wis save or Frightened 1 minute. Inept (1, Reaction): it rerolls a D20 Test. Insensate (3, Magic action): Wis save or Blinded and Deafened 1 minute. Maimed (2, Reaction): your hit on a 19 becomes a crit. Marked (2, Bonus Action): Evil Eye lasts 1 hour and you sense its direction. Plagued (1, Reaction): halve its healing and block healing until your next turn. Somnolent (3, Magic action): Wis save or Unconscious 1 minute. Unlucky (3, Bonus Action): subtract 1d4 from its attacks and saves while cursed.

feature:feature:steal-luck.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, when a creature within 30 feet is about to roll a D20 Test with Advantage, take a Reaction to cancel the Advantage and regain 1 Jinx Point.

feature:feature:curse-caster.description: Spend 3 Jinx Points as a Magic action to cast Bestow Curse.

feature:feature:improved-steal-luck.description: Steal Luck works three times per Long Rest.

feature:feature:sanguine-thief:spellcast.description: Third-caster Wizard spellcasting with Intelligence (Sangromancy spells count as Wizard spells): three cantrips (four at Rogue 10), prepared spells 3 at level 3 rising to 13 at level 20, and slots per the Eldritch Knight-style table (two 1st at level 3 up to one 4th at level 19).

feature:feature:stolen-power.description: You have a pool of Sangromancy Dice (d8s) equal to your Sneak Attack dice, refilled on a Long Rest. Spend them instead of Hit Dice when casting Sangromancy spells.

feature:feature:steal-blood.description: Int mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, when you deal Sneak Attack damage restore 1 Sangromancy Die, or while Bloodied roll it and heal that much instead.

feature:feature:bloody-blades.description: On a Long Rest spend up to 2 Hit Dice or Sangromancy Dice to make that many Daggers that last until your next Long Rest. They work as Arcane Foci (and allow Somatic components), and a crit with one adds Necrotic d8s equal to the dice spent.

feature:feature:bloodstitch.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Magic action spend 3 Hit Dice or Sangromancy Dice: chosen creatures in a 30-foot Emanation make a Dex save, 3d8 Necrotic or half. Regain one die per creature it drops to 0 HP.

feature:feature:bloody-exit.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, when hit by an attack take a Reaction and spend 5 Hit Dice or Sangromancy Dice: the attack misses, you teleport up to 30 feet, and you can make a melee attack that deals +5d8 Necrotic on a hit.

feature:feature:apocalyptic-spells.description: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Augury, Comprehend Languages, Hellish Rebuke, Ray of Enfeeblement; 5 Bestow Curse, Revivify; 7 Banishment, Divination; 9 Contagion, Insect Plague.

feature:feature:unhinged-asseverations.description: Calligrapher's Supplies proficiency; scribe Spell Scrolls in half the time and cost. You can ensorcell a scroll by spending a slot of its level or higher and Sorcery Points for a Metamagic option: anyone who knows a language can use it and gets that Metamagic. It lasts until used or your next Long Rest.

feature:feature:bear-witness.description: While Innate Sorcery is active: Resistance to Force damage, immunity to Frightened, and once per activation use an Action-casting-time Spell Scroll as a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:arcane-apocrypha.description: On each Long Rest create one free Spell Scroll of a level 5 or lower spell you can cast; it crumbles at your next Long Rest.

feature:feature:forbidden-magic.description: When you cast a Sorcerer spell with a slot, pick one. Excessive: skip a costly Material component and take 4 x slot level Force damage (ignores Resistance). Inexorable: damage can't break Concentration on it, and you gain 1 Exhaustion when it ends. Pyrrhic: its attack automatically hits as a crit, and your HP maximum drops by 4 x slot level until a Long Rest.

feature:feature:the-end-is-nigh.description: Once per Long Rest (or 6 Sorcery Points), as a Magic action chosen creatures in a 30-foot Emanation make a Wisdom save: 6d6 Psychic plus 6d6 Force and Frightened 1 minute (repeat save), half on success. A creature this drops to 0 HP can be revived only by True Resurrection or Wish.

feature:feature:haunted-spells.description: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Bane, Chill Touch, Invisibility, See Invisibility, Unseen Servant; 5 Fly, Speak with Dead; 7 Death Ward, Greater Invisibility; 9 Little Death, Telekinesis.

feature:feature:sixth-sense.description: Add your Cha mod to Initiative rolls.

feature:feature:phantom-companion.description: Learn Find Familiar and cast it as a Magic action with no slot; the familiar is an Undead Specter. As a Magic action it turns Invisible (leaving no trace) until it attacks or you cast through it. You can give up one of your attacks to let it use Life Drain with its Reaction.

feature:feature:strength-of-spirit.description: The familiar gains 4 x Sorcerer level HP maximum, you can cast spells as if from its space, and after casting a spell with your action you can command its Life Drain as a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:deathly-pallor.description: Resistance to Necrotic damage; your damaging Sorcerer spells can deal Necrotic instead.

feature:feature:phantom-possession.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Magic action your familiar tries to possess a creature within 5 feet of it: Charisma save or it controls the body for 1 minute (using the host's HP, Hit Dice, Str, Dex, Con, Speed, senses), obeying your telepathic commands within 100 feet. The host repeats the save whenever it takes damage. On a success it can't try that creature again for 24 hours.

feature:feature:become-death.description: Once per Long Rest, when dropped to 0 HP but not killed, drop to 1 HP and gain temp HP equal to half your HP maximum. While they last you have Resistance to all damage, fly 30 feet (hover), move through creatures, and at the start of each turn lose 10 temp HP while chosen creatures within 30 feet take 10 Necrotic.

feature:feature:bad-luck-charm.description: Once per Short or Long Rest (or 1 Sorcery Point), as a Bonus Action a creature within 30 feet has Disadvantage on its next D20 Test before the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:blood-ties.description: Detect Evil and Good always prepared; once per Short or Long Rest cast it without a slot. Choose Fey, Fiend, or Undead as your ancestral curser: while you concentrate on it, those creatures have Disadvantage on attacks against you and can't possess, Charm, or Frighten you.

feature:feature:wretched-curse.description: Pick one. Hulking: Disadvantage on Stealth to move quietly, +1 HP per Sorcerer level, one size larger for carrying. Nocturnal: Disadvantage on sight-based Perception in sunlight, see normally in Dim Light and Darkness (even magical) within 120 feet. Plaguebearer: Disadvantage on Persuasion with Indifferent Humanoids within 5 feet, immune to Poisoned, Resistance to Necrotic.

feature:feature:share-the-burden.description: Bestow Curse always prepared; cast it for 3 Sorcery Points instead of a slot, with no Concentration and 60-foot range.

feature:feature:terrifying-visage.description: Once per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes; a Magic action makes chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Wisdom save or be Frightened until the end of your next turn. Plus by curser: Fey, Bonus Action teleport 30 feet; Fiend, Resistance to Cold and Fire; Undead, Reaction to reduce non-Radiant damage by half your Sorcerer level.

feature:feature:vengeful-summons.description: As a Magic action spend 5 Sorcery Points to summon for 10 minutes a Lamia or Troll (Fey), Barbed Devil, Incubus, or Succubus (Fiend), or Ghost or Wraith (Undead). It acts right after you and obeys your spoken commands, otherwise Dodging.

feature:feature:coven-spells.description: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Hold Person, Identify, Locate Object, Ray of Sickness; 5 Bestow Curse, Counterspell; 7 Phantasmal Killer, Polymorph; 9 Divination, Locate Creature; 17 Contact Other Plane, Scrying.

feature:feature:hag-s-eye.description: You carry a Hag's Eye that works as an Arcane Focus (your Hag sees through it). While you have it, cast Hex without a slot Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, and from Warlock 10 cast Bestow Curse once per Long Rest without a slot.

feature:feature:hag-s-guile.description: Learn Minor Illusion (or another Warlock cantrip if you have it; it doesn't count against your cantrips). Take a Reaction to give Disadvantage to a Study check against your illusion. Cha mod times (min 1) per Short or Long Rest, when a creature first sees through your illusion spell with a Study check, it takes 1d6 + 1d6 per slot level Psychic.

feature:feature:hag-s-visage.description: Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action for 1 minute. Horrifying Gaze (Bonus Action): a Humanoid within 30 feet that can see you makes a Wisdom save with Disadvantage or is Frightened 1 minute (repeat save). Paralyzing Gaze (Magic action): a Frightened Humanoid makes a Wisdom save or is Paralyzed; on success it takes Necrotic equal to your Warlock level and is freed. Death Gaze (Magic action): a Paralyzed Humanoid saves with Advantage or drops to 0 HP; on success it takes twice your Warlock level Necrotic and is freed. A creature that succeeds is immune until your next Long Rest.

feature:feature:hag-s-craft.description: Once per Long Rest, spend a slot to turn a vessel into a Hag's Cauldron for 10 minutes and pour three Common, two Uncommon, or one Rare potion (they fade at your next rest). On a Long Rest you can also spend a slot to turn a 10 GP gem into a Minor Heartstone for 24 hours: immunity to Poisoned and one Blink without a slot.

feature:feature:drain-life.description: After the Attack or Magic action, make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action dealing 1d6 + Cha mod Necrotic. On a hit you can spend a Pact slot for +1d8 + 1d8 per slot level Necrotic, healing that much.

feature:feature:nocturnal-predator.description: Darkvision 60 feet, or +60 if you already have it.

feature:feature:first-vampire-spells.description: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Bane, Command, False Life, Fog Cloud; 5 Conjure Animals (bats, rats, or wolves only), Gaseous Form; 7 Dominate Person, Seeming; 9 Little Death, Telekinesis.

feature:feature:creature-of-the-night.description: Polymorph always prepared; Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest cast it on yourself only, with no slot or Material component, becoming a Bat, Rat, or Wolf while keeping your HP, Hit Dice, mental scores, features, and proficiencies.

feature:feature:eldritch-appetite.description: Once per Long Rest, when Drain Life drops an enemy to 0 HP, take a Reaction to regain one Pact slot.

feature:feature:eternal-night.description: You stop aging and gain Resistance to Necrotic. Once per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action for 1 minute: regain 1d6 HP at the start of each turn (not in sunlight or running water, or after Radiant damage), and Drain Life deals +1d8 Necrotic without a slot.

feature:feature:spell-siphon.description: Right after a creature within 60 feet casts a spell, take a Reaction: it makes a Charisma save or can't cast that spell for 8 hours, and if it was level 1+ and a level you can cast, you have it prepared meanwhile. You hold up to 1 + Cha mod spell levels; you lose them if Incapacitated, dead, or after a Long Rest.

feature:feature:physical-specimen.description: Once per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action pick up to Cha mod (min 1) benefits until your next Long Rest (swap one per Short Rest): +Warlock level HP maximum; Darkvision 60 (or +60); +5 feet Speed; Advantage on saves against Poisoned; triple jump and climb speed; add Cha mod to Athletics or Acrobatics.

feature:feature:symbiotic-sentinel.description: You can't be surprised, have Advantage on Initiative, and Advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened.

feature:feature:spawn-pawn.description: Dominate Person always prepared and castable once per Long Rest without a slot. Damage can't break your Concentration on it, and a creature that succeeds on its save takes Psychic damage equal to your Warlock level.

feature:feature:larval-regeneration.description: Once per Long Rest, when you die a parasite (Rat stat block with your HP, Hit Dice, mental scores, features; no spells) bursts out under your control. As a Magic action it can burrow into a Humanoid within 5 feet (Str or Dex save; Piercing equal to Warlock level), where it is untouchable except by Psychic damage. Each of the host's turns it can use its action on a Con save to expel it; otherwise it takes twice your Warlock level Necrotic at the end of its turn, and if that kills it you take over the body as with Reincarnate.

feature:feature:fair-and-foul.description: On each Long Rest choose Arch Daemons or Arch Seraphs and you can prepare only that side's free spellbook spells. Arch Daemon at Wizard levels 3 Bane, Toll the Dead; 5 Fear; 7 Dark Sacrament; 9 Geas. Arch Seraph: 3 Aid, Bless, Word of Radiance; 5 Revivify; 7 Guardian of Faith; 9 Greater Restoration.

feature:feature:stolen-secrets.description: Gain one Eldritch Invocation (two more at Wizard 6 and 14), using Wizard level for prerequisites and Intelligence instead of Charisma; swap one each Wizard level.

feature:feature:borrowed-tongues-and-hid.description: Siphoning Daemons: Resistance to Necrotic and mutual understanding with Fiends. Siphoning Seraphs: Resistance to Radiant and mutual understanding with Celestials. Once per Long Rest switch sides as a Bonus Action.

feature:feature:unearthly-countenance.description: Once per Long Rest (or a level 5+ slot), as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: Advantage on Charisma checks, your Fair and Foul spells cast one slot level higher, and fly 60 feet.

feature:feature:eternal-war-eruption.description: Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action, each creature in a 30-foot-radius Sphere within 120 feet makes a Charisma save: 4d10 Necrotic plus 4d10 Radiant and Blinded until the end of its next turn, or half on success. You may switch sides and regain one Wizard slot of level 5 or lower.

feature:feature:potion-craft.description: Proficiency in Medicine, Herbalism Kit, and Alchemist's Supplies. With 10 minutes' work or a rest and a kit, spend a slot per potion to bottle a single-target spell from your spellbook of that level or lower. A creature drinks or administers one as a Bonus Action and becomes the spell's target (concentrating itself if needed). They last until your next Long Rest or next use.

feature:feature:good-medicine.description: Instead of a spell, a slot can make Good Medicine: the drinker heals 1d8 per slot level, and a level 3+ dose also ends Poisoned.

feature:feature:bad-medicine.description: A slot can make Bad Medicine with one effect per slot level: Poisoned; Speed halved; +1d4 Necrotic the first time it takes damage each turn; 1d6 Poison whenever it takes an action, Bonus Action, or Reaction; Acid equal to slot level each turn. Throw it as a Magic action at a point within 30 feet: creatures within 10 feet make a Con save or suffer one effect for 1 minute (an action to repeat the save).

feature:feature:breathe-it-in.description: After taking Necrotic or Poison damage, gain that much temp HP. Immune to Poisoned.

feature:feature:medicinal-master.description: Good Medicine heals +2d8. Bad Medicine Acid deals +2d8, and targets save with Disadvantage.

feature:feature:sangromancy-savant.description: Sangromancy spells count as Wizard spells. Add two of level 2 or lower to your spellbook free, and one more each time you gain a new spell slot level.

feature:feature:full-blooded.description: A pool of 1 + Wizard level Sangromancy Dice (d12s) you can spend instead of Hit Dice for Sangromancy spells; regain one on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest.

feature:feature:sanguine-vigor.description: +6 HP maximum, plus 1 per later Wizard level. Casting a Sangromancy spell with a slot heals you by the slot level.

feature:feature:blood-for-blood.description: Once per turn when your Wizard spell damages creatures, spend a Hit Die or Sangromancy Die to add its roll to one target's damage (roll twice and take the higher against a Bloodied target).

feature:feature:red-renewal.description: Once per Long Rest, finishing a Short Rest restores Hit Dice and Sangromancy Dice equal to half your Wizard level.

feature:feature:unarguable-wizardry.description: Advantage on Intimidation checks to convince people you are a wizard. When someone questions your magic, take a Reaction to Rage until the end of your next turn without spending a use (it can't be extended).

feature:feature:cantrips.description: Once per turn when you hit with a Strength-based attack, add one. Mage Hand: push a Large or smaller target 5 feet (10 while Raging). Shocking Grasp: it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the end of this turn (until your next turn while Raging). True Strike: +1d6 of the attack's type (plus half your Barbarian level while Raging).

feature:feature:spells.description: While Raging, each once per Long Rest. Burning Hands: as an action, Unarmed Strike every creature in reach for 1d8 + Str mod Bludgeoning and Disadvantage on its next attack. Magic Missile: as an action, three Strength thrown-weapon attacks with Advantage. Shield: Reaction when hit to don a Shield, adding its AC against the attack and reducing damage by your Barbarian level if it still hits.

feature:feature:magic-resistance.description: While Raging, Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects.

feature:feature:i-cast-fist.description: Once per Rage, replace one attack with an Unarmed Strike at Advantage dealing 6d6 + Str mod Bludgeoning and knocking a Huge or smaller target Prone.

feature:feature:kick-in-the-door.description: Advantage on attack rolls during the first round of combat.

feature:feature:heroic-superstition.description: Gain Heroic Inspiration when you deal damage a creature is Vulnerable to, trigger a creature's specific weakness, correctly guess a non-Humanoid creature's kind before seeing it, find a secret door, detect or disarm a trap, or find an Uncommon or better magic item or 100+ GP treasure.

feature:feature:dungeon-precautions.description: Five times per Long Rest, cast Alarm, Comprehend Languages, Detect Magic, Detect Poison and Disease, Find Traps, Identify, or Purify Food and Drink without a slot, using Int, Wis, or Cha.

feature:feature:monster-kill.description: Once per turn, a weapon hit on an Aberration, Dragon, Fey, Fiend, Monstrosity, Ooze, or Undead deals +1d10 of the weapon's type.

feature:feature:avoidance.description: Against half-damage Str, Dex, or Con saves you take none on a success and half on a failure, unless Incapacitated.

feature:feature:veteran-hero.description: You can hold two Heroic Inspirations (one per roll), and once per turn spend one to turn a D20 Test into a 20 instead of rerolling.

feature:feature:combo.description: When an Unarmed Strike hits and deals damage, spend 1 Focus Point: your Unarmed Strikes get +2 to hit this turn, rising by 2 per further hit (max +6). Taking damage or missing resets it to +2.

feature:feature:iron-fist.description: Your Unarmed Strikes against objects are always Critical Hits.

feature:feature:special-moves.description: 1 Focus Point each. Energy Blast: replace an attack; a creature within 60 feet makes a Dex save for two Martial Arts dice Force, half on success. Guard Breaker: after missing with an Unarmed Strike, deal Dex mod damage anyway and keep your Combo bonus. Uppercut: after an Unarmed Strike hits, push 5 feet and knock a Large or smaller target Prone.

feature:feature:air-dash.description: On your turn spend 1 Focus Point to fly at your Speed until the end of your next turn and gain Advantage on your next melee attack this turn.

feature:feature:k-o.description: Once per Short or Long Rest (or 5 Focus Points), an Unarmed Strike hit adds three Martial Arts dice Force; if the target is left at 100 HP or fewer it is Unconscious for 10 minutes.

feature:feature:oath-of-revelry-spells.description: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Charm Person, Hideous Laughter; 5 Enhance Ability, Hangover; 9 Create Food and Water, Hypnotic Pattern; 13 Charm Monster, Freedom of Movement; 17 Geas, Telepathic Bond.

feature:feature:conjure-drink.description: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Magic action to conjure up to Cha mod (min 1) mugs of ale within 30 feet (gone after a Long Rest). Drinking one as a Bonus Action grants temp HP equal to your Cha mod and Advantage on saves for 1 minute.

feature:feature:aura-of-fraternity.description: You and allies in your Aura of Protection deal +1d4 on melee weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks.

feature:feature:merrymaker.description: Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, take a Reaction to give yourself or an ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you Advantage on a D20 Test; the use isn't spent if it still fails.

feature:feature:party-animal.description: Once per Long Rest (or a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: Aura of Fraternity becomes 1d8, you grant Heroic Inspiration to an ally in the aura each turn, and you and allies in it are immune to Blinded, Deafened, Exhaustion, and Poisoned.

feature:feature:webbing.description: As a Bonus Action produce webs lasting 1 minute: zip to a point within 30 feet without provoking (or as a Reaction while falling, 10 feet any direction); manipulate or snatch an unattended object under 10 pounds within 30 feet; make an anchored 60-foot rope; or, twice per Long Rest (one back on a Short Rest), cast Web in a 5-foot Cube for 1 minute with DC 8 + Dex mod + PB.

feature:feature:venomous-strike.description: Your Sneak Attack can deal d8s of Poison instead of d6s of the weapon's type.

feature:feature:wall-crawling.description: Climb Speed equal to your Speed, spider climb with free hands, and you can Hide on a ceiling while Lightly Obscured from enemies below.

feature:feature:spider-sense.description: When you take damage from a saving throw effect, use Uncanny Dodge as a Reaction to halve it.

feature:feature:paralytic-venom.description: New Cunning Strike option, Paralyze (4d6): when Venomous Strike deals Poison, the target makes a Con save or is Paralyzed until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:future-you-spells.description: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Accelerate/Decelerate, Delay, Enhance Ability, Moment to Think, Recall; 5 Protection from Energy, Slow; 7 Death Ward, Dire Warning; 9 Legend Lore, Telepathic Bond. You also pick up a quirk from talking to yourself across time.

feature:feature:it-happened-like-this.description: After each Short or Long Rest the GM secretly rolls a d20 and a d4, and tells you the d20 (lying if the d4 shows 4). Before any D20 Test by you or a creature you can see, you can replace it with the recorded d20.

feature:feature:i-could-do-with-fewer-sc.description: Twice per Long Rest (one back on a Short Rest), when hit by an attack you can see, take a Reaction for +10 AC against it.

feature:feature:expect-an-ambush.description: Advantage on Initiative and Resistance to all damage during the first round of combat.

feature:feature:grandfather-paradox.description: Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action a creature within 60 feet makes an Int save: 10d6 Psychic and Stunned for 1 minute (repeat save each turn), or half damage only.

feature:feature:persona-masks.description: Own three masks (four at Bard 6, five at 14), swapping one per Long Rest; put on or switch one as a Bonus Action; remake a lost one in 8 hours. Angel: once per turn spend Bardic Inspiration to add a die of Radiant damage. Archmage: always prepared Fire Bolt, Scorching Ray, Thunderwave (3), Lightning Bolt (5), Ice Storm (7), Wall of Stone (9). Devil: Reaction when damaged by a creature within 30 feet, spend Inspiration for two dice of Fire damage to it and that much temp HP. Dragon: on donning and as a Bonus Action each turn, spend Inspiration for a 15-foot Cone, Dex save for two dice of Fire (half on success). Faceless: Disguise Self prepared, castable without a slot as a 1-minute, 8-hour casting. Gladiator: Martial weapons and Shields, and spend Inspiration for a Bonus Action attack. Hierophant: always prepared Aid, Cure Wounds, Spare the Dying (3), Revivify (5), Death Ward (7), Mass Cure Wounds (9). Jester: on donning and as a Bonus Action each turn move half your Speed without provoking, and spend Inspiration to cast Vicious Mockery with it. Noble: grant Bardic Inspiration as part of donning it, and creatures that fail a D20 Test with your die roll it twice and keep the higher.

feature:feature:thespian.description: Disguise Kit proficiency, and add your Bardic Inspiration die to Performance checks without spending it.

feature:feature:virtuoso-skill.description: Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, once per turn make a D20 Test with Charisma instead of its usual ability.

feature:feature:master-of-many-faces.description: Wear two masks at once and gain both.

feature:feature:chromatic-affinity.description: On each Long Rest pick Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison; your Cleric spells and features can deal it instead of Necrotic or Radiant. Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, once per turn add damage of that type equal to your Cleric level.

feature:feature:dragon-domain-spells.description: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Chromatic Orb, Command, Darkvision, Dragon's Breath; 5 Fly, Protection from Energy; 7 Banishment, Charm Monster; 9 Dominate Person, Summon Dragon.

feature:feature:draconic-majesty.description: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Magic action: chosen creatures in a 30-foot Emanation make a Wisdom save or are Charmed or Frightened (your pick) for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn.

feature:feature:wyrm-s-blessing.description: Spend a Channel Divinity to cast Dragon's Breath or Protection from Energy on yourself without a slot or Concentration.

feature:feature:legendary-aspect.description: Three times per Long Rest (or regain one with a level 2+ slot), take a Legendary Action right after another creature's turn, each option once per round. Rend: move your Speed and cast an action Cleric cantrip or make a melee attack using Wisdom. Tail Swipe: chosen Large or smaller creatures within 10 feet fall Prone. Wingbeat: move your Speed flying without provoking.

feature:feature:circle-of-the-city-spell.description: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Grease, Jump, Shatter, Spider Climb; 5 Meld into Stone, Sending; 7 Fabricate, Stone Shape; 9 Animate Objects, Passwall.

feature:feature:city-shape.description: Spend a Wild Shape use to cast Meld into Stone, Passwall, or Stone Shape without a slot.

feature:feature:urban-druid.description: Pick Acrobatics, History, Intimidation, Investigation, Persuasion, or Stealth each Long Rest and add Wis mod (min +1) to it. Your plant spells take urban forms, and plant-targeting spells like Speak with Plants and Tree Stride can use structures.

feature:feature:object-shape.description: Your Wild Shape can become an Animate Objects object up to Large (Huge from Druid 10).

feature:feature:wall-warp.description: Once per Long Rest (or a level 3+ slot), when a creature within 60 feet takes damage from an attack, take a Reaction to raise a 10-by-10-foot stone panel (AC 15, 30 HP) between it and the attacker that takes the hit and vanishes at the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:urban-colossus.description: As an animated object: AC 18; once per turn reduce damage under 10 to 0; Slam twice per Attack action; move through creatures, and those your size or smaller take 2d6 + Wis mod Bludgeoning and fall Prone (once per turn each).

feature:feature:lycanthrope.description: Claws: Unarmed Strikes can use Dex and deal 1d6 + Str or Dex mod Slashing. Climb Speed equal to your Speed. Darkvision 60 feet (or +60).

feature:feature:bestial-aspect.description: After you damage an enemy, a Bonus Action raises your Bestial Aspect Level by 1 (resets after a minute without damaging an enemy). Benefits stack: 1 Carnage (+2 weapon and Unarmed Strike damage); 2 +10 feet Speed; 3 Advantage against creatures below full HP; 4 +2 AC without a Shield; 5 Reaction melee attack against an adjacent creature that damages you.

feature:feature:feral-howl.description: When you roll Initiative, roll a d4 and set your Bestial Aspect Level to the result.

feature:feature:bloodthirsty-fury.description: You can cast Hunter's Mark as part of the Bonus Action that raises your Bestial Aspect, and Carnage becomes +3.

feature:feature:monstrous-resilience.description: Once per turn reduce damage you take by Con mod + your Bestial Aspect Level.

feature:feature:heroic-spells.description: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Arc Blade, Burning Blade, Frigid Blade, Heroism, Magic Weapon, Mirror Image, Shield; 5 Haste, Phantom Steed; 7 Death Ward, Stoneskin; 9 Legend Lore, Hold Monster.

feature:feature:martial-sorcery.description: Martial weapons, Light and Medium armor, and Shields. While Innate Sorcery is active, attack with proficient weapons using Charisma. At the start of each turn you can spend 1 Sorcery Point for 1d6 + Sorcerer level temp HP.

feature:feature:heroic-sorcery:extra-att.description: Attack twice per Attack action, and you can swap one attack for an action Sorcerer cantrip.

feature:feature:mystical-maneuvers.description: On a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, spend 2 Sorcery Points as a Bonus Action to add 2d8 damage and one effect. Blinding Attack: Con save or Blinded 1 minute (repeat save). Ruinous Blow: -3 AC until the end of your next turn. Wounding Strike: a bleeding wound that blocks healing and deals 1d8 Necrotic per wound each turn, ignoring Resistance, until staunched with an action.

feature:feature:heroic-haste.description: Haste on yourself can skip Concentration, and you suffer no lethargy when it ends.

feature:feature:magic-missile-savant.description: Magic Missile is free in your spellbook. It fires one extra dart (two at Wizard 6, three at 10, four at 14), ignores effects that specifically block it such as Shield, and you can cast it without a slot Int mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, regaining one on a Short Rest.

feature:feature:versatile-missiles.description: Give up darts to add effects to a target the darts strike: Trip (1 dart, Str save or Prone), Blinding (3, Con save or Blinded until your next turn), Stunning (5, Con save or Stunned until your next turn).

feature:feature:shield-of-missiles.description: Once per Long Rest (or a level 3+ slot), keep the darts orbiting you in a 10-foot Emanation for up to 1 minute: +1 AC per dart (max +5). A dart strikes anyone within 120 feet who misses you, and you can fire darts at creatures the Emanation touches (once per creature per turn).

feature:feature:giga-missile.description: Once per Long Rest (or a level 6+ slot), each dart deals extra Force equal to your Int mod (min 1).

feature:feature:permafrost.description: +1 AC while unarmored, Resistance to Cold damage, and Con mod times (min 1) per Long Rest you can extend a Rage that would end (no action) unless you are Unconscious.

feature:feature:frostbite.description: Once per turn while Raging, a Strength-based hit adds 1d6 Cold (2d6 at Barbarian 9, 3d6 at 16) and cuts the target's Speed by 10 feet until your next turn.

feature:feature:cold-fortress.description: Entering Rage while unarmored grants 1d12 + Con mod temp HP; on later turns of the Rage, a Bonus Action and a Hit Die grants them again.

feature:feature:deep-sleep.description: You can hibernate through a Long Rest, appearing dead to all inspection and magic and ignoring noise. Six unbroken hours give a Long Rest plus a bonus pool of Con mod (min 1) Barbarian Hit Dice until your next Long Rest; damage or a slap wakes you.

feature:feature:avalanche-stomp.description: As a Magic action, chosen creatures in a 15-foot Emanation make a Dex save (DC 8 + Str mod + PB) or take 3d6 + Str mod Bludgeoning and fall Prone.

feature:feature:inspirational-dance.description: As a Bonus Action spend a Bardic Inspiration: a creature that can see you gains temp HP equal to the die + Cha mod (min 2) and can use its Reaction to move its Speed without provoking or Dodge.

feature:feature:entrancing-movement.description: A creature that hits you with an Opportunity Attack or while you're Dodging takes Psychic damage equal to Cha mod + half your Bard level. Charm Person is always prepared, castable without Verbal components, and once per Long Rest without a slot as a level 3 spell whose targets get no Advantage from fighting you.

feature:feature:endless-dance.description: A creature receiving Inspirational Dance can instead use its Reaction to attack once. You can Dodge as a Bonus Action, including as part of any Bonus Action that spends Bardic Inspiration.

feature:feature:astral-domain-spells.description: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Blur, Guiding Bolt, Invisibility, Longstrider, Starry Wisp; 5 Blink, Slow; 7 Banishment, Dimension Door; 9 Teleportation Circle, Wall of Force.

feature:feature:create-void.description: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Bonus Action to open a 15-foot-radius vacuum within 60 feet: Dex save or 1d8 + Cleric level Force and pulled 15 feet toward the center, or half damage only.

feature:feature:planar-reach.description: Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, a Touch spell you cast has a 30-foot range instead.

feature:feature:spatial-exchange.description: Misty Step always prepared; cast it with a Channel Divinity instead of a slot, and then you can swap places with a willing creature within 30 feet.

feature:feature:supreme-switching.description: Any Misty Step can swap you with a willing creature. With Channel Divinity you can target an unwilling one (Charisma save negates and wastes the use), and on a successful swap you can cast a level 0-5 Touch spell with an action or Bonus Action casting time on that creature as part of the same Bonus Action.

feature:feature:improved-shillelagh.description: Shillelagh works on any melee weapon you hold, which can keep its own damage die, and any proficient weapon can be your Druid Spellcasting Focus.

feature:feature:unbroken-circle-spells.description: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Ensnaring Strike, Shillelagh, Shining Smite, True Strike; 5 Haste; 7 Fire Shield; 9 Flame Strike.

feature:feature:wild-recovery.description: As a Bonus Action spend a Wild Shape use to heal 2d6 + Druid level (3d6 at Druid 10, 4d6 at 14).

feature:feature:shillelagh-mastery.description: With a Shillelagh weapon you attack twice per Attack action and get +1 to attack and damage (+2 at Druid 10, +3 at 14; doesn't stack with the weapon's own bonus).

feature:feature:war-druid.description: Replace one Attack action attack with an action Druid cantrip.

feature:feature:nature-armor.description: You are always under Barkskin. At the start of each turn gain temp HP equal to half your Druid level, and on assuming Wild Shape gain temp HP equal to 1.5 times your Druid level.

feature:feature:agent-of-mercy.description: Mercy Dice: three d6 (four at Fighter 7, d8s at 10, five at 15, d10s at 18), regained on a Short or Long Rest. Benevolent Presence: add any number to Insight, Performance, or Persuasion checks. Merciless Strike: once per turn on a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, add one as Radiant damage. Peaceful Ward: as a Bonus Action, gain temp HP equal to one + Cha mod (min 1).

feature:feature:one-of-the-people.description: Proficiency in Insight and Persuasion. You can knock out instead of kill with any attack, leaving the target at 1 HP, Unconscious, and resting until healed or given first aid (DC 10 Medicine).

feature:feature:peacebringer.description: Your weapon and Unarmed Strike damage can be Radiant. Calm Emotions and Sanctuary are always prepared (Charisma, no Somatic or Material components), each once per Short or Long Rest without a slot.

feature:feature:calm-mind.description: Regain a Mercy Die for each creature you persuade to stand down. Immune to Charmed and Frightened.

feature:feature:paragon.description: As a Bonus Action spend a Mercy Die on a creature within 30 feet that can hear you: temp HP equal to the roll + Cha mod, and it can use its Reaction to move half its Speed without provoking and attack once; that attack only knocks out.

feature:feature:heraldic-enforcer.description: Once per turn, Merciless Strike costs no Mercy Die (and you can use it again that turn by paying one). Creatures you knock out stay Unconscious for 8 hours or until you or an ally shakes them awake, even if healed.

feature:feature:celestial-connection.description: Telepathy with any creature within 30 feet that knows a language (one-way).

feature:feature:soul-searching-strike.description: When you touch or hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, spend 1 Focus Point (free on Flurry of Blows hits) to read its emotions and most obvious desire until the end of your next turn (1 minute out of combat), perhaps its HP or a piece of history, and gain Advantage on your next attack against it this turn and on Insight checks with it.

feature:feature:stabilizing-focus.description: As a Magic action touch a Bloodied creature and spend Focus Points to heal 5 HP each, up to half its HP maximum. Spend 2 Focus Points to cast Enhance Ability, Lesser Restoration, or Protection from Evil and Good without a slot or Material components (Wisdom).

feature:feature:celestial-emissary.description: Dream and Scrying always prepared, each once per Long Rest without a slot or Material components (you must be the Dream messenger). Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, a hit made with Advantage adds a Martial Arts die of Radiant damage.

feature:feature:heavenborne.description: Stabilizing Focus works as a Bonus Action and at 30 feet. You fly at your Speed but fall if you end your turn airborne. Unarmed Strikes deal +1d4 Radiant.

feature:feature:oath-of-the-hearth-spell.description: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Burning Hands, Find Familiar; 5 Aid, Continual Flame; 9 Beacon of Hope, Daylight; 13 Fire Shield, Guardian of Faith; 17 Flame Strike, Rary's Telepathic Bond.

feature:feature:burning-weapon.description: When you take the Attack action, spend a Channel Divinity to ignite a held melee weapon for 10 minutes: hits deal +Cha mod (min 1) Fire and can deal Fire instead of their type, and it sheds Bright Light 20 feet and Dim 20 more.

feature:feature:aura-of-warmth.description: You and allies in your Aura of Protection have Resistance to Cold and Fire damage.

feature:feature:insulating-ward.description: Whenever you cast a level 1+ Paladin spell with a slot (or a level 1+ spell through a Paladin feature), you and allies in your aura gain temp HP equal to the spell's level + Cha mod (min 2).

feature:feature:burning-spirit.description: Once per Long Rest (or a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: your aura fills with Bright Light (Dim 30 feet beyond); +10 feet Speed and you can move through and end in others' spaces without anyone falling Prone; and at the end of each of your turns chosen creatures in a 10-foot Emanation take Fire equal to twice your Cha mod (min 2).

feature:feature:pin-down.description: Once per turn on a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, add 1d6 of the attack's type and cut the target's Speed by 10 feet until your next turn. At Ranger 11 it becomes 1d8 and the target also can't make Opportunity Attacks until your next turn.

feature:feature:winter-trapper-magic.description: Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Ice Knife; 5 Mirror Image; 9 Sleet Storm; 13 Hallucinatory Terrain; 17 Hold Monster.

feature:feature:arctic-predator.description: No Disadvantage on attacks against Prone targets more than 5 feet away. Icy or snowy Difficult Terrain costs no extra movement and gives Advantage on Stealth. You can't be Prone unless you are also Incapacitated.

feature:feature:magic-snare.description: Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action set an invisible trap in your space for 1 minute: the first Large or smaller creature to enter (other than you or chosen creatures) makes a Dex save, taking 2d8 Piercing and Speed 0 until the end of your next turn, or half damage only.

feature:feature:tripped-defenses.description: When a creature within 5 feet misses you, take a Reaction to knock it Prone (or halve a larger creature's Speed this turn), then attack it once or move half your Speed without provoking it.

feature:feature:impressionist.description: Expertise with Calligrapher's and Painter's Supplies; conjure either kit plus ink or paint as a Magic action (they vanish if they leave you). Any mark you paint can hold a Message that glows faintly until someone touches it and hears it.

feature:feature:runes.description: 4 Rune Points, regained on a Short or Long Rest. When you hit with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, spend 1 to mark the creature for up to 1 minute (it can wipe the mark off with an action). Cryos: no Reactions until your next turn. Hexxus: when it succeeds on a check or attack within 60 feet, a Reaction subtracts 1d6. Locus: the next attack against it has Advantage and deals +1d6 Acid on a hit.

feature:feature:escape-artist.description: Advantage on checks and saves to avoid or escape Grappled and Restrained, and escaping takes only a Bonus Action. Next to a solid surface, a Bonus Action and 1 Rune Point make you Invisible for 10 minutes until you attack, deal damage, cast a spell, or leave that space.

feature:feature:resourceful.description: On rolling Initiative, refill to 2 Rune Points if lower. Spend Rune Points to forgo one fewer Sneak Attack die per point for Cunning Strike effects.

feature:feature:lead-paint.description: Against a creature bearing (or receiving) your rune you can Sneak Attack without Advantage or an adjacent ally (unless you have Disadvantage), and that Sneak Attack deals +2d6.

feature:feature:create-ice.description: Touching a surface, as a Bonus Action ice over five contiguous 5-foot squares as Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn, plus five more per Sorcery Point.

feature:feature:frost-spells.description: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Blindness/Deafness, Ice Knife, Misty Step, Sleep; 5 Sleet Storm, Slow; 7 Fire Shield, Ice Storm; 9 Cone of Cold, Conjure Elemental (Cold only).

feature:feature:frozen-body.description: +3 HP maximum and +1 per later Sorcerer level. Icy or snowy Difficult Terrain costs no extra movement, and on ice each foot of movement carries you 2 feet.

feature:feature:cold-hearted.description: Resistance to Cold damage. When your spell deals Cold damage to a Large or smaller creature, spend Sorcery Points to cut its Speed by 15 feet each until the end of its next turn; reaching 0 also deals 2d6 Cold. Create Ice can freeze water 5 feet deep, holding up to Large creatures.

feature:feature:flash-freeze.description: Moving on ice doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks. When a creature within 5 feet hits you, take a Reaction to deal Cold equal to Cha mod + half your Sorcerer level and use Create Ice.

feature:feature:frozen-soul.description: Immunity to Cold and Resistance to Fire. Wall of Ice is always prepared without its Material component, and once per Long Rest castable without a slot with non-contiguous panels if flat.

feature:feature:astral-griffon-spells.description: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Identify, Locate Object, Magic Missile, Rope Trick; 5 Blink, Clairvoyance; 7 Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum, Leomund's Secret Chest; 9 Legend Lore, Passwall.

feature:feature:astral-missile.description: Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest cast Magic Missile without a slot; its darts can target creatures you can't see.

feature:feature:extradimensional-acuity.description: A personal pocket dimension holding 50 pounds in 1 cubic foot, reached by hand. Putting another extradimensional container inside destroys both and locks you out for 7 days. You sense other extradimensional spaces within 60 feet.

feature:feature:planar-escape.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, when you take damage, take a Reaction to halve it and slip into an overlapping demiplane, unseen by the plane you left, until the end of your next turn or until you return.

feature:feature:extradimensional-mastery.description: Resistance to Force damage. Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, a Magic action grants Truesight 30 feet and Advantage on sight-based Perception for 10 minutes. You sense the contents of extradimensional magic items within 10 feet.

feature:feature:pocketeer.description: Your pocket holds 250 pounds in 10 cubic feet. As a Magic action pull an unworn object within 30 feet into it (a carrier makes a Wis save, and that version is once per Short or Long Rest); unretrieved by the end of your next turn, it pops out within 5 feet or into your hand.

feature:feature:arcane-artisan.description: Learn Mending (or another Wizard cantrip) for free. Proficiency with three Artisan's Tools, swapping one each Long Rest. Crafting with proficient tools, cut each day's required hours by your Int mod (min 1; at least 2 hours).

feature:feature:minor-creation.description: When you cast a level 1+ spell, create a 5-foot cube of any inanimate material within 30 feet (60 at Wizard 10) or attached to another of your cubes. Each weighs 25 pounds, holds ten times that, gives cover, has AC 10 + Int mod and 1 HP, and lasts an hour; you can have as many as your Wizard level and dismiss them as a Bonus Action. Int mod times (min 1) per Long Rest (or regain uses with slots) you can detonate dismissed cubes instead: creatures within 10 feet make a Dex save for 1d6 + half your Wizard level Force, half on success.

feature:feature:material-enhancement.description: Twice per Short or Long Rest, as a Magic action give an object one benefit per use until your next rest: weapon +1 (+2 at Wizard 10, +3 at 14); armor +1 AC (same scaling); no Stealth Disadvantage; light 20/20 feet; half weight and no Strength requirement or Heavy penalty; returns when thrown; or cosmetic changes. Each benefit only once per recharge.

feature:feature:dematerialize.description: Your spells deal double damage to objects and structures, and your damage to Constructs adds 1d8 Force.

feature:feature:rematerialize.description: Once per Long Rest, when a Large or smaller nonmagical object or structure is destroyed within 60 feet, a Reaction stores its debris; within 8 hours a Magic action rebuilds it intact within 60 feet. Dropped from the air, it deals 1d6/2d6/3d6 Bludgeoning per 10 feet fallen (by size) to those beneath on a failed Dex save, half on success.

feature:feature:alchemical-experiments.description: Alchemist's Supplies with proficiency; craft Potions of Healing with them instead of an Herbalism Kit.

feature:feature:volatile-serum.description: When you Rage, inject one serum for the Rage (swap as a Bonus Action). Ferocity: ignore Difficult Terrain and trigger Cleave alongside another mastery on melee hits. Monstrosity: grow to Large (space permitting), +5 feet reach, and once per turn add your Rage Damage bonus to a missed Strength attack roll. Reconstruction: on injecting and at the start of each turn, spend and roll a Hit Die to heal it + Con mod, excess as temp HP (not the turn after Acid or Fire damage).

feature:feature:augmentation-compounds.description: Also activate a compound with your serum. Stimulated Senses: Blindsight 30 feet (or +30). Maddening Fumes: a 30-foot Emanation halves enemies' Speed, and those starting a turn there make a Wis save (DC 8 + Con mod + PB) or have Disadvantage attacking others until their next turn. Corrosive Expulsion: replace an attack with a 15-foot Cone or 30-foot Line of acid; Dex save for d8s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, half on success.

feature:feature:reactive-catalyst.description: When you take damage or become Blinded, Deafened, Poisoned, or Stunned, take a Reaction to Rage first, ending those conditions. Advantage on Con saves while Raging.

feature:feature:biochemical-admixture.description: Activate two serums at once. While Raging, a creature within 5 feet that damages you with a melee attack takes 1d12 Acid (once per turn).

feature:feature:handy-haints.description: When you give Bardic Inspiration, summon a haint around the target for 1 minute with a 15-foot aura (it ends when you use its Reaction). Grump: Advantage on Intimidation and Str saves in the aura, and a Reaction adds an Inspiration die + Cha mod to one creature's damage. Sad Sack: Half Cover against ranged attacks in the aura, and a Reaction reduces damage to a creature by an Inspiration die + Cha mod. Scamp: +10 feet Speed for those starting a turn in it, and a Reaction lets a creature reroll a failed save.

feature:feature:whistling-wanderer.description: On a Long Rest turn a bag into a bindle that works as a Handy Haversack (one at a time; it fails beyond 1 mile). You can whistle Verbal components; observers need DC 15 Arcana to recognize the casting.

feature:feature:homeward-bound.description: On each Long Rest mark the spot (up to Cha mod marks). Once per Long Rest cast Teleportation Circle to a mark as a phantom train. From Bard 9, Teleportation Circle is always prepared and can target your marks.

feature:feature:ride-the-rails.description: Once per Long Rest (or a level 3+ slot), as a Magic action a ghost train runs a 120-foot by 10-foot Line: you and up to six willing creatures within 30 feet teleport to a space along it, and others in the Line make a Wis save or are Deafened, pushed 10 feet, and take three Inspiration dice of Psychic.

feature:feature:last-stop.description: Once per Long Rest (or a level 7+ slot), as a Magic action up to six creatures within 300 feet make a Cha save or are cursed for up to 1 minute (repeat save each turn): Psychic damage Frightens them of its source, and the first Psychic hit gives them Vulnerability to Psychic.

feature:feature:community-almanac.description: Herbalism Kit with proficiency, plus Nature or Survival.

feature:feature:harvest-domain-spells.description: After each rest pick Sowing, Growing, or Reaping and have that column prepared up to your level. Sowing: 3 Druidcraft, Goodberry, Lesser Restoration; 5 Harvest Moonglow; 7 Death Ward; 9 Awaken. Growing: 3 Guidance, Entangle, Summer Winds; 5 Plant Growth; 7 Sanctum of the Shepherd; 9 Mass Cure Wounds. Reaping: 3 Chill Touch, Inflict Wounds, Hold Person; 5 Culling Sickle; 7 Consuming Pyre; 9 Field of Reaping.

feature:feature:cornucopia.description: Once per Long Rest, start a Short Rest by conjuring food for twice your PB creatures; at the rest's end divide Cleric-level d4s of healing among those who ate.

feature:feature:bountiful-harvest.description: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Magic action: up to six creatures within 60 feet gain Heroic Inspiration (once per Long Rest each) plus one aspect's boon, which becomes your aspect. Sowing: temp HP equal to PB + Wis mod. Growing: +1d4 to attacks and checks until the end of your next turn. Reaping: +PB Necrotic on their first damage before the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:blessing-of-the-seasons.description: Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, when a creature within 30 feet fails a save of your aspect's types (Sowing Dex/Cha, Growing Con/Int, Reaping Wis/Str), take a Reaction to let it reroll; afterward it heals PB d4s.

feature:feature:eternal-wheel.description: Once per Long Rest (or a level 7+ slot), Bountiful Harvest adds: Sowing, Regenerate for 1 minute; Growing, Advantage on saves and checks for up to 1 hour (Concentration); Reaping, Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Poison for 1 hour.

feature:feature:circle-of-the-old-ways-s.description: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Ancestral Communion, Barkskin, Shield of Faith, Shillelagh, Spike Growth; 5 Magic Circle, Plant Growth; 7 Freedom of Movement, Private Sanctum; 9 Awaken, Tree Stride.

feature:feature:bough-and-branch.description: Casting Shillelagh can grow a wooden Shield in your free hand for its duration; you can't be disarmed of either unless Incapacitated, you ignore Somatic components of Druid spells, and the weapon is your Druidic Focus.

feature:feature:wood-wose.description: As a Bonus Action or while casting Shillelagh, spend a Wild Shape use for 10 minutes: unarmored AC 10 + Dex + Wis; Shillelagh hits coat the target in sap so it has Disadvantage attacking anyone but you until your next turn; Advantage on Str and Con saves.

feature:feature:oak-and-thorn.description: During Wood Wose: two attacks per Attack action, and once per turn a melee weapon hit adds 1d6 Piercing.

feature:feature:deepwood-elder.description: During Wood Wose: once per turn a melee hit forces a Str save or Prone; melee attackers within 5 feet take 1d8 Piercing (once per turn); and you gain Wis mod + PB temp HP on activation and each turn.

feature:feature:ancient-protector.description: During Wood Wose: grow to Large with +5 feet reach, Resistance to Bludgeoning and Piercing, and a Reaction melee attack when a sap-coated creature in reach makes an attack roll.

feature:feature:bewitched-effigy.description: As a Bonus Action spend a Wild Shape use to set a Small wicker effigy within 30 feet for 1 minute (AC 15, HP 5 x Druid level, Vulnerable to Fire) with a 30-foot dimly lit aura. Sacrifice: Reaction to deal 1d8 + Wis mod Fire to a creature in it that takes damage. Soothe: on creation and as a Bonus Action later, heal a creature in it 1d6 (twice your spellcasting modifier times). Ward: +1 AC to you and allies in it.

feature:feature:circle-of-wicker-spells.description: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Bane, Bless, Summer Winds, Zone of Truth; 5 Bestow Curse, Tiny Hut; 7 Death Ward, Sanctum of the Shepherd; 9 Hold Monster, Lucky Charm.

feature:feature:wicker-token.description: On each Long Rest make PB tokens; you can cast Touch spells on anyone carrying one on your plane.

feature:feature:wicker-rising.description: Sacrifice becomes 2d8 + Wis mod. Soothe heals 1d8 and can spend 5 of the effigy's HP to end Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned. Ward also grants Resistance to one non-Force damage type.

feature:feature:soulbound-poppet.description: As a Magic action spend a Wild Shape use to make a doll of a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute (AC 10, 10 HP): it has Disadvantage attacking whoever carries the doll, and that carrier's first damage to it each turn adds 2d10 Necrotic.

feature:feature:wicker-zenith.description: Switch the effigy's aura at the start of your turn. Sacrifice becomes 3d8 + Wis mod; Soothe ends Charmed or Frightened on those starting a turn there; Ward also grants Advantage on saves of one chosen ability.

feature:feature:death-knight.description: Draugr Dice: four d6 (six d8 at Fighter 5, eight at 9, eight d10 at 11, ten at 13, twelve d12 at 17); regain one on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest; save DC 8 + Con mod + PB. Dark Rider: once per Short or Long Rest (or spend a die), as a Bonus Action summon a ghostly Undead Warhorse for 1 hour with B/P/S Resistance that can only Dash, Disengage, or Dodge; spend a die on its Dash to add 5 feet per point rolled. Grave Guard: Reaction to reduce damage by a die + Con mod. Soul Reaper: give up an attack to grip a creature within 60 feet with ghostly hands: Str save or a die + Con mod Necrotic and Grappled for 1 minute, half damage only on success.

feature:feature:siphoning-souls.description: When a non-Construct, non-Undead enemy within 30 feet dies, a Reaction regains a Draugr Die. Spend a die to add it to an ability check.

feature:feature:tomb-castellan.description: Your steed ignores Difficult Terrain, and when it Dashes, Disengages, or Dodges you can spend a die to teleport it 60 feet; chosen creatures within 10 feet of where it appears make a Con save for a die + Con mod Necrotic, half on success. Grave Guard returns half the prevented damage as Psychic to the attacker. Creatures held by Soul Reaper take PB Psychic at the start of their turns, plus a die with your Reaction.

feature:feature:grave-lord.description: Dark Rider can carry a passenger, and spending a die on its Dash lets it pass through objects and creatures. Grave Guard also grants Resistance to one triggering damage type until your next turn. Soul Reaper's grapple also Restrains.

feature:feature:might-of-the-necropolis.description: You don't age or need air, food, drink, or sleep. When you roll Initiative with fewer than 3 Draugr Dice, refill to 3.

feature:feature:contagious-discipline.description: Your Unarmed Strikes can deal Slashing, and Flurry of Blows hits add a Martial Arts die of Necrotic. Miasmic Plague: on an Unarmed Strike hit, spend 1 Focus Point (or forgo the Flurry bonus) for a Con save or 1 minute cursed: Poisoned and once per turn taking a Martial Arts die of extra Necrotic from your Unarmed Strikes, repeating the save each turn.

feature:feature:gift-of-pestilence.description: Advantage on saves against Poisoned and magical contagions and Resistance to Poison and Necrotic. Talk simply with vermin, and once per Long Rest cast Animal Messenger on a plague-bearing Tiny Beast (Wisdom).

feature:feature:potent-plague.description: Your Necrotic and Poison damage ignores Resistance to those types.

feature:feature:tolling-censer.description: As a Magic action spend 2 Focus Points: chosen creatures in a 20-foot Emanation make a Con save for two Martial Arts dice Necrotic and Miasmic Plague, half damage only on success.

feature:feature:miasmic-contagion.description: Saves against Miasmic Plague have Disadvantage. Spending a Focus Point on Step of the Wind lets you plague chosen creatures you pass within 5 feet of (Con save, once per turn each).

feature:feature:epidemic.description: Miasmic Plague ignores immunity to Poisoned, and your Necrotic damage to a plagued creature adds a Martial Arts die.

feature:feature:castigate.description: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Magic action: up to Cha mod creatures within 30 feet make a Str save or are shackled in fire with Speed 0 for up to 1 minute (repeat save each turn); a Bonus Action flares the shackles for 2d6 Fire each.

feature:feature:incite.description: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Magic action for 10 minutes of Advantage on Investigation and Insight, during which a Bonus Action forces a creature within 10 feet to make a Cha save or be Frightened for 1 minute and unable to lie deliberately (ends if it takes damage or you use this again).

feature:feature:oath-of-castigation-spel.description: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Divine Favor, Inflict Wounds; 5 Chain of Conviction, Hold Person; 9 Counterspell, Speak with Dead; 13 Consuming Pyre, Locate Creature; 17 Flame Strike, Hold Monster.

feature:feature:kindling-aura.description: You and allies in your Aura of Protection ignore Fire and Radiant Resistance, can deal Fire with weapon hits, and add your Cha mod to Investigation and Insight.

feature:feature:fervent-inquisitor.description: When a creature damages you or an ally within 30 feet, a Reaction grants Advantage on your next attack against it. Fire or Radiant damage to a Bloodied creature reveals any lies it knowingly told you in the past 24 hours.

feature:feature:fire-and-brimstone.description: Once per Long Rest (or a level 5 slot), as a Bonus Action for 10 minutes: Immunity to Fire, +10 feet reach with melee attacks that ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover, and a creature you hit with an Opportunity Attack or that ends its turn in your reach makes a Cha save or falls Prone with Speed 0 until its next turn.

feature:feature:grim-harbinger-spells.description: Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Bane; 5 Hold Person; 9 Fear; 13 Intrusive Despair; 17 Dream.

feature:feature:omen-of-doom.description: Wis mod times (min 1) per Short or Long Rest (or spend a slot), as a Bonus Action doom a creature within 90 feet for 1 hour: once per turn your hits on it add 1d6 Necrotic. A Grim appears within 30 feet of it (AC 13 + Wis mod, HP 5 + 5 x Ranger level, Incorporeal Movement, adds PB to checks and saves; Ominous Rend uses your spell attack for 1d6 + 3 + Wis mod Necrotic and Frightens; Baleful Howl reaction stops a fleeing creature). It Dodges unless commanded with a Bonus Action or by giving up an attack, and vanishes when you die, the target dies, it drops to 0, or you use this again.

feature:feature:harbinger-of-doom.description: Ominous Rend deals +1d6 Necrotic, your damage to a doomed creature can be Necrotic, and Necrotic from you or the Grim ignores Resistance.

feature:feature:grave-bond.description: The Grim gains B/P/S Resistance; you gain Necrotic Resistance; and once per Omen, a Reaction makes the doomed target reroll a successful save with Disadvantage.

feature:feature:sealed-fate.description: Ominous Rend deals a further +1d6. Once per Long Rest (or a level 4+ slot), when you cast Omen of Doom the target makes a Cha save or is Vulnerable to the Grim's damage and your Omen damage.

feature:feature:hex-slinger.description: Cha mod times (min 1) per Short Rest, when you deal Sneak Attack damage designate two of the dice; their total sets a jinx until the end of the target's next turn. 2 Snake Eyes: it can only move or act or Bonus Act, taking 2d6 Psychic if it attacks your side. 3-4 The Nightmare: Frightened and it uses its Reaction to flee. 5-6 Whiskey Bottle: drops what it holds and fumbles pickups (DC 15 Dex). 7 Cheap Shot: half Speed and attacks against it have Advantage. 8-9 Withered Arm: Disadvantage on Strength D20 Tests. 10-11 Bad Luck: -1d6 on attacks and saves. 12 Dead Man: your next attack before the end of your next turn hits, or crits if it would hit (triple dice on a natural 20).

feature:feature:get-jinxed.description: Proficiency with two Gaming Sets. A 1-hour ritual makes a jinx weapon: a Gaming Set that works for you as a Simple Ranged weapon (30/90 feet, 1d8 Force, Vex mastery), a Pistol, or a proficient weapon that deals Force. Learn Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Mysterious Presence, or Prestidigitation (Charisma).

feature:feature:borrowed-luck.description: Using Hex Slinger grants Heroic Inspiration; if you already have it you can spend it instead of a Hex Slinger use.

feature:feature:pick-your-poison.description: Roll the jinx dice twice and choose. Doubles also deal Psychic equal to half your level, and a 2 or 12 doesn't spend the use.

feature:feature:the-other-side.description: After a missed attack or failed save, spend and roll any number of Sneak Attack dice to add to it; when hit, spend them to add to your AC. Spent dice return after your next Sneak Attack.

feature:feature:blood-well.description: When you deal damage or restore HP, spend your Blood Well to add 1d8 for one target. It refills on a Long Rest or when a creature takes 10+ Necrotic from you at once.

feature:feature:crimson-spells.description: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Aid, Blood Bolt, Cure Wounds, Inflict Wounds, Blood Sacrifice; 5 Crimson Harvest, Vampiric Touch; 7 Death Ward, Sacrificial Siphon; 9 Field of Reaping, Mass Cure Wounds.

feature:feature:pool-of-blood.description: As a Bonus Action spend your Blood Well to become a pool of blood for up to 1 hour: Speed 10 with climb, swim, and spider climb; B/P/S Resistance; immune to Prone; Advantage on Str, Dex, Con saves; squeeze through cracks and share spaces; but no speaking, attacking, casting, or using items.

feature:feature:scarlet-vigor.description: Resistance to Necrotic. After a Short Rest, spend your Blood Well to remove 1 Exhaustion level.

feature:feature:vital-siphoning.description: As a Bonus Action spend a Hit Die to refill your Blood Well, or spend the Blood Well to make your next Metamagic this turn free.

feature:feature:sanguine-feast.description: Once per Long Rest (or 5 Sorcery Points), as a Magic action chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Con save (with Disadvantage if your Blood Well is spent) for 5d8 Necrotic, half on success; you heal the damage roll if any are hurt.

feature:feature:great-fool-spells.description: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Disguise Self, Hideous Laughter, Rope Trick, Spiritual Weapon, Vicious Mockery; 5 Blink, Stinking Cloud; 7 Phantasmal Killer, Puppet Master; 9 Arcane Hand, Mislead.

feature:feature:killing-joke.description: Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest (one back on a Short Rest), when a creature you can see within 60 feet takes damage or fails a save, take a Reaction to cast Vicious Mockery on it.

feature:feature:jester-s-japes.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, as a Magic action a creature within 60 feet makes a Cha save or is cursed for 1 minute (repeat save each turn): Flower Spurt (Blinded), Clown Shoes (half Speed, Disadvantage on Dex checks and saves), Honk Honk (noisy and can't benefit from Invisible), or Jolly Arms (half damage with weapons and Unarmed Strikes).

feature:feature:mocking-banter.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, when a creature damages you, take a Reaction: it makes a Wis save, taking Psychic damage equal to the damage you took, or half on success.

feature:feature:send-in-the-clowns.description: Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action summon three ghostly fools for 1 minute and make up to three melee spell attacks against creatures within 60 feet (repeatable with your action on later turns): 2d10 Psychic and Frightened until its next turn ends, or Prone.

feature:feature:horned-king-spells.description: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Animal Friendship, Bane, Spike Growth, Suggestion; 5 Bestow Curse, Fly; 7 Phantasmal Killer, Polymorph; 9 Dominate Person, Scrying.

feature:feature:witch-mark.description: On a Long Rest, imbue a held Tiny object with one of your prepared action-time Warlock spells; whoever holds it can cast it once as a Magic action using your modifiers.

feature:feature:malediction.description: Cha mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, curse a creature within 60 feet until the end of its next turn as a Magic action, or as a Reaction when it targets you with an attack or spell. Agony: Disadvantage on its next attack or Concentration save. Hate: Disadvantage on its next Int, Wis, or Cha save. Rot: +1d10 Necrotic the next time it takes damage and no healing until its next turn ends.

feature:feature:spiteful-curse.description: Once per Long Rest (not spent if it saves), Malediction can cast Bestow Curse instead with 60-foot range, 1-minute duration, and no Concentration; on a successful save it suffers a Malediction curse instead.

feature:feature:crown-of-horns.description: Once per Long Rest (or a Pact slot), as a Bonus Action for 1 minute: once per turn your damage adds 1d8 Necrotic, and on activation and each turn a creature in a 20-foot aura makes a Cha save or until your next turn is Charmed, has Disadvantage on attacks and checks, or is Frightened and must flee.

feature:feature:gather-the-coven.description: A 1-hour ritual bonds up to six willing creatures: each can use one chosen Malediction Reaction once per Long Rest; once per Short or Long Rest you can teleport next to a bonded creature as a Bonus Action (free while Crowned); and while your Crown is active their first damage each turn adds 1d10 Necrotic.

feature:feature:forbidden-knowledge.description: Learn Deep Speech or another language, and always have one level 1 Warlock spell prepared (swap on a Long Rest).

feature:feature:intrusion.description: You have an Intrusion Die that starts at d6 (d8 at Wizard 5, d10 at 11, d12 at 17) and shifts along d2-d3-d4-d6-d8-d10-d12. Risking Intrusion: roll it; on 2+ nothing happens and it shrinks a step; on a 1 it grows a step and you roll a d12 Intrusion effect (from losing actions, warped space, or blindness to a free spell slot, a buffed DC, or a summoned Aberration or Fiend). It regrows a step on a Short Rest and resets on a Long Rest. When you cast a slot spell, risk Intrusion for Overwhelming Mind (Disadvantage on the first save) or Seeking Eye (Advantage on the first attack roll).

feature:feature:reality-tear.description: Always have one Warlock spell of level 3 or lower prepared (swap on a Long Rest). Risk Intrusion to cast it without Concentration (lasting up to 1 minute), or once per Long Rest trigger an automatic Intrusion to cast it without a slot.

feature:feature:occult-presence.description: Roll Intrusion effects twice and pick, or negate one by gaining 1 Exhaustion. Gain one benefit, swappable on a Long Rest or with an automatic Intrusion as a Bonus Action: immunity to Charmed, Frightened, and possession; Resistance to Necrotic and Psychic; or flight with hover at your Speed.

feature:feature:beyond-space.description: Scrying always prepared. Risk Intrusion to treat the target as if you had part of its body, or to cast it as an action. Once per Long Rest during the spell, trigger an automatic Intrusion to teleport yourself and willing creatures within 10 feet to spaces seen through the sensor.

feature:feature:alchemical-knowledge.description: Alchemist's Supplies with proficiency, usable as an Arcane Focus and to craft any magic item.

feature:feature:quintessence.description: Learn Dissolution; what it destroys (Small or larger) leaves an ounce of Quintessence. Hold up to twice your Int mod (min 2). Spend it as 100 GP of Material components per measure, as 50 GP of materials for scribing or crafting, or to turn one damage type of a spell into Force.

feature:feature:albedo.description: When casting with a slot, spend up to half your PB (round up) in Quintessence to raise the slot level by 1 each (max 9).

feature:feature:citrinitas.description: Creation and Fabricate always prepared, each once per Long Rest without a slot and as an action. Spend up to Int mod Quintessence on Creation to multiply its duration by 1 + the amount.

feature:feature:rubedo.description: After a rest, spend 10 Quintessence to make a philosopher's stone (AC 19, 20 HP, harmed only by Force). While carried: spend up to 2 Quintessence to raise a spell's DC by that much; a Reaction and 5 Quintessence turn a failed save into a success; you stop aging; and it counts as part of your body for Scrying and resurrection, serving as the component.

feature:feature:rage-of-the-giants.description: When you activate Rage, if smaller than Large you can become Large (with your gear) if there is room. While Large your carrying capacity doubles, you have Advantage on Strength checks and saves, and weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks deal one extra damage die.

feature:feature:crushing-steps.description: You can move through the space of any creature smaller than you. An enemy whose space you move through makes a Strength save (DC 8 + Strength modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or has the Prone condition and can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

feature:feature:titanic-strikes.description: Brutal Strike's Forceful Blow pushes twice as far, and Hamstring Blow reduces the target's Speed to 0 until the start of your next turn.

feature:feature:rage-of-the-titans.description: When you activate Rage, if smaller than Huge you can become Huge (or Large if there isn't room). While Huge your carrying capacity triples, your reach increases by 5 feet, you have Advantage on Strength checks and saves, and your attacks deal two extra damage dice.

feature:feature:poetic-provocation.description: You always have Vicious Mockery prepared (or learn another cantrip if you know it). A creature that fails its save against your Vicious Mockery also has Disadvantage on its next Wisdom, Intelligence, or Charisma save before the end of your next turn. Flyting Master: use Charisma (Performance) in place of Intimidation or Persuasion to provoke, threaten, or sway with words.

feature:feature:skald:martial-training.description: Proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor and Shields. You can use a Simple or Martial weapon as a Spellcasting Focus for Bard spells, and you gain the mastery property of one Simple or Martial weapon (change it after a Long Rest).

feature:feature:bragi-s-rune-of-speech.description: As a Bonus Action, expend a Bardic Inspiration for one effect (only one active at a time). Scorn: a creature within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or has Disadvantage on attacks against you for 1 minute. Eloquence: add your Bardic Inspiration roll to your first Charisma check or save in the next hour. Vitality: you and up to three allies within 30 feet gain Temporary Hit Points equal to a Bardic Inspiration roll.

feature:feature:battle-sagas.description: Spend 1 minute reciting the Eddas; creatures of your choice within 60 feet that hear you gain for 1 hour: Resistance to Poison and Immunity to Frightened and Poisoned, +2d10 Hit Point maximum (and Hit Points), and +1d4 once per turn to an attack roll or save. During that hour, when an affected ally fails a d20 test, you can take a Reaction and expend a Bardic Inspiration to let it add the die. Once per Short or Long Rest.

feature:feature:domain-spells.description: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Augury, Bane, Bless, Warding Bond; 5 Bestow Curse, Counterspell; 7 Death Ward, Divination; 9 Commune, Modify Memory.

feature:feature:tailor-the-skein.description: After a Long Rest, roll a d6 twice and record the results as Skeins. As a Reaction after learning the result of an attack, damage roll, save, or ability check by a creature you can see within 60 feet, add or subtract one Skein from it. Each Skein is used once. The die becomes a d8 at level 7, d10 at 11, and d12 at 15.

feature:feature:plucking-at-threads.description: As a Bonus Action, expend a Channel Divinity: allies within 30 feet have Advantage on attack rolls and saves until the end of your next turn.

feature:feature:intertwined-fate.description: As a Magic action, expend a spell slot and choose two creatures you can see within 30 feet. The primary makes a Constitution save (it may choose to fail), taking 1d8 Force damage per slot level or half on a success. The secondary regains that many Hit Points, or gains them as Temporary Hit Points if uninjured.

feature:feature:skein-weaver.description: When you use Plucking at Threads, enemies within 30 feet make a Charisma save or have Disadvantage on attack rolls and saves for 1 minute (save at the end of each turn); a success grants immunity for 24 hours.

feature:feature:mantle-of-the-wolf.description: As an action, expend a Wild Shape use to manifest a spectral wolf's head for 10 minutes (ends if dismissed, re-manifested, or you are Incapacitated). You add your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1) to Strength (Athletics) checks and Strength saves, and you can replace one melee attack with a bite using Wisdom: 1d8 + Wisdom modifier Force.

feature:feature:circle-of-fenris-spells.description: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Beast Sense, Enhance Ability, Ensnaring Strike, Hunter's Mark; 5 Conjure Animals, Fear; 7 Dominate Beast; 9 Commune with Nature.

feature:feature:improved-mantle.description: While the mantle is active: bite attacks deal double damage to objects and structures and ignore damage thresholds; Darkvision 60 feet (or +30 feet); and +10 feet Speed.

feature:feature:defend-the-pack.description: When a creature attacks an ally within 30 feet, take a Reaction and spend a Wild Shape use: a phantom wolf deals 4d8 Force (no roll or save) and knocks it Prone. 6d8 from level 14.

feature:feature:children-of-the-great-wo.description: Once per day when you take on your Mantle of the Wolf, also summon a loyal fenrikyn that obeys your telepathic commands for as long as the mantle lasts (or until dismissed, destroyed, you leave the plane, are killed or Unconscious, or it is more than 120 feet away).

feature:feature:seaborne.description: Advantage on Strength and Dexterity saves and checks to avoid being pushed, knocked Prone, or moved against your will, and on checks to pilot waterborne vehicles.

feature:feature:viking-weapon-mastery.description: If you have Weapon Mastery with a Battleaxe, Longsword, or Spear, once on each of your turns add your Proficiency Bonus to a damage roll with it.

feature:feature:savage-charge.description: As an Attack action, move up to your Speed and make one melee attack. On a hit, a Bonus Action Dash lets you pass through the target's space without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

feature:feature:call-of-the-northlands.description: At the end of a Long Rest choose one (replacing the previous): Dragonslayer (Advantage on attacks against Dragons), Hardy Swimmer (Swim Speed equal to Speed), Inured to Cold (Resistance to Cold), or Trollslayer (Advantage on attacks against Giants).

feature:feature:marauder-s-reprisal.description: When you become Bloodied or take a Critical Hit, use your Reaction to attack an enemy in reach; a hit is a Critical Hit and grants Temporary Hit Points equal to half your level. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest.

feature:feature:unstoppable-assault.description: As an action once per Long Rest, attack additional times equal to half your Proficiency Bonus beyond your normal attacks; hits from these are Critical Hits and push the target 10 feet unless it succeeds on a Strength save (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Strength modifier).

feature:feature:tenets-of-valhalla.description: Protect the worthy dead. Inspire courage in battle. Bring justice to those who make a mockery of the dead.
